npc.ishina.greet_msg_1: Var hälsad, |PLAYERNAME|. Vilken av mina fina pärlor gör du {need}?
npc.ishina.multi_1: [EN] Listen, um... I have been wanting a comb for a long time... not just any comb, but a mermaid's comb. Having a mermaid's comb means never having split ends again! ...
npc.ishina.multi_2: [EN] You know what that means to a girl! Could you please bring me such a comb? I really would appreciate it.
npc.ishina.say_1: [EN] My jewelled belt? Of course I could make one for you, but I have a small request. Would you fulfil a task for me?
npc.ishina.say_2: [EN] Have you brought me a mermaid's comb?
npc.ishina.say_3: [EN] Yay! I will wait for you to return with a mermaid's comb then.
npc.ishina.say_5: [EN] Yeah! That's it! I can't wait to comb my hair! Oh - but first, I'll fulfil my promise: Here is your jewelled belt! Thanks again!
npc.ishina.stdmod_1: Jag är juvelerare. Kanske vill du ta en titt på min underbara {offers}.
npc.ishina.stdmod_2: Jo, jag säljer juveler och {goblets}. Om du vill se mina erbjudanden, be mig om en {trade}.
npc.ishina.stdmod_3: Ah, vår senaste import! Vi har guldbägare, silverbägare och bronsbägare. Alla har utrymme för en handskriven dedikation.
npc.isimov.greet_msg_1: Välkommen, unga |PLAYERNAME|! Om du är svårt sårad eller förgiftad kan jag {heal} dig gratis.
npc.isimov.keyword_1: Så ta emot skyddet av ödets vändning, pilgrim.
npc.isimov.stdmod_1: Så ta emot skyddet av ödets vändning, pilgrim.
npc.isimov.stdmod_11: [EN] I think you have forgotten to bring your stake, kid.
npc.isimov.stdmod_12: Ja, jag fick besked om vad jag skulle göra. Är du beredd att ta emot min bönelinje?
npc.isimov.stdmod_13: [EN] So receive my prayer: 'Unclean spirits shall be repelled'. Now, bring your stake to Amanda in Edron for the next line of the prayer. I will inform her what to do.
npc.isimov.stdmod_15: [EN] You should visit Amanda in Edron now, kid.
npc.isimov.stdmod_16: Du har redan fått min bönrad.
npc.isimov.stdmod_17: En välsignad insats? Det är en konstig begäran. Kanske Quentin vet mer, han är trots allt en av de äldsta munkarna.
npc.isimov.stdmod_18: Du är sårad, mitt barn. Jag ska läka dina sår.
npc.isimov.stdmod_19: Du ser inte så illa ut. Tyvärr, jag kan inte hjälpa dig. Men om du letar efter ytterligare skydd bör du gå på {pilgrimage} av aska eller få skyddet av {twist of fate} här.
npc.isimov.stdmod_2: Bra. Du är fri att tacka nej till mitt erbjudande.
npc.isimov.stdmod_20: Närhelst du får ett dödligt sår skadas din livskraft och det finns en chans att du tappar bort en del av din utrustning. Med varenda av de fem {blessings} du har kommer denna skada och risken för förlust att minska.
npc.isimov.stdmod_21: [EN] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.isimov.stdmod_22: Jag ser att du fick den andliga avskärmningen i det vita blomtemplet söder om Thais.
npc.isimov.stdmod_23: Jag kan ana att druiderna norr om Carlin har försett dig med omfamningen Tibia.
npc.isimov.stdmod_24: Jag kan se att du fick välsignelsen av de två solarna i soltornet nära Ab'Dendriel.
npc.isimov.stdmod_25: Jag kan ana att gnistan från Fenix ​​redan gavs till dig av dvärgprästerna av jord och eld i Kazordoon.
npc.isimov.stdmod_26: Jag kan känna att du redan pratade med eremiten Eremo på ön Cormaya och fick denna välsignelse.
npc.isimov.stdmod_27: Du kan be om välsignelsen av andlig avskärmning i whiteflower-templet söder om Thais.
npc.isimov.stdmod_28: Druiderna norr om Carlin kommer att förse dig med Tibia.
npc.isimov.stdmod_29: Du kan be om välsignelsen av de två solarna i soltornet nära Ab'Dendriel.
npc.isimov.stdmod_30: Fenixens gnista ges av jord- och eldens dvärgpräster i Kazordoon.
npc.isimov.stdmod_32:
Detta är en speciell välsignelse som jag kan skänka dig när du har fått åtminstone en av de andra välsignelserna och som fungerar lite annorlunda. ... \z
	Det fungerar bara när du dödas av andra äventyrare, vilket betyder att minst hälften av skadan som ledde till din död orsakades av andra, inte av monster eller miljön. ... \z
	{twist of fate} kommer inte att minska dödsstraffet som de andra välsignelserna, utan istället hindra dig från att förlora dina andra välsignelser såväl som förlustamuletten, om du bär en. Det kostar lika mycket som de andra välsignelserna. ... \z
	Skulle du vilja få det skyddet för ett offer på |PVPBLESSCOST| guld, barn?
npc.isimov.stdmod_4: Ah, vill du byta ut din äventyrarsten gratis?
npc.isimov.stdmod_5: Här är du. Ta hand om dig.
npc.isimov.stdmod_7: Ah, vill du byta ut din äventyrarsten mot 30 guld?
npc.isimov.stdmod_8: Här är du. Ta hand om dig.
npc.isimov.stdmod_9: Tyvärr, du har inte tillräckligt med pengar.
npc.isimov.walkaway_msg_1: Kom ihåg: Om du är svårt sårad eller förgiftad kan jag bota dig gratis.
npc.iskan.greet_msg_1: [EN] You are not one of us. I don't want to talk to you.
npc.iskan.greet_msg_2: [EN] I was told you have been killing huskies here in Svargrond! Never do that again, okay? They are precious animals for us. Give me 500 gold and I will forget that incident without telling it to Jarl Sven. Okay?
npc.iskan.greet_msg_3: [EN] HAIL to the Warlord of the arena! |PLAYERNAME|, Hero of Svargrond! What can I {do for you}?
npc.iskan.greet_msg_4: [EN] Greetings. What can I {do for you}?
npc.iskan.multi_1: [EN] That's surprising. Take a piece of meat. If you find the boy, feed it to him. That will give him enough strength and incentive to return to his pack ...
npc.iskan.multi_2: [EN] Talk to him by calling his name 'Sniffler' and tell him you got meat for him. After he has eaten the meat, return here to talk to me about your mission.
npc.iskan.multi_3: [EN] Well, one of the boys has run away. I think he got the scent of some beast. He's young and inexperienced so I can't blame the cub ...
npc.iskan.multi_4: [EN] I would like you to see after him. He should be somewhere north west of the town. He is probably marking his territory so you should be able to find his trace. Are you willing to do that?
npc.iskan.say_1: [EN] So, do you want a passage to Nibelor my friend?
npc.iskan.say_3: [EN] You are a friend of mine and the boys now. I tell you something. If you ever need to go to the isle of Nibelor, just ask me for a {passage}.
npc.iskan.say_4: [EN] I have now no mission for you.
npc.iskan.say_5: [EN] Sorry but I only give missions to those who are considered a true Barbarian.
npc.iskan.say_7: [EN] You don't have enough. Bring me the money and I will forget about it.
npc.iskan.say_8: [EN] Sorry, first time you have to do a mission for me.
npc.iskan.say_9: [EN] Mhmm, you leave me no other choice than to inform the Jarl.
npc.iskan.stdmod_1: [EN] I run the dog sled service from this city to {Nibelor}.
npc.iskan.stdmod_10: [EN] The yeti is real and dangerous.
npc.iskan.stdmod_11: [EN] I am not sure what to think about this new custom to accept foreigners as one of us after passing that test. But it's the Jarl's decision, not mine.
npc.iskan.stdmod_12: [EN] The raiders camps are far to the south. There are three of them. Small camp sites of raiding parties might be found almost anywhere though.
npc.iskan.stdmod_13: [EN] They are sometimes trying to catch me and the boys. Such fools, they will never get us. Right, boys?
npc.iskan.stdmod_14: [EN] The boys can tell who's an enemy just by the smell.
npc.iskan.stdmod_15: [EN] Me and the boys care only about our own territory.
npc.iskan.stdmod_16: [EN] I guess their healing powers are almost as useful as those of our shamans.
npc.iskan.stdmod_17: [EN] I guess there are guys like me that have a talent to talk to dogs and there are guys like the shamans that have the talent to talk to spirits.
npc.iskan.stdmod_18: [EN] We don't need any kings or queens. Am I right, boys? Yeah, I am.
npc.iskan.stdmod_19: [EN] Sven the Younger is our current Jarl. For my standards he's still a puppy, but a smart one at least.
npc.iskan.stdmod_20: [EN] Yeah, where could it be. That's the question.
npc.iskan.stdmod_21: [EN] Easy, boys! Don't mention that name again. Makes the boys nuts, ye know?
npc.iskan.stdmod_22: [EN] In my whole long life, I've not seen any sign of those gods the people of the south are constantly talking about.
npc.iskan.stdmod_23: [EN] The icy father. We know him all too well, am I right boys? He has claimed so many old friends in all those years. So many.
npc.iskan.stdmod_24:
[EN] I'll tell you something. I have seen such a creature once, far on the ice to the east. It was the coldest winter I can remember and the chakoyas were roaming the ice almost everywhere. ... \z
	To evade them, me and the boys had to walk a long way to a spot where the ice was treacherous and thin. ... \z
	And there I've seen such a creature. The boys went almost mad and I turned my sled immediately. No idea how we made it home. True story.
npc.iskan.stdmod_3: [EN] I can bring you to Nibelor with the sled if you want to. Just ask for a {passage}.
npc.iskan.stdmod_4: [EN] This city seems to be growing every day. First, there have been only a few huts and now ... look around, houses everywhere.
npc.iskan.stdmod_5: [EN] Our people are very proud and honest. I guess that's more than most people can say about themselves and their people, right boys?
npc.iskan.stdmod_6: [EN] I heard something about a ship crashing in the shelf ice between Nibelor and Grimlund. If I were you, I wouldn't go to chakoya terrain. It's pretty dangerous.
npc.iskan.stdmod_7: [EN] Nasty little beasts. Me and the boys had quite some bloody encounters with them on the ice.
npc.iskan.stdmod_8: [EN] The boys warn me in advance if a monster is around.
npc.iskan.stdmod_9: [EN] My boys did not like the guys that were travelling through our city, and I trust in their instincts. Isn't it so, boys?
npc.ivalisse.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello, worshiper of the Astral Shapers! Welcome to the temple! While you are here to pay tribute, you can also learn something about the ancient art of imbuing.
npc.ivalisse.multi_1: [EN] Thank you! He told me the other researchers in his team discovered a bridge leading to a cave with a dragon sculpture somewhere in a muggy, grassy area. ...
npc.ivalisse.multi_10: [EN] Papa- my father has recently started an adventure on his own. His name is Silus; he is a member of the Edron academy. ...
npc.ivalisse.multi_11: [EN] Ever since he joined what he called a 'special research division', he went on and on about Zao and how venturing there would help him get ahead. ...
npc.ivalisse.multi_12: [EN] You must know he lives for science, especially concerning faraway lands and cultures. He talked about the importance of practical field studies but, frankly, he isn't particularly cut out for that. ...
npc.ivalisse.multi_13: [EN] I know he has to focus to get his research done right now, and I simply cannot leave my duties in the temple. You seem like a person who travels a lot; would you be willing to help me?
npc.ivalisse.multi_14: [EN] The astral Shapers had many ways to shape and refine weapons and equipment. They built shrines dedicated to this world's energies, focussing it and utilising it like a tool to enhance objects. ...
npc.ivalisse.multi_15: [EN] They called this process imbuing and perfected it throughout time. Remains of these shrines are scattered all over Tibia. ...
npc.ivalisse.multi_16: [EN] If you truly want to master this art, you will need to visit the various ancient sites related to the original Shaper imbuements. There is one for each element and we know of at least one other besides these. ...
npc.ivalisse.multi_17: [EN] The discovery of the foundations of this very temple we are standing in, was the key to access their legacy. It is now the center of all our efforts in getting closer to the astral predecessors. ...
npc.ivalisse.multi_18: [EN] They found ways to connect various sites with a system of gates, all concentrating energy to allow travel to far away places. The more we learn, the more we can restore of these ancient gateways. ...
npc.ivalisse.multi_19: [EN] We see the gates as an invitation, use them to your advantage and follow the ways of the Shapers. Access to one of these ancient shrines is the only way to learn additional imbuements. ...
npc.ivalisse.multi_2: [EN] The cave is said to lead to a temple complex underground which is ued as a gathering place for a race called 'draken'. He left right away and tried to enter Zao on his own. ...
npc.ivalisse.multi_20: [EN] But beware, as far as we know, some of them have been claimed by other ancient beings and there is now way for us to prepare you what lies beyond any of those gates.
npc.ivalisse.multi_3: [EN] I was even more worried when he explained the route he chose. he wanted to head straight through a giant steppe and through a massive mountainous ridge to reach the grassy plains of lower Zao. ...
npc.ivalisse.multi_4: [EN] If you're interested: I know that the Shapers where active in all corners of Tibia. If you happen to find Shaper ruins there, you may even be able to gather some of their lost knowledge. ...
npc.ivalisse.multi_5: [EN] I may have been a bit stubborn and angry the day he left, I even refused to say farewell. And now I worry if he is safe. ...
npc.ivalisse.multi_6: [EN] I can not do much to help you but I can open a portal to get you quite close to his last known location in Zao. What do you say, will you help me find my father?
npc.ivalisse.multi_7: [EN] What? You're telling me you found father? How is he? What did papa say? A chalice? As a disguise? The whole time? ...
npc.ivalisse.multi_8: [EN] Well, I am not as much surprised as I am happy to hear that he's alright. You know, after the incident with the duck and the umbrella—it doesn't get to me that easily anymore. ...
npc.ivalisse.multi_9: [EN] Thank you very much for doing all this for me; I will be forever grateful. I have nothing to repay you with, but you are already blessed to have been able to lay eyes on the sacred Shaper ruins.
npc.ivalisse.say_1: [EN] Well, I hope you like it here. We tried to rebuild in the {Shaper}'s will. I am a bit preoccupied at the moment because of the absence of my {father}. I may not be the best of help currently, sorry.
npc.ivalisse.say_2: [EN] Besides my various {duties} in the temple, I also take care of visitors. Well, I would but right now I can't get my mind of how my {father}'s doing. I am sorry.
npc.ivalisse.say_3: [EN] Well, I hope you like it here. We tried to rebuild in the Shaper's will. I am a bit preoccupied at the moment because of the absence of my father. I may not be the best of help currently, sorry.
npc.ivalisse.say_4: [EN] You would? That's great! Thank you! If you can find my father, tell him I understand and that I really miss him!
npc.ivalisse.say_5: [EN] Oh nevermind, I am sorry I asked you for this.
npc.ivalisse.stdmod_1: [EN] My {father}, can you tell me if he's alright?
npc.ivalisse.stdmod_2: [EN] Alright then, you are very welcome to explore the temple!
npc.ivalisse.stdmod_4: [EN] There is always time to make a change.
npc.ivalisse.stdmod_5: [EN] Besides my various {duties} in the temple, I also take care of visitors. Well, I would but right now I can't get my mind of how my {father}'s doing. I am sorry.
npc.ivalisse.stdmod_6: [EN]  I help linking the portals of this temple to other ancient sites of the {Astral Shapers}.
npc.ivalisse.stdmod_7: [EN]  I help linking the portals of this temple to other ancient sites of the {Astral Shapers}.
npc.iwan.greet_msg_1: [EN] Feel welcome to my gem store, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.iwan.voice_1: [EN] Gems of all kinds! Precious jewellery!
npc.iwar.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hiho Storm Killer! Welcome to Kazordoon furniture store.
npc.iwar.say_1: [EN] Nice. You like your picture, haa? Give me 10,000 gold and I will deliver it to the museum. Do you {pay}?
npc.iwar.say_2: [EN] Well done. The picture will be delivered to the museum as last as possible.
npc.iwar.say_3: Du har inte tillräckligt med pengar.
npc.iyad.farewell_msg_1: [EN] D...Daraman's blessings... oh, how I m...miss my warm Darashia...
npc.iyad.greet_msg_1: [EN] Finally! A c...c...customer! Wh... where do you want to f...f...{fly}?
npc.iyad.stdmod_1: [EN] A... aargh. I wish I had some e... earmuffs to put over this useless t... turban.
npc.iyad.stdmod_10: [EN] I can fly you to {Darashia}, to {Edron}, to {Kazordoon}, to Z... Zao, to the F...{Femor Hills}, to {Issavi} or to M... {Marapur} if you like. W....Where do you want to go?
npc.iyad.stdmod_11: [EN] I can fly you to {Darashia}, to {Edron}, to {Kazordoon}, to Z... Zao, to the F...{Femor Hills}, to {Issavi} or to M... {Marapur} if you like. W....Where do you want to go?
npc.iyad.stdmod_12: [EN] I'm k...known as Iyad Ibn Abdul.
npc.iyad.stdmod_13: [EN] The thought of s...some mad sorcerer unleashing some f...fire magic is very tempting.
npc.iyad.stdmod_14: [EN] S...so close and s...still that far away.
npc.iyad.stdmod_15: [EN] For all its m...mistakes, Thais is warm at least.
npc.iyad.stdmod_16: [EN] I can fly you to {Darashia}, to {Edron}, to {Kazordoon}, to Z... Zao, to the F...{Femor Hills}, to {Issavi} or to M... {Marapur} if you like. W....Where do you want to go?
npc.iyad.stdmod_17: [EN] I would t...trade it for some firewood.
npc.iyad.stdmod_18: [EN] This h...here is no continent. This is h...hell.
npc.iyad.stdmod_19: [EN] Even D...Drefia can't be worse than this land.
npc.iyad.stdmod_20: [EN] I d...don't care about any n...news unless it's the announcement of a h....heatwave.
npc.iyad.stdmod_3: Aldrig hört talas om en plats som denna.
npc.iyad.stdmod_7: [EN] I'm a licensed c...carpet pilot. I can {transport} you t...to a warm p...place.
npc.iyad.stdmod_8: [EN] I t...{transport} travellers to the continent of Darama for a small fee. It's w...warm there.
npc.iyad.stdmod_9: [EN] I can fly you to {Darashia}, to {Edron}, to {Kazordoon}, to Z... Zao, to the F...{Femor Hills}, to {Issavi} or to M... {Marapur} if you like. W....Where do you want to go?
npc.iyad.voice_1: [EN] A... aargh. I wish I had some e... earmuffs to put over this useless t... turban.
npc.iyad.voice_2: [EN] Oh p.. please. P... lease let me fly us out of this c... cold.
npc.izsh.multi_1: [EN] Fine, zo let'z prozeed. You uzed forged documentz to enter our zity, killed zeveral guardz who enjoyed a quite excluzive and expenzive training, deztroyed rare magical devizez in ze pozzezzion of ze emperor. ...
npc.izsh.multi_10: [EN] Ze rednezz of your faze and ze zound you make wiz your teez iz obviouzly a zign of gratitude of your zpeziez! I am flattered, but pleaze leave now az I have to attend to zome important buzinezz.
npc.izsh.multi_2: [EN] Ze good newz iz, your zree cheztz of platinum should be nearly enough to pay ze finez. Lucky you, ziz could have left you broke. ...
npc.izsh.multi_3: [EN] Zere are alzo zertain noble familiez complaining about ze murder of zeveral of zeir beloved onez. ...
npc.izsh.multi_4: [EN] I zink I can make a deal wiz ze noblez by zelling zem your property in ze zity. Your prezenze would ruin ze houze prizez zere anyway. ...
npc.izsh.multi_5: [EN] Of courze zat will not zuffize to compenzate zeir grief, zo I guezz you'll have to part wiz zat elite armor, too. Zadly, prizez for armor are on an all time low right now. ...
npc.izsh.multi_6: [EN] But luckily you ztill have zat mana cazket. Well, you had it. Now we have to zell it. ...
npc.izsh.multi_7: [EN] But not all iz lozt my blank-zkinned vizitor. According to my calculationz, zere iz ztill a bit left. ...
npc.izsh.multi_8: [EN] I zink we can zave you zome gold and zome treazurez, and you can keep one pieze of your elite armor at leazt. ...
npc.izsh.multi_9: [EN] You will find your rewardz in one of ze old zupply zellarz. Beware of ze ratz zough. ...
npc.izsh.say_1: [EN] Oh yez, let me zee ze documentz. Here we go: zree cheztz filled wiz platinum, one houze, a zet of elite armor, and an unending mana cazket. Iz ziz correct?
npc.jack.greet_msg_1: [EN] You!! What have you told my family? They are mad at me and I don't even know why! They think I lied to them about working in Edron in secrecy! Why should I even do that!
npc.jack.greet_msg_2: [EN] So, you've returned to Spectulus? What did he say, is anything wrong? You have this strange expression on your face - is there anything wrong? You DID tell me the truth here, didn't you?
npc.jack.greet_msg_3: [EN] Yes? What can I do for you? I hope this won't take long, though.
npc.jack.greet_msg_4: [EN] What did you do to my SCULPTURE? You simply DESTROYED it? Why? You... you ruined everything... my house, my hobby, my life. My family even refuses to talk to me anymore. ...
npc.jack.greet_msg_5: [EN] Alright, alright you win. I am done for. You... you must be right, yes. Yes, I was working as an intern... in the academy in Edron... yes... Just... tell this Spectulus guy I want to see him. I have nothing left. I am ready.
npc.jack.multi_1: [EN] Ah, also a keen lover of arts I assume? You might have already caught a glimpse of that humble masterpiece over there in the corner - I sculpt sulky sculptures! ...
npc.jack.multi_2: [EN] Sculpting sculptures was my passion since childhood... ...and it was there at my first sandcastle when... ...and it formed... ...and it developed into... ...years of enduring sculpting... ...carved of something like... ...sulky... ...
npc.jack.multi_3: [EN] And that's what I like to do to this very day - hey, hey will you wake up? Were you even listening to me?
npc.jack.multi_4: [EN] I see. Well for starters, I think you're crazy. If I would have 'travelled' in some kind of - device? - that thing should be around here somewhere, or not? ...
npc.jack.multi_5: [EN] What? 'Dimensional fold?' Well, thanks for the information and please close the door behind you when you leave my house. Now.
npc.jack.multi_6: [EN] Oh hm, I've got a handkerchief here somewhere - ah, oh no it's already used, I'm sorry. So, you say that's a real person? Spectulus? I mean - what kind of weirdo thinks of a name like that anyway. ...
npc.jack.multi_7: [EN] And he does what? Hm. Here in Edron? I see. And I was - what? No way. Where? What! Why? And you say you are telling the truth?
npc.jack.multi_8: [EN] So... so this wasn't EVEN REAL? You brought all this ugly furniture here, you destroyed my sculpture... and on top of that you actually CONVINCED mother and my sister!? How can I possibly explain all that? ...
npc.jack.multi_9: [EN] I... I... Well, at least you told me the truth. I don't know if I can accept this as an excuse but it's a start. Now let me return to my work, I need to fix this statue and then the rest of this... mess.
npc.jack.say_1: [EN] So it's that name again. You are really determined, aren't you. ...
npc.jack.say_2: [EN] So if he thinks I'm someone he knew who is now 'lost' and needs to come back or whatever - tell him he is WRONG. I always lived here with my mother and sister, I'm happy here and I certainly don't want to go to that academy of yours.
npc.jack.say_3: [EN] WHAT?? No way, I ask you again - you DID tell me the TRUTH here... right?
npc.jack.say_5: [EN] Yeah, yeah... so what are you still doing here? I guess I... will have to seek out this Spectulus now, see what he has to say. There is nothing left for me in this place.
npc.jack.say_6: [EN] I... was... sculpting sulky sculptures. For all my life. Until you came in here and DESTROYED MY MASTERPIECE. Go away. I don't like you.
npc.jack.voice_1: [EN] Now I need to clean up everything again.
npc.jack.voice_2: [EN] So much to do, so little time, they say...
npc.jack.voice_3: [EN] Could it be...? No. No way.
npc.jack_drone.farewell_msg_1: Hej då. Rekommendera oss om du är nöjd med vår tjänst.
npc.jack_drone.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today? I can travel you back to {thais}.
npc.jack_drone.stdmod_1: [EN] Do you seek a passage back to thais?
npc.jack_drone.stdmod_2: Vi skulle vilja tjäna dig lite tid.
npc.jack_fate.farewell_msg_1: Hej då. Rekommendera oss om du är nöjd med vår tjänst.
npc.jack_fate.stdmod_1: [EN] Passages to Edron, Thais, Venore, Darashia, Ankrahmun, Yalahar and Port Hope.
npc.jack_fate.stdmod_10: [EN] Where do you want to go? To {Edron}, {Thais}, {Venore}, {Darashia}, {Ankrahmun}, {Yalahar} or {Port Hope}?
npc.jack_fate.stdmod_11: [EN] My name is Jack Fate from the Royal Tibia Line.
npc.jack_fate.stdmod_12: [EN] I'm the captain of this sailing ship.
npc.jack_fate.stdmod_13: [EN] I'm the captain of this sailing ship.
npc.jack_fate.stdmod_2: Jag är ledsen men jag seglar inte dit.
npc.jack_fate.stdmod_3: Aldrig hört talas om en plats som denna.
npc.jack_fate.stdmod_4: Vi skulle vilja tjäna dig lite tid.
npc.jack_fate.stdmod_5: [EN] Do you seek a passage to Thais for |TRAVELCOST|?
npc.jack_fate.stdmod_6: [EN] I have to warn you - we might get into a tropical storm on that route. I'm not sure if my ship will withstand it. Do you really want to travel to Thais?
npc.jack_fate.stdmod_7: Vi skulle vilja tjäna dig lite tid.
npc.jack_fate.stdmod_8: Vi skulle vilja tjäna dig lite tid.
npc.jack_fate.stdmod_9: [EN] Where do you want to go? To {Edron}, {Thais}, {Venore}, {Darashia}, {Ankrahmun}, {Yalahar} or {Port Hope}?
npc.jack_fate.voice_1: [EN] Passages to Edron, Thais, Venore, Darashia, Ankrahmun, Yalahar and Port Hope.
npc.jack_fate_goroma.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello, Sir |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?
npc.jack_fate_goroma.multi_1: [EN] Thank you. Luckily the damage my ship has taken looks more severe than it is, so I will only need a few wooden boards. ...
npc.jack_fate_goroma.multi_2: [EN] I saw some lousy trolls running away with some parts of the ship. It might be a good idea to follow them and check if they have some more wood. ...
npc.jack_fate_goroma.multi_3: [EN] We will need 30 pieces of wood, no more, no less. Did you understand everything?
npc.jack_fate_goroma.say_1: [EN] I'd love to bring you back to Liberty Bay, but as you can see, my ship is ruined. I also hurt my leg and can barely move. Can you help me?
npc.jack_fate_goroma.say_2: [EN] Have you brought 30 pieces of wood so that I can repair the ship?
npc.jack_fate_goroma.say_3: [EN] Do you want to travel back to Liberty Bay?
npc.jack_fate_goroma.say_4: [EN] Good! Please return once you have gathered 30 pieces of wood.
npc.jack_fate_goroma.say_5: [EN] Excellent! Now we can leave this godforsaken place. Thank you for your help. Should you ever want to return to this island, ask me for a passage to Goroma.
npc.jack_fate_goroma.stdmod_1: [EN] My name is Jack Fate from the Royal Tibia Line.
npc.jack_fate_goroma.stdmod_2: [EN] I'm the captain of this - well, wreck. Argh.
npc.jack_fate_goroma.stdmod_3: [EN] I'm the captain of this - well, wreck. Argh
npc.jack_fate_goroma.stdmod_4: [EN] This is where we are... the volcano island Goroma. There are many rumours about this place.
npc.jack_springer.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! There is much we have to {discuss}.
npc.jack_springer.greet_msg_2: [EN] Hello, stranger! You look suspicious to me. I don't think we have anything to discuss.
npc.jack_springer.greet_msg_4: [EN] Hello, stranger! Sorry, but I never heard about you. I'm looking for more experienced help.
npc.jack_springer.multi_1: [EN] You have to travel to the isle of the kings. There, hidden beneath the isle of the kings is the shamefully hidden grave of king Zelos. It is him, they are trying to raise. ...
npc.jack_springer.multi_10: [EN] Don't forget that you'll need very potent holy water for your task. If you need some, just ask me for a {trade}.
npc.jack_springer.multi_11: [EN] Don't forget that you'll need very potent holy water for your task. If you need some, just ask me for a {trade}.
npc.jack_springer.multi_12: [EN] Don't forget that you'll need very potent holy water for your task. If you need some, just ask me for a {trade}.
npc.jack_springer.multi_2: [EN] With some luck you will arrive before the ritual's completion. But be warned. At least four risen lich-knights will be present, to raise 'their king'. ...
npc.jack_springer.multi_3: [EN] Hopefully the ritual will bind some of their powers but they will still be formidable foes. You will have to act quick because with each moment you take to defeat the knights ...
npc.jack_springer.multi_4: [EN] The ritual will progress and the king will become stronger up to a point where you might be unable to defeat him. Due to the efforts and sacrifices of the death cultists, the king will be active at some capacity and you will have to confront him. ...
npc.jack_springer.multi_5: [EN] Remember, the further the ritual progresses when you face him, he will become considerably more powerful. So time is of the essence. ...
npc.jack_springer.multi_6: [EN] All I can do right now is to wish you good luck and may the gods bless you.
npc.jack_springer.multi_7: [EN] It became obvious that their goal is to raise an ancient and fallen king, to lead their lich-knights and raise even more of them. ...
npc.jack_springer.multi_8: [EN]  With each lich-knight being able to raise and control lesser undead, this would lead to a chain-reaction. If they succeed, we might face an undead {threat} not seen since the corpse wars.
npc.jack_springer.multi_9: [EN] Don't forget that you'll need very potent holy water for your task. If you need some, just ask me for a {trade}.
npc.jack_springer.say_1: [EN] By now the cultists of the Shiron'Fal seem to have abandoned their search. But this is sadly no good news. It seems they gathered enough lich-knights to proceed with their {ultimate} plan.
npc.jack_springer.say_2: [EN] Sadly, I have no news yet. But I can give you information about the {locations} of the graves that we learned about. If you need more holy water just ask me for a {trade}.
npc.jack_springer.say_3: [EN] Here is your second addon for your efforts!
npc.jack_springer.say_4: [EN] Here is your first addon for your efforts!
npc.jack_springer.say_5: [EN] Incredible! You averted a crisis that would have utterly crippled our defences aganist any other threat that is arising. Let me grant you the honor to be one of the hands of the inquisition alongside with the according outfit as a reward.
npc.jack_springer.say_6: [EN] Indeed you averted us a great danger! We will ever be greatful to you hand of the inquisition!
npc.jack_springer.say_7: [EN] You need to travel to the isle of the kings and end this threat before they raise king Zelos!
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_10: [EN] Here is where you come into play. We could identify the most recent plot of the Shiron'Fal and already had some {clashes}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_11: [EN] In our efforts to hinder their plot, we achieved mixed results at best. But now things are escalating fast and we have to {hurry}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_12: [EN] Our resources are already stretched thin, so we need your help with the most recent {problem}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_13: [EN] The legion tries to use a new form of twisted rituals to raise the bodies of well-known {knights}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_14: [EN] These powerful undead were a terrible threat on their own but it seems even they are just part of some larger {scheme} that we cannot make out yet.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_15: [EN] We are still working feverishly to uncover their goals but for now more imminent {threats} are at hand.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_18:
[EN] For this purpose, the members gather knowledge, artefacts and powerful individuals. The members are formidable at certain fields of expertise. They are cunning and powerful and act with no regard for others, with no remorse or mercy. ... \z
	As they are doing this since ages, they must have acquired tremendous powers and knowledge. Their members often operate alone but are usually well funded with the necessary resources. ... \z
	Whatever their endgame might be, each of their operations pose a grave danger to the whole world and have to be {stopped}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_19:
[EN] Reaching the graves will not be without danger and if you encounter the death cultists you will have to fight them. Even worse, they might have even succeeded in some cases. ... \z
	As a newly risen lich-knight is not able to leave the site of its resurrection for some time, you might have to fight some of them. ... \z
	Let us pray that you never come too {late} or else some of the fiends might be able to leave their crypts.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_2: [EN] I need your help in a matter of utmost {urgency}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_20:
[EN] We have located twelve graves that have to be secured: In the old northern Edron graveyard, in the dark cathedral of the plains of havoc, in the ghostlands, on Cormaya, Somewhere in the Femor Hills, on Vengoth, ... \z
	in the graveyard of Darashia, in the old temple north of Thais, at the entrance to the orcland, one is on the southern ice islands, in a mountain on Kilmaresh, one on an island north-east of Ankrahmun.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_21:
[EN] Well, in Rathleton there was an individual at work, looking for some ancient artefact of power. ... \z
	To cover its escape the creature left another creature, known as the ravager to cover his tracks. But there is {more}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_22:
[EN] Only recently someone was trying to manipulate the elven dream courts into releasing a monstrosity of nightmares, probably planning to control or recruit this creature. .... \z
	But those incidents were just some of {many}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_23:
[EN] There is a scheming going on behind the scenes. Powerful good people were corrupted. Evil-doers got backup and resources from a hidden ally. ... \z
	Powerful malignant creatures, gathering their kind under their banner and so much more. These things are not happening by chance. There is a pattern, a guiding {hand}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_24:
[EN] It has a rather complex meaning and as far as we can tell it translates to 'army of those who are many, dedicated to the ultimate time of mayhem and despair'. ... \z
	Other, more handy names are army of the last battlefield, army of the last days, legion of mayhem, dread legion or simply the {legion}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_25:
[EN] We know little for sure. You can look into our books to see some of our sources. But most are vague and some even contradictory. ... \z
	To summarise what we know, let me tell you this: The Shiron'Fal is an extremely old organisation. It seeks to accumulate power for some unknown but certainly sinister {goal}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_26:
[EN] The knights they aim at were tainted in life by their actions or happenstance. ... \z
	This leaves their bodies vulnerable to their special breed of necromancy that would raise them as powerful {lich}-knights.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_3: [EN] I need your help in a matter of utmost {urgency}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_4: [EN] The situation is complicated and it's even hard to say where to {start} best, just to describe it to you.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_5: [EN] You see, several incidents in history can be traced back to a single {source}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_6: [EN] Things get murkier the further you go down in history, but that's not even necessary. Even today we can discern a certain pattern in recent {events}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_7: [EN] The recent rise of lycanthropy, the robbery of certain forbidden arcane texts and the vanishing of at least three dangerous individuals, targeted by the inquisition are just the tip of the {iceberg}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_8: [EN] This outside force is moving behind the scenes since ages. Our research suggests that this force probably even {predates} the rise of humanity.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_9: [EN] Well, we are sure that the puppeteer behind all these events is an organisation. So old that even its name, the Shiron'Fal, has lost its meaning, because the {language} it originates from is long dead.
npc.jacob.multi_1: En offerplats? Fan, låter som någon galen kult eller något. Bara bra. Och den här gamla strukturen du pratade om som inte är en del av avloppen? Du borde se lokalhistorikern om det, man. ...
npc.jacob.multi_2: Han kan förstå vad du hittade där. Han heter Barazbaz. Han borde vara i magistratsbyggnaden.
npc.jacob.multi_3: Wow, du har redan gjort det, det går snabbt. Jag är van vid en mer avslappnad attityd från de flesta. Det är synd att riskera att förlora dig till några kollapsande tunnlar, men en affär är en affär. ...
npc.jacob.multi_4: Jag ger dig härmed tillstånd att gå in i den övergivna delen av avloppen. Ta hand om dig, man! ...
npc.jacob.multi_5: Om du hittar något intressant, kom tillbaka för att prata om {abandoned sewers}.
npc.jacob.multi_6: Vill du komma in i de övergivna avloppen? Det är ganska farligt och ingen bra idé. Den delen av avloppen var inte förseglad för ingenting, vet du? ...
npc.jacob.multi_7: Men hej, det är ditt liv, bror. Så här är affären. Jag släpper in dig i de övergivna avloppen om du hjälper mig med vår {mission}.
npc.jacob.say_1: Jag är glad att se dig tillbaka levande och frisk. Hittade du något intressant som du vill {report}?
npc.jacob.say_2: Avloppen behöver repareras. Är du med?
npc.jacob.say_3: Elliotts fortsätter att kalla det så. Det är bara ett annat jobb! Har du fixat några trasiga rör och sånt? Låt mig kolla, {ok}?
npc.jacob.say_4: [EN] If you want to redo this task just say {abandoned sewers} to repeat it.
npc.jacob.say_5: Bra. Trasiga rör och generatorbitar, det är rök som tränger undan. Det är så man känner igen dem. Se hur du kan fixa dem med händerna. Behöver ungefär, åh, åtminstone tjugo av dem repareras. Rapportera till mig eller Jacob
npc.jacob.say_6: [EN] Good. Thanks, man. That's one vote you got for helping us with this.
npc.jacob.say_7: Du har redan rapporterat detta uppdrag, gå till nästa.
npc.jakahr.farewell_msg_1: [EN] It was an honour to serve you, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.jakahr.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello, mourned pilgrim. How may I help you |PLAYERNAME|?
npc.jakahr.sendtrade_msg_1: Här. Glöm inte att du måste köpa en etikett också om du vill skicka ett paket. Skriv alltid namnet på {receiver} på första raden.
npc.jakahr.walkaway_msg_1: [EN] It was an honour to serve you.
npc.jamesfrancis.greet_msg_1: [EN] Gerimor is right. As an expert for minotaurs I am researching these creatures for years. I thought I already knew a lot but the monsters in this cave are {different}. It's a big {mystery}.
npc.jamesfrancis.greet_msg_3: [EN] You say the minotaurs were controlled by a very powerful boss they worshipped. This explains why they had so much more power than the normal ones. ...
npc.jamesfrancis.greet_msg_4: [EN] I'm very thankful. Please go to the Druid of Crunor and tell him what you've seen. He might be interested in that.
npc.jamesfrancis.say_1: [EN] The minotaurs I faced in the cave are much stronger than the normal ones. What I were able to see before I had to flee: all of them seem to belong to a cult worshipping their god. Could you do me a {favour}?
npc.jamesfrancis.say_2: [EN] I'd like to work in this cave researching the minotaurs. But right now there are too many of hem and what is more, they are too powerful for me. Could you enter the cave and kill at least 50 of these creatures?
npc.jamesfrancis.say_3: [EN] Great job! You have killed at least 50 of these monsters. I give this key to you to open the door to the inner area. Go there and find out what's going on.
npc.jamesfrancis.say_4: [EN] Come back when you have killed enough minotaurs.
npc.jamesfrancis.say_5: [EN] Very nice. Return to me if you've finished your job.
npc.jamesfrancis.voice_1: [EN] Don't enter this area if you are an inexperienced fighter! It would be your end!
npc.jean_pierre.greet_msg_1: [EN] Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|. What are you doing out here?
npc.jean_pierre.multi_1: [EN] Time to have a sweet drink! Let's pour the bug milk into my cauldron and heat it over fire until it's boiling... <starts slicing mangoes in the meantime> there! ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_10: [EN] Now, carefully, we add the demonic blood... <and time seems to stand still as seemingly for the first time ever he does something slowly, pouring a single drop of concentrated demonic blood onto each ball> ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_100: [EN] One fresh dead bat, three jalapeño peppers, five brown breads, two eggs, one powder herb and five red mushrooms.
npc.jean_pierre.multi_101: [EN] One fresh dead bat, three jalapeño peppers, five brown breads, two eggs, one powder herb and five red mushrooms.
npc.jean_pierre.multi_102: [EN] We'll add some other vegetables and spices for the delicate and distinctive taste. Bring me the following ingredients and I'll show you how it's done. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_103: [EN] Two hydra tongue plants, two tomatoes, one cucumber, two eggs, one troll green and one vial of wine.
npc.jean_pierre.multi_104: [EN] Two hydra tongue plants, two tomatoes, one cucumber, two eggs, one troll green and one vial of wine.
npc.jean_pierre.multi_105: [EN] The name is just for the effect it has on people. <winks> Bring me the following ingredients and I'll show you how it's done. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_106: [EN] Two pieces of meat, two vials of beer, twenty potatoes, one onion, one bulb of garlic and five ounces of flour. Make sure that the ingredients are fresh and smell good.
npc.jean_pierre.multi_107: [EN] Two pieces of meat, two vials of beer, twenty potatoes, one onion, one bulb of garlic and five ounces of flour. Make sure that the ingredients are fresh and smell good.
npc.jean_pierre.multi_11: [EN] Here you go, but beware possible side effects! You never know for sure what will happen and so far all of those I tried had awesome effects, so of course I don't hope for nasty surprises! Enjoy!
npc.jean_pierre.multi_12: [EN] Awesome! Let's go! Let's start with preparing the sandcrawlers <starts boiling water on a stove and tosses the sandcrawler shells in there> ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_13: [EN] I understand your scepticism, but believe me, all will be well! As you can see, they change colour from dark to light red, and that's when they also start turning soft. <stirs with one hand while he slices carrots and peppers with the other hand> ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_14: [EN] Now add whole potatoes and let everything cook at high temperature until the potatoes are so soft they're basically falling apart. <mashes really fast, creating something of a dark brownish colour that doesn't really look tasty> ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_15: [EN] Yes yes, I know, don't give me that look! You'll be surprised! Now just add the chopped carrots and chili for a healthy portion of vitamins and spices, keep stiring and mashing and let it simmer for about an hour. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_16: [EN] You're wondering why I chose a simple recipe like that for my famous menu? You'll know when you taste it! ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_17: [EN] Heeeeeere you are - just a few spoons of this great stew make you so full that the bowl I give you will last for a long time until it's finally depleted. Enjoy!
npc.jean_pierre.multi_18: [EN] Yum! Just the thought of it makes me drool. <tosses the shrimps into a bowl and soaks them in coconut milk as he goes on chopping all mushrooms in the blink of an eye> ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_19: [EN] I see you brought real Zaoan rice balls! That saves us a lot of time as we don't have to cook the rice anymore. Now we just flatten them out nice and medium thick on this baking tray. <squeezes and smoothes the rice piles with his fingers> ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_2: [EN] Now we're breaking all of the eggs into there - 1, 2, 10, 20, 40 <ticktickcrack> crumble the honeycombs and toss the sliced mangoes into the hot mix. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_20: [EN] In the meantime, our shrimps have absorbed some of the coconut milk and we can now add them on top of the rice. <spreads them evenly across the rice and pours the coconut milk from the bowl over the rice> ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_21: [EN] Now we just need to add the mushrooms <tosses them all over the tray>, pour the rest of the coconut milk over it and put it into the oven! ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_23: [EN] Aaaaaaand there you go! Sweet coconut goodness! And psst - the shrimps add some submarine flavour to this dish. You should definitely eat it while walking underwater and wearing a helmet of the deep. Just in case. Enjoy!
npc.jean_pierre.multi_24: [EN] So, now for our final dish - a grand dessert from the amazon girls at Carlin! <grates carrots during his explanations> ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_25: [EN] It's easy as it can be - mix a normal cake dough with milk, flour and eggs, then add some cookie crumbs for the crunchy effect later on. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_26: [EN] Stir in the grated carrots and tiny peanut pieces and bake it for about thirty minutes! Now we'll make a great topping with sugar and lemon juice, pour it over the cake and decorate it. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_27: [EN] And voilà, we're done! The girls of Carlin swear that it sharpens their eyesight, at least for a while. I'm sure it will somehow aid you in your battles. Enjoy! ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_28: [EN] Oh, which reminds me - my little apprentice, we are finished with our cooking course. I think you did great and if it was my decision, you could open your own tavern. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_29: [EN] But anyway, it's up to you what you make of your newly discovered skills! In case you forget my recipes, please feel free to take a copy of the cookbook upstairs. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_3: [EN] Now we just have to let it simmer and stir using a blessed wooden stake <stirs so vigorously that you can barely see his arms anymore> for thirty minutes. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_30: [EN] You can drop by and practice cooking those dishes, at least during the time that I'm at home. I promise that I will cook each dish once with you, but then I have to take care of my other apprentices. Cheers to you!
npc.jean_pierre.multi_31: [EN] Great! After all this meat, we shouldn't neglect to prepare some fish. <carefully removes heads, tails and bones from the fishes and peels shrimps at incredible speed> ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_32: [EN] Simply cut the rolls in half, shortly fry one slice of each fish type, put in the shrimps and spice up with grinded fern, which, by the way, tastes slightly like dill. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_33: [EN] Nicely decorate it on a plate, and voilà, we're done already! Can't tell you much about the effects, but fishermen in Svargrond seem to love it. Enjoy!
npc.jean_pierre.multi_34: [EN] Nicely decorate it on a plate, and voilà, we're done already! Can't tell you much about the effects, but fishermen in Svargrond seem to love it. Enjoy!
npc.jean_pierre.multi_35: [EN] Here we go! <pounds with his bare hands on the steak> This will break through the meat fibres, making our steak more tender for this fine Daramanian dish. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_36: [EN] It's easy to prepare, just chop and sweat the onions and add small pieces of pumpkin, beetroot, plums and peppers. Put the steak into the pan too to let it absorb some of the sweet and fruity flavour. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_37: [EN] Finally, remove the fruits and onions from the pan and fry the steak from both sides until it's crisp and crusty. Put on a plate and decorate with the fruit mix. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_38: [EN] The people of Darashia say that it has magical abilities and will help you if you feel totally drained. Enjoy!
npc.jean_pierre.multi_39: [EN] Okay! So after all of these heavy dishes, we're going to create a fast little snack. <starts preparing the peppers as he speaks> ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_4: [EN] By now, the power of the blessed wooden stake will have been transferred into our elixir, so let's put out the fire and let it cool down. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_40: [EN] First of all, remove the top of the jalapeño peppers and clean their inside, so that you have space for the filling. Now for the filling, we grate the cheese and mix it with the mead and the eggs, until it has a nice consistency. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_41: [EN] We add the grinded herbs and blend it well. Push a spoonful in each jalapeño pepper until they are nicely stuffed. Now, we shortly fry the jalapeño peppers in a pan to heat them up. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_42: [EN] The filling will melt nicely, just be careful that it doesn't drip out! And voilà, we're done! ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_43: [EN] This famous dish from Ankrahmun is quite hot and spicy, so only eat one at a time. It's also possible that you get the urge to run really fast afterwards. Enjoy!
npc.jean_pierre.multi_44: [EN] So let's start! <rubs hands together and chops the vegetables> This is a dish especially famous in the area around Ab'Dendriel! Chop the onions into little cubes and sweat them in a pan until they are glassy. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_45: [EN] Add garlic and mushrooms and fry gently until the mushrooms have shrunk up. Now, we add the peeled tomatoes and corn and have it all nicely cook together. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_46: [EN] Put in carrot pieces and cucumber at the very end, so they will stay crisp! Finally put the cheese over it like a little blanket have it melt on the oven until it's slightly brownish. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_47: [EN] And voilà, we're done! This dish will help you in your battles and supply you with enough power to hit really hard! Enjoy!
npc.jean_pierre.multi_48: [EN] Great! Let's get it done! <mixes and shakes faster than any human could> An easy one again, but you'll get right into holiday mood, like the Meriana beach dwellers I got that recipe from. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_49: [EN] Melt the chocolate in a hot-water bath and add the grinded herbs - did you know, those herbs have a flavour like cinnamon and vanilla, yummy! Keep at gentle heat and add the milk. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_5: [EN] <carefully pours the cooled elixir into a small bottle or glass> There! Its inventor said it had amazing effects on the ring you're wearing, as long as the ring is based on time, not on charges. Enjoy! ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_50: [EN] Mash the banana and stir it really well into the chocolate-milk mixture. Gosh, do you smell that? Pure goodness! Now finally, we take just a bit of the creamcake and fold it in. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_51: [EN] Voilà, we're done! To be honest, I don't know what this drink does, but at least it makes me really happy. Drink together with a loved one and enjoy!
npc.jean_pierre.multi_52: [EN] This is a recipe right from the jungles of Tiquanda! <grinds and chops during his talk> Grind the stone herb and mix it with the coconut milk, then bathe the chicken in it for a while. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_53: [EN] In the meantime, peel the oranges and mangos, chop them into pieces and add them to the mix. Take the chicken out of its bath and fry it, preferably over open fire. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_54: [EN] Take the fruits out of the spicy coconut milk and heat them on an oven. Once the chicken is fried, add the fruits and spray some squeezed lemon over it. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_55: [EN] Voilà, we're done! They say that this dish has magical abilities and can awaken secret powers in you during your battles. Enjoy!
npc.jean_pierre.multi_56: [EN] Let's get started! <starts grinding and chopping at amazing speed> The trick with this one is the crunchy crust around the wings. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_57: [EN] First, we grate the dry brown bread into very small crumbs and mix that with the two eggs. Add grinded peppers for the spicy taste and the powder herb for a hint of curry flavour. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_58: [EN] Carefully separate the bat wings, clean them of any possible hairs and coat them in our mixture. Roast them in a pan together with sliced mushrooms and serve. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_59: [EN] Voilà, we're done! This recipe is from the area around Thais and should help you protect yourself in your battles. Enjoy!
npc.jean_pierre.multi_6: [EN] And by the way... since those were all the recipes from this year and you cooked them so nicely, you may take the cookbook containing them from upstairs, if you like!
npc.jean_pierre.multi_60: [EN] Okay, here we go! <cuts the ingredients so fast that his hands seem almost blurry> This one is easy, just chop the hydra tongues, tomatoes and cucumber into tiny pieces. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_61: [EN] Now for the sauce - our base is wine, in which we mix the raw eggs until it got a nice smooth consistency. Add grinded troll green, whose flavour is quite similar to basil and shake the sauce in a mug. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_62: [EN] Pour it over the salad, and voilà, we're done! This is a Venorean recipe and very tasty. I recommend eating it when you're suffering from some kind of dangerous condition. Enjoy!
npc.jean_pierre.multi_63: [EN] Aah, so let's see! <prepares the food quickly while he explains it to you> We cook the meat in a large pot together with the chopped onion until it's separated from the bones. Now we also have a fine meat broth! ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_64: [EN] Cut the potatoes into small pieces and add them to the pot. Add some flour to thicken the stew. Finally, spice it up with some garlic and add beer for the typical dwarvish taste! ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_65: [EN] And voilà, we're done. I developed this recipe while talking to Maryza in the Jolly Axeman. She said to eat it when one's health is low. Enjoy!
npc.jean_pierre.multi_66: [EN] Did you dare eat all of your Demonic Candy Balls...? Hehehe! Well, I almost forgot one of the most essential parts for a perfect dinner. A drink! I have one for you, almost a designer drink you could say. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_67: [EN] Its inventor seems to have done some scientific research in order to achieve his desired effect, which is - charging magical rings. You have to drink it while you're wearing one for a miraculous effect! ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_68: [EN] Bring me the following ingredients and we'll get started: Fourty eggs, twenty mangos, ten honeycombs, one bottle of bug milk and one blessed wooden stake. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_69: [EN] Oh yes, I understand your worries about the eggs, but just make sure they're fresh and all should be fine for our {Sweet Mangonaise Elixir}!
npc.jean_pierre.multi_7: [EN] Very nice! I'm ready for action! <quickly grabs all the candies, candy canes and gingerbread men and crushes them with amazing speed> ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_70: [EN] Weren't you surprised by the great taste of our main dish? In case you still have some space left in your tummy, we're in for a sweet and fun dessert - but beware unwanted side effects! ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_71: [EN] It was introduced to me by a fearless knight who invented this recipe rather by accident when a bottle of demonic blood broke in his backpack and spilled its contents over his bag of candy balls. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_72: [EN] Curiously, he tried one and red steam came out of his ears - but it tasted so great that he instantly popped another one in his mouth, and then another, and another. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_73: [EN] Each one seemed to cause a different effect and he was never really sure what the next one would do. Seems safer to be careful with them and not to eat them in dangerous situations! ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_74: [EN] In any case, bring me the following ingredients and we'll make some {Demonic Candy Balls}, if you like: Three candies, three candy canes, two bars of chocolate, fifteen gingerbread men and one concentrated demonic blood.
npc.jean_pierre.multi_75: [EN] After this wonderful and tasty starter we're all set for a special dish I learnt from a brave adventurer who almost starved when he got lost in the mountains between Ankrahmun and Port Hope, or so he told me. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_76: [EN] Luckily, he was saved by nomads - can you imagine? - and they fed him a special local dish that's very cheap and easy to prepare, yet rich in vitamins and spending energy for hours. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_77: [EN] Now don't be shocked, but - they do put sandcrawlers in there. When I tried to prepare that dish at first, I was repelled by its awful appearance, but since it smelled so good I did take a sip and was pleasantly surprised of the great taste. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_78: [EN] According to the adventurer, this meal works well with any kind of vegetables or any kind of edible creepy-crawlers, depending on what the nomads get their hands on, but we'll stick to the original for now! ...

npc.jerom.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello. Sorry, but I'm not in the best {mood} today.
npc.jerom.multi_1: [EN] I'm not sure but I suppose that an evil troll lives in the mountains here! I saw him rummaging in the ruins of my house. ...
npc.jerom.multi_2: [EN] I took a closer look and found my family casket ripped open. It contained a precious necklace. If I had it back, I could sell it and start over! ...
npc.jerom.multi_3: [EN] Could you look for this mean beast, find out why he did and either get me some money ormy necklace to rebuild my business?
npc.jerom.say_1: [EN] Thank you sooo much <sniffs>. Well, you know I lost everything, but recently I found this strange rope here. I don't need it, here take it!
npc.jerom.say_2: [EN] Great! Finally, some light at the end of the tunnel! Come back and ask me for the quest when you solved this mystery!
npc.jerom.stdmod_10: [EN] I like it here, at least the town. I was warned that there are nasty creatures outside the town walls but I didn't expect anything to happen so close to town!
npc.jerom.stdmod_11: [EN] I was always good with animals. My parents had a farm, the McRonalds farm. Maybe you know it. Anyway, I had the idea that people may like to have animals as companions and so one led to another.
npc.jerom.stdmod_12: [EN] I'd go mad listening to this 'ribbit' the whole time. But each to his own!
npc.jerom.stdmod_13: [EN] I'm new here in Edron. I wanted to open up a pet shop. But now I'm ruined, uahahahaha <sniffs>.
npc.jerom.stdmod_14: [EN] I need to write a letter to the king. I'm not sure if those 2 million gold coins that Daniel Steelsoul demanded from me weren't too much.
npc.jerom.stdmod_15: [EN] I'm there from time to time, catching frogs. People like their bright colours.
npc.jerom.stdmod_16: [EN] My name is Jerom but no need to remember my name. All my belongings are destroyed and stolen. I'll be gone soon!
npc.jerom.stdmod_17: [EN] Raymond Striker offered me a contract to export parrots from Meriana but I won't need them anymore now that I'm ruined.
npc.jerom.stdmod_18: [EN] Not a very good spot to catch animals. At least no animals that pass off as pets.
npc.jerom.stdmod_19: [EN] Yesterday I would have said that I like all creatures of Tibia but TODAY my life has changed! When I catch this stinking troll!!
npc.jerom.stdmod_2: [EN] Dear gods! My precious house, DESTROYED!!
npc.jerom.stdmod_20: [EN] True, why not keep a rat as a pet! They can eat your trash, live inside your walls and you don't have to worry if one dies ! Could be a huge success....if I weren't ruined!!!!
npc.jerom.stdmod_21: [EN] That would be a mission for a hero.
npc.jerom.stdmod_22: [EN] Well, I don't see any other way than going back to my home country now.
npc.jerom.stdmod_23: [EN] Good idea! Easy to catch and once the owner has been bitten, he can't sue me anymore, hehehe!!.... but wait....I forgot....I'm ruined, uahahahaha <sniffs>.
npc.jerom.stdmod_24: [EN] I never make profit in Thais and most of the time I get robbed. I stopped visiting Thais for business some years ago.
npc.jerom.stdmod_3: [EN] Oh no!! What am I supposed to do now?!?
npc.jerom.stdmod_4: [EN] The only animal to catch there is the cobra and most people don't like to keep one as a pet.
npc.jerom.stdmod_5: [EN] Who wants such an animal as a pet?!?!
npc.jerom.stdmod_6: [EN] Those amazons denied making business with me. You know the reason?!? I tell you, the reason was that I am MALE! Ridiculous!
npc.jerom.stdmod_7: [EN] For sure, I would have offered cats!
npc.jerom.stdmod_8: [EN] He gave me the permission to open up a pet shop here. I paid him almost everything I got!
npc.jerom.stdmod_9: [EN] I made contact with Svargrond! A guy named Buddel wanted to sell me a three-headed dog. I haven't seen it yet, but imagine how much money I could make by breeding such a pet!!
npc.jerom.voice_2: [EN] Dear gods! My precious house, DESTROYED!!
npc.jerom.voice_3: [EN] Oh no!! What am I supposed to do now?!?

npc.jondrin.multi_1: [EN] A necrometer? Have you any idea how rare and expensive a necrometer is? There is no way I could justify giving a necrometer to an inexperienced adventurer. Hm, although ... if you weren't inexperienced that would be a different matter. ...
npc.jondrin.multi_2: [EN] Did you do any measuring task for Doubleday lately?
npc.jondrin.say_2: [EN] Indeed I heard you did a good job out there. <sigh> I guess that means I can hand you one of our necrometers. Handle it with care.
npc.jorge.multi_1: [EN] In this category I can offer you a Norseman doll, an abacus, a key of numerous locks, a friendship amulet, a mexcalibur sword, an orc shredder, a frozen heart, a phoenix statue, a dragon eye and a noble sword. Or: ...
npc.jorge.multi_2: [EN] A hand puppet, a music box, an encyclopedia, a Durin doll, a medusa skull, a newspaper, a bag of spices or an Exhiti imortus. ...
npc.jorge.multi_3: [EN] A mathmaster shield, a draken doll, an emblem, a crimson doll, an old radio, a bookworm doll, a golden falcon and an assassin doll. ...
npc.jorge.multi_4: [EN] A dragon goblet, a pigeon trophy, a loremaster doll and a jade amulet. ...
npc.jorge.multi_5: [EN] All listed souvenirs are at 20 silver raid tokens each. Which one of them do you want?

npc.jorge.say_2: [EN] I'm sorry, I need at least 20 silver tokens for that. Please come back when you have them.
npc.julius.greet_msg_1: [EN] Be greeted, adventurer |PLAYERNAME|. I assume you have read the {note} about the {vampire} threat in this city.
npc.julius.greet_msg_2: [EN] Be greeted, adventurer |PLAYERNAME|. Please excuse me if I appear {distracted}!
npc.julius.multi_1: [EN] Here is the map. When you are standing near a remarkable spot, use it to mark that spot on the map. Don't forget, come back with at least five marks! ...
npc.julius.multi_10: [EN] You know, I came to think that the spell didn't work because there is another, greater power behind all of this. I fear that if we don't find the source of the vampire threat we can't defeat them. ...
npc.julius.multi_11: [EN] I heard that there is an island not far from here. Unholy and fearsome things are said to happen there, and maybe that means vampires are not far away. ...
npc.julius.multi_12: [EN] I want you to try and convince someone with a boat to bring you to this island, Vengoth. I'll give you an empty map. Please map the area for me and pay special attention to unusual spots. ...
npc.julius.multi_13: [EN] Mark them on my map and come back once you have found at least five remarkable places on Vengoth. Can you do that for me?
npc.julius.multi_14: [EN] Listen, I thought of something. If we could somehow figure out who among those five is their leader and manage to defeat him,the others might give up too. ...
npc.julius.multi_15: [EN] Without their leader they will at least be much weaker. Before I explain my plan, do you think you could do that?
npc.julius.multi_2: [EN] Also, they say there is a castle on this island. That mark HAS to be included, it's far too important to leave it out. Good luck!
npc.julius.multi_3: [EN] Great, now here's my plan. As I said, my strength lies not on the battlefield, but it's theory and knowledge. While you were distributing cookies I developed a spell. ...
npc.julius.multi_4: [EN] This spell is designed to reveal the identity of the master vampire and force him to show his true face. It is even likely that it instantly defeats him. ...
npc.julius.multi_5: [EN] I want you to go to the five vampires you detected and try out the magic formula on them. One of them - the oldest and most powerful - will react to it, I'm sure of it. The words are: '{Alori Mort}'. Please repeat them.
npc.julius.multi_6: [EN] As I already told you, anyone in this city could really be a vampire, even the most unsuspicious citizen. I want you to find that brood. ...
npc.julius.multi_7: [EN] You can possibly identify the vampires by using a trick with hidden garlic, but better put it into something unsuspicious, like... cookies maybe! ...
npc.julius.multi_8: [EN] Just bake a few by using holy water on flour, then use that holy water dough on garlic, use the garlic dough on a baking tray and finally place the tray on an oven. Then just play little girl scout and distribute some cookies to the citizens. ...
npc.julius.multi_9: [EN] Watch their reaction! If it's suspicious, write down the name and let me know. Then we'll work something out against them. Agreed?
npc.julius.say_1: [EN] Our nightly blood-sucking visitors put the inhabitants of Yalahar in constant danger. The worst thing is that anyone in this city could be a vampire. Maybe an outsider like you could help us. Would you try?
npc.julius.say_10: [EN] Fine then. Talk to me again about your mission once you have the garlic bread. You can get holy water from a member of the inquisition.
npc.julius.say_11: [EN] Fine. Good luck! Talk to me again about your mission once you have confirmed the names of five suspects.
npc.julius.say_12: [EN] Alright, wait a moment. Tell me one name at a time so I can note them down carefully. Who is a suspect?
npc.julius.say_13: [EN] Well, you need to mix flour with holy water and use that dough on garlic to create a special dough. Bake it like normal bread, but I guarantee that no vampire can eat that. Are you following me?
npc.julius.say_14: [EN] I guess Armenius, Lisander, Maris, Ortheus and Serafin are all the names we can get for now. Let me think for a moment what we are going to do, talk to me about your mission again later.
npc.julius.say_15: [EN] No, no, I was asking for one of the names.
npc.julius.say_16: [EN] Very well. I think I can trust you now. Sorry that I had to put you through this embarassing procedure, but I'm sure you understand. So, are you ready for your first real task?
npc.julius.say_17: [EN] No, no, you didn't eat it! Vampire Brood! Say '{aaah}' once you have eaten the bread or get out of her instantly!
npc.julius.say_18: [EN] He really doesn't look like the man of the sea he pretends to be, does he? Noted down! Any other name?
npc.julius.say_19: [EN] You already reported that name. Any new ones?
npc.julius.say_2: [EN] Hmm, I see, I see. That necklace is only a small indication though... I think I need another proof, just to make sure. Say... have you ever baked {garlic bread}?
npc.julius.say_20: [EN] Hm. You don't look so sure about that one. You should not report suspects that you did not confirm yourself! Any others?
npc.julius.say_21: [EN] I always thought that there is not really a poor beggar hidden under those ragged clothes. Noted down! Any other name?
npc.julius.say_22: [EN] You already reported that name. Any new ones?
npc.julius.say_23: [EN] Hm. You don't look so sure about that one. You should not report suspects that you did not confirm yourself! Any others?
npc.julius.say_24: [EN] Nice angelic name for a vampire. But he didn't escape your attention, well done. Noted down! Any other name?
npc.julius.say_25: [EN] You already reported that name. Any new ones?
npc.julius.say_26: [EN] Hm. You don't look so sure about that one. You should not report suspects that you did not confirm yourself! Any others?
npc.julius.say_27: [EN] Yes, that pale skin and those black eyes speak volumes. Noted down! Any other name?
npc.julius.say_28: [EN] You already reported that name. Any new ones?
npc.julius.say_29: [EN] Hm. You don't look so sure about that one. You should not report suspects that you did not confirm yourself! Any others?
npc.julius.say_3: [EN] I fear that will not do. Sorry.
npc.julius.say_30: [EN] Ahh, I always thought something was suspicious about him. Noted down! Any other name?
npc.julius.say_31: [EN] You already reported that name. Any new ones?
npc.julius.say_32: [EN] Hm. You don't look so sure about that one. You should not report suspects that you did not confirm yourself! Any others?
npc.julius.say_34: [EN] Hm. You don't look so sure about that one. You should not report suspects that you did not confirm yourself! Any others?
npc.julius.say_35: [EN] Good. Don't play around with the spell, only use it when standing in front of those vampires. Come back and report to me about your progress later.
npc.julius.say_36: [EN] I see... so Armenius is the master, and the spell didn't even cause a scratch on him... Well, that went worse than expected. Let me think for a moment and then ask me about a mission again.
npc.julius.say_4: [EN] I fear that will not do. Sorry.
npc.julius.say_5: [EN] Let me check - yes indeed, there's garlic in it. Now eat one, in front of my eyes. Right now! Say '{aaah}' when you've chewed it all down so that I can see you're not hiding it!
npc.julius.say_6: [EN] So, are you ready for your first real task?
npc.julius.say_7: [EN] Are you back with confirmed names of possible vampires?
npc.julius.say_8: [EN] Oh! You look horrible - I mean, rather weary. What happened? Who is the master vampire?
npc.julius.say_9: [EN] Well, there's one problem. How would I know I can trust you? You might be one of them... hm. Can you think of something really unlikely for a vampire? If you know a way to prove it to me, ask me about your {mission}.
npc.julius.sendtrade_msg_1: [EN] I'll reward you for every pair of vampire teeth you bring me.
npc.julius.stdmod_1: [EN] I come from a family of {vampire} hunters, but to be honest, I'm more into the theoretic part and strategic planning.
npc.julius.stdmod_2: [EN] A better name would be Gomorrah, if you ask me.
npc.julius.stdmod_4: [EN] Storkus? Oh yes, I know him. A long time ago we used to hunt together... sometimes.
npc.julius.stdmod_5: [EN] It's about time you showed the vampires that they should never bother the citizens again.
npc.julius.stdmod_6: [EN] Another vampire raid last night. But then again, that's nothing new.
npc.julius.stdmod_7: [EN] Well, I should be the one to thank you I guess.
npc.junkar_mines.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! You are lucky that the service is running right now. Save your coal for the days to come though!
npc.junkar_mines.stdmod_1: [EN] So much to do. So many things to be fixed.
npc.junkar_mines.voice_1: [EN] So much to do. So many things to be fixed.
