npc.kais.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hmm... surely you are in need of {help} - will you let me? I am {Kais} the Bound and I can lend you a hand in {healing} your body and soul or even grant an {enhanced} blessing!
npc.kais.keyword_1: [EN] So receive the blood of the mountain, master.
npc.kais.stdmod_1: [EN] I have the power to grant you the blood of the mountain's blessing. But I must ask of you to sacrifice |BLESSCOST| gold. Are you prepared for that?
npc.kais.stdmod_10: Du kan be om välsignelsen av de två solarna i soltornet nära Ab'Dendriel.
npc.kais.stdmod_11: Fenixens gnista ges av jord- och eldens dvärgpräster i Kazordoon.
npc.kais.stdmod_12: [EN] Talk to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya about this blessing.
npc.kais.stdmod_2: [EN] So receive the blood of the mountain, master.
npc.kais.stdmod_3: Bra. Du är fri att tacka nej till mitt erbjudande.
npc.kais.stdmod_4: Du är sårad, mitt barn. Jag ska läka dina sår.
npc.kais.stdmod_5: Du ser inte så illa ut. Tyvärr, jag kan inte hjälpa dig. Men om du letar efter ytterligare skydd bör du gå på {pilgrimage} av aska eller få skyddet av {twist of fate} här.
npc.kais.stdmod_6: [EN] I am Kais, Kais the Bound. Eternally {fixed} to the wretched place, unless... unless I prove my worth in aiding all those who seek my {help}.
npc.kais.stdmod_7: [EN] Well, as I am quite in a fix currently, my only hope to escape this situation may be to grant you {healing} or an {enhanced} blessing if you wish. You must desire SOMETHING, right? Sure you do.
npc.kais.stdmod_8: [EN] Besides the {enhanced} blessing available from me, I know of one other, granted by a solitary {nomad} far west of Svargrond. There are also five different other blessings available, each in a sacred place. ...\nThese blessings are: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}.
npc.kais.stdmod_9: Du kan be om välsignelsen av andlig avskärmning i whiteflower-templet söder om Thais.
npc.kallimae.say_1: [EN] Some residents are in need of ingredients to finish a ritual. You can help?
npc.kallimae.say_2: [EN] Search for the NPCs Yonan, Narsai, Shimun and Tefrit.
npc.kallimae.say_4: [EN] Did you help some residents with ingredients?
npc.kallimae.say_5: [EN] Thanks. I need you to go to 4 places indicated by Goddess Bastesh.
npc.kallimae.say_7: [EN] Did you check all the points and bring the Symbol of Sun and Sea?
npc.karith.greet_1: [EN] Hello! Tell me what's on your mind. Time is money.
npc.karith.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello! Tell me what's on your mind. Time is money.
npc.karith.greet_msg_2: [EN] Hello! Tell me what's on your mind. Time is money.
npc.karith.multi_1: [EN] The evergreen flower pots are an amusing item that might find some customers here. Do you want a passage to Carlin for 185 gold?
npc.karith.multi_10: [EN] A city full of mad death worshippers, no thanks. Or did you find something interesting there?
npc.karith.multi_11: [EN] Another port full of smelly humans, fittingly located in a swamp. Or did you find something interesting there?
npc.karith.multi_12: [EN] Of course it is merely superstition that the darashian sand wasp honey brings back youth and vitality, but as long people pay a decent price, I couldn't care less. Do you want a passage to Darashia for 210 gold?
npc.karith.multi_13: [EN] From all what I have heard, it is an unremarkable pile of huts in the desert. Or did you find something interesting there?
npc.karith.multi_14: [EN] Do you want a passage to Ab'Dendriel for 160 gold?
npc.karith.multi_15: [EN] I've never been there. I doubt the elves there came up with something noteworthy. Or did you find something interesting there?
npc.karith.multi_16: [EN] For the sake of profit, we established ship routes to {Ab'Dendriel}, {Darashia}, {Venore}, {Ankrahmun}, {Port Hope}, {Thais}, {Liberty Bay} and {Carlin}.
npc.karith.multi_17: [EN] I see no reason to establish ship routes to other cities. There is nothing that would be worth the effort. ...
npc.karith.multi_18: [EN] But since you won't stop bugging me, let's make a deal: If you can prove that at least five of your so-called 'cities' are not worthless, I might reconsider my position. ...
npc.karith.multi_19: [EN] Bring me something SPECIAL! The local bar tenders usually know what's interesting about their city.
npc.karith.multi_2: [EN] An unremarkable town compared to the wonders of Yalahar. Or did you find something interesting there?
npc.karith.multi_3: [EN] Do you want a passage to Liberty Bay for 275 gold?
npc.karith.multi_4: [EN] Which sane captain would sail his ship to a pirate town? Or did you find something interesting there?
npc.karith.multi_5: [EN] Astonishing enough the royal satin seems to suit the exquisite taste of the Yalahari. Do you want a passage to Thais for 200 gold?
npc.karith.multi_6: [EN] Thais must be a hell hole if only half of the stories we hear about it are true. Or did you find something interesting there?
npc.karith.multi_7: [EN] Ivory is highly prized by the artisans of the Yalahari. Do you want a passage to Port Hope for 260 gold?
npc.karith.multi_8: [EN] Another pointless human settlement. Or did you find something interesting there?
npc.karith.multi_9: [EN] The Yalahari seem to be obsessed with conserving their dead, so I guess the embalming fluid will be a great success in Yalahar. Do you want a passage to Ankrahmun for 230 gold?
npc.karith.say_1: [EN] The swamp spice will turn out very lucrative considering that it helps to make even the most disgusting dish taste good. Do you want a passage to Venore for 185 gold?
npc.karith.say_11: Du har inte tillräckligt med pengar.
npc.karith.say_13: Du har inte tillräckligt med pengar.
npc.karith.say_15: Du har inte tillräckligt med pengar.
npc.karith.say_17: Du har inte tillräckligt med pengar.
npc.karith.say_19: Du har inte tillräckligt med pengar.
npc.karith.say_2: [EN] What's that? Bug milk? Hm, perhaps I can find some customers for that!
npc.karith.say_21: Du har inte tillräckligt med pengar.
npc.karith.say_23: Du har inte tillräckligt med pengar.
npc.karith.say_25: Du har inte tillräckligt med pengar.
npc.karith.say_3: [EN] Sand wasp honey? Hm, interesting at least!
npc.karith.say_4: [EN] Some special spice might be of value indeed.
npc.karith.say_5: [EN] I can hardly imagine that someone is interested in embalming fluid, but I'll give it a try.
npc.karith.say_6: [EN] Of course! Ivory! Its value is quite obvious.
npc.karith.say_7: [EN] This royal satin is indeed of acceptable quality.
npc.karith.say_8: [EN] I doubt that the esteemed Yalahari will indulge into something profane as rum. But who knows, I'll give it a try.
npc.karith.say_9: [EN] I doubt that these flowers will stay fresh and healthy forever. But if they do, they could be indeed valuable.
npc.karith.stdmod_1: [EN] This weather is killing me. If I only had enough money to retire.
npc.karith.stdmod_2: Jag är kapten på det här fartyget.
npc.karith.stdmod_3: Jag är kapten på det här fartyget.
npc.karith.stdmod_4: [EN] I'm Karith. I don't belong to a caste any longer, and only serve the Yalahari.
npc.karith.voice_1: [EN] This weather is killing me. If I only had enough money to retire.
npc.karl.farewell_msg_1: [EN] Please come back, but don't tell others.
npc.karl.greet_msg_1: [EN] Pshhhht! Not that loud ... but welcome.
npc.karl.say_1: [EN] Do you bring me a barrel of beer??
npc.karl.say_2: [EN] Do you want to buy a bottle of our finest whisper beer for 80 gold?
npc.karl.say_4: [EN] You don't have any barrel of beer!
npc.karl.say_5: [EN] Here. Don't take it into the city though.
npc.karl.say_6: Du har inte tillräckligt med pengar.
npc.karl.walkaway_msg_1: [EN] Please come back, but don't tell others.
npc.kasmir.greet_msg_1: Välkommen, unga |PLAYERNAME|! Om du är svårt sårad eller förgiftad kan jag {heal} dig gratis.
npc.kasmir.keyword_1: Så ta emot skyddet av ödets vändning, pilgrim.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_1: Så ta emot skyddet av ödets vändning, pilgrim.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_11: Jag tror att du har glömt att ta med din påle, pilgrim.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_12: Ja, jag fick besked om vad jag skulle göra. Är du beredd att ta emot min bönelinje?
npc.kasmir.stdmod_13: [EN] So receive my prayer: 'Let there be honour and humility'. Now, bring your stake to Rahkem in Ankrahmun for the next line of the prayer. I will inform him what to do.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_15: [EN] You should visit Rahkem in Ankrahmun now, pilgrim.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_16: Du har redan fått min bönrad.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_17: [EN] A blessed stake? That is a strange request. Maybe Quentin knows more, he is one of the oldest monks after all.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_18: Du är sårad, mitt barn. Jag ska läka dina sår.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_19: Du ser inte så illa ut. Tyvärr, jag kan inte hjälpa dig. Men om du letar efter ytterligare skydd bör du gå på {pilgrimage} av aska eller få skyddet av {twist of fate} här.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_2: Bra. Du är fri att tacka nej till mitt erbjudande.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_20: Närhelst du får ett dödligt sår skadas din livskraft och det finns en chans att du tappar bort en del av din utrustning. Med varenda av de fem {blessings} du har kommer denna skada och risken för förlust att minska.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_21: [EN] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_22: Jag ser att du fick den andliga avskärmningen i det vita blomtemplet söder om Thais.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_23: Jag kan ana att druiderna norr om Carlin har försett dig med omfamningen Tibia.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_24: Jag kan se att du fick välsignelsen av de två solarna i soltornet nära Ab'Dendriel.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_25: Jag kan ana att gnistan från Fenix ​​redan gavs till dig av dvärgprästerna av jord och eld i Kazordoon.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_26: Jag kan känna att du redan pratade med eremiten Eremo på ön Cormaya och fick denna välsignelse.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_27: Du kan be om välsignelsen av andlig avskärmning i whiteflower-templet söder om Thais.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_28: Druiderna norr om Carlin kommer att förse dig med Tibia.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_29: Du kan be om välsignelsen av de två solarna i soltornet nära Ab'Dendriel.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_30: Fenixens gnista ges av jord- och eldens dvärgpräster i Kazordoon.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_32:
Detta är en speciell välsignelse som jag kan skänka dig när du har fått åtminstone en av de andra välsignelserna och som fungerar lite annorlunda. ... \z
	Det fungerar bara när du dödas av andra äventyrare, vilket betyder att minst hälften av skadan som ledde till din död orsakades av andra, inte av monster eller miljön. ... \z
	{twist of fate} kommer inte att minska dödsstraffet som de andra välsignelserna, utan istället hindra dig från att förlora dina andra välsignelser såväl som förlustamuletten, om du bär en. Det kostar lika mycket som de andra välsignelserna. ... \z
	Skulle du vilja få det skyddet för ett offer på |PVPBLESSCOST| guld, barn?
npc.kasmir.stdmod_4: Ah, vill du byta ut din äventyrarsten gratis?
npc.kasmir.stdmod_5: Här är du. Ta hand om dig.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_7: Ah, vill du byta ut din äventyrarsten mot 30 guld?
npc.kasmir.stdmod_8: Här är du. Ta hand om dig.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_9: Tyvärr, du har inte tillräckligt med pengar.
npc.kasmir.walkaway_msg_1: Kom ihåg: Om du är svårt sårad eller förgiftad kan jag bota dig gratis.
npc.kawill.stdmod_1: [EN] The Spark of the Phoenix is given by me and by the great pyromancer in the nearby fire temple. Do you wish to receive my part of the Spark of the Phoenix?
npc.kawill.stdmod_10: [EN] Nice world in general. It's a shame there is so much water ruining the general impression.
npc.kawill.stdmod_12: [EN] May the earth swallow them all!
npc.kawill.stdmod_13: [EN] Ah, a weapon to be feared by man, beast and god alike, jawoll. He who wields it will be both blessed and cursed at the same time.
npc.kawill.stdmod_14: [EN] The day will come when he finally bites the dust.
npc.kawill.stdmod_15: [EN] By using the powers of fire and earth we forced the river that once wound its way through the big old one in other directions, and created our home.
npc.kawill.stdmod_16: [EN] Bezil and Nezil have pawn and equpiment shop with an amazing stock.
npc.kawill.stdmod_17: [EN] Bezil and Nezil have pawn and equpiment shop with an amazing stock.
npc.kawill.stdmod_18: [EN] The first knight of dwarvenkind is a fine woman.
npc.kawill.stdmod_19: [EN] I fear the sorcerers focus on the destructive forces of fire. They forget about the protection earth could provide.
npc.kawill.stdmod_2: [EN] So receive the blessing of the life-giving earth, pilgrim.
npc.kawill.stdmod_20: [EN] He is a jolly fellow and one of the oldest dwarves alive.
npc.kawill.stdmod_21: [EN] He is a fine smith and his armour may save your neck one day.
npc.kawill.stdmod_22: [EN] She is a fine cook, jawoll.
npc.kawill.stdmod_23: [EN] Uzgod is a blacksmith and understands the ways of his element well.
npc.kawill.stdmod_24: [EN] The emperor has rarely visited the temple district in the last years. He should care more about spirituality then about politics. Jawoll.
npc.kawill.stdmod_25: [EN] The emperor has rarely visited the temple district in the last years. He should care more about spirituality then about politics. Jawoll.
npc.kawill.stdmod_26: [EN] The celestial paladin, the protector of our race. The only divine being we care for and the only one who still cares for dwarfs.
npc.kawill.stdmod_27: [EN] Where earth is giving, fire is taking. That is the way of the elements.
npc.kawill.stdmod_28: [EN] The lifegiving earth protects us, feeds us and takes us home after death.
npc.kawill.stdmod_29: [EN] The mountain we live in is called the big old one. It's the mountain of mountains, and it isand like a friend and protector to our race.
npc.kawill.stdmod_3: [EN] Ok. If you don't want it...
npc.kawill.stdmod_4: [EN] The gods are treacherous and vain. They want to use us like they did in the past. Only the elements can be trusted, because all they want is for nature to run its set course.
npc.kawill.stdmod_5: [EN] I am the great geomancer of dwarvenkind.
npc.kawill.stdmod_6: [EN] We investigate the will of the earth. It is our duty to make sure things to work in their natural way.
npc.kawill.stdmod_7: [EN] Life is born by earth and fed by earth.
npc.kawill.stdmod_8: [EN] I am Kawill Marbleeye, Son of Earth, from the Molten Rock.
npc.kawill.stdmod_9: [EN] There's nothing I need, better ask others.
npc.kawill.walkaway_msg_1: [EN] Earth under your feet, pilgrim. What brings you here?
npc.kaya.greet_msg_1: Ja? Vad kan jag göra för dig, |PLAYERNAME|? Bankaffärer kanske?
npc.kaya.voice_1: [EN] Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Tibian Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.kazzan.multi_1: [EN] Very good. I hope you are able to convince one of the fractions to stand on our side. If you haven't done yet, you should first go and look for old Melchior in Ankrahmun. ...
npc.kazzan.multi_2: [EN] He knows many things about the djinn race and he may have some hints for you.
npc.kazzan.multi_3: [EN] Alright. The problem is that I want to know at least one of them on my side. You never know. I don't mind if it's the evil Efreet or the Marid. ...
npc.kazzan.multi_4: [EN] Your mission will be to visit one kind of the djinns and bring them a peace-offering. Are you interested in that mission?
npc.kazzan.say_2: [EN] Feel welcome in the lands of the children of the enlightened Daraman, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.kazzan.say_3: [EN] Do you know the location of the djinn fortresses in the mountains south of here?
npc.kazzan.say_4: [EN] Well, I don't blame you for that. I am sure you did your best. Now we can just hope that peace remains. Here, take this small gratification for your effort to help and Daraman may bless you!
npc.kendra.farewell_msg_1: Hej då. Rekommendera oss om du är nöjd med vår tjänst.

npc.kendra_thais.stdmod_7: [EN] Where do you want to go? To {Nostalgia}, {Horror Village}
npc.kendra_thais.stdmod_8: [EN] Where do you want to go? To {Nostalgia}, {Horror Village}
npc.kendra_thais.stdmod_9: [EN] This is Nostalgia. Where do you want to go?
npc.kepar.greet_msg_1: Ja? Vad kan jag göra för dig, |PLAYERNAME|? Bankaffärer kanske?
npc.kepar.voice_1: [EN] Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Tibian Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.kevin.say_1: [EN] You are not a member of our guild yet! We have high standards for our members. To rise in our guild is a difficult but rewarding task. Are you interested in joining?
npc.kevin.say_10: [EN] Fine, fine. I think that should do it. Tell Hugo that we order those uniforms. The completed dress pattern will soon arrive in Venore. Report to me when you have talked to him.
npc.kevin.say_11: [EN] So Waldo is dead? This is grave news indeed. Did you recover his posthorn?
npc.kevin.say_12: [EN] You did it? I hope you did not catch a flu in the cold! Anyway, there's another mission for you. Are you interested?
npc.kevin.say_13: [EN] You have delivered that letter? You are a true postofficer. All over the land bards shallpraise your name. There are no missions for you left right now.
npc.kevin.say_14: [EN] There are no missions for you left right now. You already have the title of Archpostman.
npc.kevin.say_15: [EN] There are no missions for you left right now. But you are worthy indeed. Do you want to advance in our guild?
npc.kevin.say_16: [EN] So are you ready for another mission?
npc.kevin.say_17: [EN] So are you ready for another mission?
npc.kevin.say_18: [EN] So are you ready for another mission?
npc.kevin.say_19: [EN] Excellent! Another job well done! Would you accept another mission?
npc.kevin.say_2: [EN] So you have finally made it! I did not think that you would have it in you ... However: are you ready for another assignment?
npc.kevin.say_20: [EN] Excellent! Another job well done! Would you accept another mission?
npc.kevin.say_21: [EN] You have made it! We have enough bones for the fund! You remind me of myself when I was young! Interested in another mission?
npc.kevin.say_22: [EN] You have made it! We have enough bones for the fund! You remind me of myself when I was young! Interested in another mission?
npc.kevin.say_23: [EN] You truly got him? Quite impressive. You are a very promising candidate! I think I have another mission for you. Are you interested?
npc.kevin.say_24: [EN] So are you ready for another mission?
npc.kevin.say_25: [EN] So are you ready for another mission?
npc.kevin.say_26: [EN] Oh yes, where did we get that from ...? Let's see, first ask the great technomancer in Kazordoon for the technical details. Return here afterwards.
npc.kevin.say_27: [EN] The mail with Talphion's instructions just arived. I remember we asked Queen Eloise of Carlin for the perfect colours. Go there, ask her about the UNIFORMS and report back here.
npc.kevin.say_28: [EN] The queen has sent me the samples we needed. The next part is tricky. We need theuniforms to emanate some odor that dogs hate.The dog with the best 'taste' in that field is Noodles,the dog of King Tibianus. Do you understand so far?
npc.kevin.say_29: [EN] Fine, fine. I think that should do it. Tell Hugo that we order those uniforms. The completed dress pattern will soon arrive in Venore. Report to me when you have talked to him.
npc.kevin.say_3: [EN] Excellent, you got it fixed! This will teach this mailbox a lesson indeed! Are you interested in another assignment?
npc.kevin.say_30: [EN] You are worthy indeed. Do you want to advance in our guild?
npc.kevin.say_31: [EN] You are worthy indeed. Do you want to advance in our guild?
npc.kevin.say_32: [EN] You are worthy indeed. Do you want to advance in our guild?
npc.kevin.say_33: [EN] You are worthy indeed. Do you want to advance in our guild?
npc.kevin.say_34: [EN] Hm, I might consider your proposal, but first you will have to prove your worth by doing some tasks for us. Are you willing to do that?
npc.kevin.say_35: [EN] Excellent! Your first task will be quite simple. But you should better write my instructions down anyways. You can read and write?
npc.kevin.say_36: [EN] So listen, you will check certain tours our members have to take to see if there is some trouble. First travel with Captain Bluebear's ship from Thais to Carlin, understood?
npc.kevin.say_37: [EN] Excellent! Once you have done that you will travel with Uzon to Edron. You will find him in the Femor Hills. Understood?
npc.kevin.say_38: [EN] Fine, fine! Next, travel with Captain Seahorse to the city of Venore. Understood?
npc.kevin.say_39: [EN] Good! Finally, find the technomancer Brodrosch and travel with him to the Isle of Cormaya. After this passage report back to me here. Understood?
npc.kevin.say_4: [EN] You truly got him? Quite impressive. You are a very promising candidate! I think I have another mission for you. Are you interested?
npc.kevin.say_40: [EN] Ok, remember: the Tibian mail service puts trust in you! Don't fail and report back soon. Just tell me about your {mission}.
npc.kevin.say_41: [EN] I am glad to hear that. One of our mailboxes was reported to be jammed. It is located on the so called 'mountain' on theisle Folda. Get a crowbar and fix the mailbox. Report about your mission when you have done so.
npc.kevin.say_42: [EN] For your noble deeds I grant you the title Assistant Postofficer. All Postofficers will charge you less money from now on. After every second mission ask me for an ADVANCEMENT. Your next task will be a bit more challenging. Do you feel ready for it?
npc.kevin.say_43: [EN] I need you to deliver a bill to the stage magician David Brassacres. He's hiding from his creditors somewhere in Venore. It's likely you will have to trick him somehow to reveal his identity. Report back when you delivered this bill.
npc.kevin.say_44: [EN] Ok, listen: we have some serious trouble with agressive dogs lately. We have accumulated some bones as a sort of pacifier but we need more. Collect 20 bones like the one in my room to the left and report here.
npc.kevin.say_45: [EN] You have collected all the 20 bones needed. Excellent! Now let's talk about further missions if you are interested.
npc.kevin.say_47: [EN] I grant you the title of postman. You are now a full member of our guild. Here have your own officers hat and wear it with pride.
npc.kevin.say_48: [EN] Since I am convinced I can trust you, this time you must deliver a valuable present to Dermot on Fibula. Do NOT open it!!! You will find the present behind the door here on the lower right side of this room.
npc.kevin.say_49: [EN] Ok. We need a new set of uniforms, and only the best will do for us. Please travel to Venore and negotiate with Hugo Chief acontract for new uniforms.
npc.kevin.say_5: [EN] Do you bring all bones for our officers' safety fund at once?
npc.kevin.say_50: [EN] Good. Go there and find out what taste he dislikes most: mouldy cheese, a piece of fur or abananaskin. Tell him to SNIFF, then the object. Show him the object and ask 'Do you like that?'.DONT let the guards know what you are doing.
npc.kevin.say_51: [EN] Good, so listen. Hugo Chief informed me that he needs the measurements of our postofficers. Go and bring me the measurements of Ben, Lokur, Dove, Liane, Chrystal and Olrik.
npc.kevin.say_52: [EN] From now on it shall be known that you are a grand postman. You are now a privilegedmember until the end of days. Most captains around the world have an agreement with our guild to transport our privileged members, like you, for less gold.
npc.kevin.say_53: [EN] Ok but your next assignment might be dangerous. Our Courier Waldo has been missing for a while. I must assume he is dead. Can you follow me so far?
npc.kevin.say_54: [EN] Find out about his whereabouts and retrieve him or at least his posthorn. He was looking for a new underground passage that is rumoured to be found underneath the troll-infested Mountain east of Thais.
npc.kevin.say_55: [EN] Thank you. We will honour this. Your next mission will be a very special one. Good thing you are a special person as well. Are you ready?
npc.kevin.say_56: [EN] From now on you are a grand postman for special operations. You are an honoured member of our guild and earned the privilege of your own post horn. Here, take it.
npc.kevin.say_57: [EN] So listen well. Behind the lower left door you will find a bag. The letters in the bag are for none other than Santa Claus! Deliver them to his house on the isle of Vega, {use} thebag on his mailbox and report back here.
npc.kevin.say_58: [EN] Excellent. Here is a letter for you to deliver. Well, to be honest, no one else volunteered. It's a letter from the mother of Markwin, the king of Mintwallin. Deliver that letter to him, but note that you will not be welcome there.
npc.kevin.say_59: [EN] I grant you the title of Archpostman. You are a legend in our guild. As privilege of your newly aquired status you are allowed to make use of certain mailboxes in dangerous areas. Just look out for them and you'll see.
npc.kevin.say_6: [EN] Splendid, I knew we could trust you. I would like to ask for your help in another matter. Are you interested?
npc.kevin.say_60: [EN] Your eagerness is a virtue, young one, but first let's talk about advancement
npc.kevin.say_7: [EN] Once more you have impressed me! Are you willing to do another job?
npc.kevin.say_8: [EN] First you need to complete your current mission.
npc.kevin.say_9: [EN] Excellent! Another job well done! Would you accept another mission?
npc.khanna.say_1: Så du ber mig om en {{}} för att börja ditt äventyr?
npc.khanna.say_2: Vad? Jag har redan gett dig en {{}}!
npc.khanna.say_3: Naturligtvis, bara bläddra igenom mina varor. Du kan också titta på {}.
npc.khanna.voice_1: [EN] If you need runes, this is the market stall for you!
npc.khanna.voice_2: [EN] I'm selling magic equipment. Come and have a look.
npc.king_tibianus.greet_1: [EN] I greet thee, my loyal subject |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.king_tibianus.greet_2: [EN] I greet thee, my loyal subject |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.king_tibianus.multi_1: Excellent! Låt mig nu förklara. Om du donerar 1 000 000 000 guldpjäser har du rätt att bära en unik outfit. ...
npc.king_tibianus.multi_2: [EN] You will be entitled to wear the {armor} for 500.000.000 gold pieces, {helmet} for an additional 250.000.000 and the {boots} for another 250.000.000 gold pieces. ...
npc.king_tibianus.say_1: [EN] Ah, I vaguely remember that our little allies were eager to build some base. So speak up, what do you want?
npc.king_tibianus.say_10: Ta den här hjälmen som ett tecken på stor tacksamhet. Låt oss för alltid minnas denna dag, min vän.
npc.king_tibianus.say_11: Du har inte tillräckligt med pengar för att donera det beloppet.
npc.king_tibianus.say_13: [EN] You need to donate {armor} outfit first.
npc.king_tibianus.say_14: Ta dessa stövlar som ett tecken på stor tacksamhet. Låt oss för alltid minnas denna dag, min vän.
npc.king_tibianus.say_15: Du har inte tillräckligt med pengar för att donera det beloppet.
npc.king_tibianus.say_18: [EN] Ah, I vaguely remember that our little allies were eager to build some base. So speak up, what do you want?
npc.king_tibianus.say_19: Så du skulle vilja donera 500.000.000 guldpjäser som i gengäld ger dig rätt att bära en unik rustning?
npc.king_tibianus.say_2: [EN] Do you have anything that might change my mind?
npc.king_tibianus.say_20: Så du skulle vilja donera 250.000.000 guldpjäser som i gengäld ger dig rätt att bära unik hjälm?
npc.king_tibianus.say_21: Så du skulle vilja skänka 250.000.000 guldpjäser som i gengäld ger dig rätt att bära en unik känga?
npc.king_tibianus.say_3: [EN] Indeed, indeed. Without the help of Thais, our allies stand no chance! Well, I'll send some money to support their cause.
npc.king_tibianus.say_4: [EN] In exchange for a truly generous donation, I will offer a special outfit. Do you want to make a donation?
npc.king_tibianus.say_5: I så fall, återvänd till mig när du bestämt dig.
npc.king_tibianus.say_6: Ta denna rustning som ett tecken på stor tacksamhet. Låt oss för alltid minnas denna dag, min vän!
npc.king_tibianus.say_7: Se till att du har lediga platser i din butiks inkorg.
npc.king_tibianus.say_8: Du har inte tillräckligt med pengar för att donera det beloppet.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_1: Jag kan marknadsföra dig för 20 000 guldmynt. Vill du att jag ska marknadsföra dig?
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_10: [EN] The latest news is usually brought to our magnificent town by brave adventurers. They recount tales of their journeys at Frodo's tavern.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_13: [EN] Sell? Sell what? My kingdom isn't for sale!
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_14: [EN] Honour the Gods and above all pay your {taxes}.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_15: [EN] Please ask a priest about the gods.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_16: [EN] The citizens of Tibia are my subjects. Ask the old monk Quentin if you want to learn more about them.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_17: [EN] He is a skilled blacksmith and a loyal subject.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_18: [EN] He is the owner of Frodo's Hut and a faithful tax-payer.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_19: [EN] He was once one of Tibia's greatest fighters. Now he sells equipment.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_20: [EN] He was once my greatest general. Now he is very old and senile so we assigned him to work for the Royal Tibia Mail.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_21: [EN] The royal poodle Noodles is my greatest {treasure}!
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_22: [EN] He is a follower of the evil God Zathroth and responsible for many attacks on us. Kill him on sight!
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_23: [EN] He is my royal jester and cheers me up now and then.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_24: [EN] The royal poodle Noodles is my greatest treasure!
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_25: [EN] Go and hunt them! For king and country!
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_26: [EN] Visit Quentin the monk for help.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_28: [EN] Dungeons are no places for kings.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_29: [EN] Feel free to buy it in our town's fine shops.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_3: Okej då, kom tillbaka när du är redo.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_30: [EN] Ask the royal cook for some food.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_31: [EN] That tax collector is the bane of my life. He is so lazy. I bet you haven't payed any taxes at all.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_32: [EN] I am the king, so watch what you say!
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_34: [EN] Visit the shops of our merchants and craftsmen.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_35: [EN] The four major guilds are the knights, the paladins, the druids, and the sorcerers.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_36: [EN] Vile monsters, but I must admit they are strong and sometimes even cunning ... in their own bestial way.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_37: [EN] The forces of good are hard pressed in these dark times.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_38: [EN] We need all strength we can muster to smite evil!
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_4: [EN] It is said that he lives on a small island near Edron. Maybe the people there know more about him.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_41: [EN] It's the sword of the Kings. If you return this weapon to me I will {reward} you beyond your wildest dreams.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_42: [EN] Well, if you want a reward, go on a quest to bring me Excalibug!
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_43: [EN] A very competent person. A little nervous but very competent.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_44: [EN] This organisation is an essential tool for holding our enemies in check. Its headquarter is located in the bastion in the northwall.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_45: [EN] Soon the whole land will be ruled by me once again!
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_46: [EN] Harkath Bloodblade is the general of our glorious {army}.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_47: [EN] I will call for heroes as soon as the need arises again and then reward them appropriately.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_48: [EN] To pay your taxes, visit the royal tax collector.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_5: [EN] Awesome! Please pay a visit to www.otserv.com.br!
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_50: [EN] Our enemies are numerous. The evil minotaurs, Ferumbras, and the renegade city of Carlin to the north are just some of them.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_51: [EN] They dare to reject my reign over the whole continent!
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_52: [EN] Our beloved city has some fine shops, guildhouses and a modern sewerage system.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_54: [EN] The paladins are great protectors for Thais.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_55: [EN] The brave knights are necessary for human survival in Thais.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_56: [EN] The magic of the sorcerers is a powerful tool to smite our enemies.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_6: [EN] Baah is awesome dude that rewrote my outfit script.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_7: [EN] I am your sovereign, King Tibianus III, and it's my duty to uphold {justice} and provide guidance for my subjects.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_8: [EN] I try my best to be just and fair to our citizens. The army and the {TBI} are a great help in fulfilling this duty.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_9: [EN] Preposterous! You must know the name of your own King!
npc.kjesse.greet_msg_1: Välkommen, unga |PLAYERNAME|! Om du är svårt sårad eller förgiftad kan jag {heal} dig gratis.
npc.kjesse.keyword_1: Så ta emot skyddet av ödets vändning, pilgrim.
npc.kjesse.stdmod_1: Så ta emot skyddet av ödets vändning, pilgrim.
npc.kjesse.stdmod_11: Du är sårad, mitt barn. Jag ska läka dina sår.
npc.kjesse.stdmod_12: Du ser inte så illa ut. Tyvärr, jag kan inte hjälpa dig. Men om du letar efter ytterligare skydd bör du gå på {pilgrimage} av aska eller få skyddet av {twist of fate} här.
npc.kjesse.stdmod_13: Närhelst du får ett dödligt sår skadas din livskraft och det finns en chans att du tappar bort en del av din utrustning. Med varenda av de fem {blessings} du har kommer denna skada och risken för förlust att minska.
npc.kjesse.stdmod_14: [EN] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.kjesse.stdmod_15: Jag ser att du fick den andliga avskärmningen i det vita blomtemplet söder om Thais.
npc.kjesse.stdmod_16: Jag kan ana att druiderna norr om Carlin har försett dig med omfamningen Tibia.
npc.kjesse.stdmod_17: Jag kan se att du fick välsignelsen av de två solarna i soltornet nära Ab'Dendriel.
npc.kjesse.stdmod_18: Jag kan ana att gnistan från Fenix ​​redan gavs till dig av dvärgprästerna av jord och eld i Kazordoon.
npc.kjesse.stdmod_19: Jag kan känna att du redan pratade med eremiten Eremo på ön Cormaya och fick denna välsignelse.
npc.kjesse.stdmod_2: Bra. Du är fri att tacka nej till mitt erbjudande.
npc.kjesse.stdmod_20: Du kan be om välsignelsen av andlig avskärmning i whiteflower-templet söder om Thais.
npc.kjesse.stdmod_21: Druiderna norr om Carlin kommer att förse dig med Tibia.
npc.kjesse.stdmod_22: Du kan be om välsignelsen av de två solarna i soltornet nära Ab'Dendriel.
npc.kjesse.stdmod_23: Fenixens gnista ges av jord- och eldens dvärgpräster i Kazordoon.
npc.kjesse.stdmod_25:
Detta är en speciell välsignelse som jag kan skänka dig när du har fått åtminstone en av de andra välsignelserna och som fungerar lite annorlunda. ... \z
	Det fungerar bara när du dödas av andra äventyrare, vilket betyder att minst hälften av skadan som ledde till din död orsakades av andra, inte av monster eller miljön. ... \z
	{twist of fate} kommer inte att minska dödsstraffet som de andra välsignelserna, utan istället hindra dig från att förlora dina andra välsignelser såväl som förlustamuletten, om du bär en. Det kostar lika mycket som de andra välsignelserna. ... \z
	Skulle du vilja få det skyddet för ett offer på |PVPBLESSCOST| guld, barn?
npc.kjesse.stdmod_4: Ah, vill du byta ut din äventyrarsten gratis?
npc.kjesse.stdmod_5: Här är du. Ta hand om dig.
npc.kjesse.stdmod_7: Ah, vill du byta ut din äventyrarsten mot 30 guld?
npc.kjesse.stdmod_8: Här är du. Ta hand om dig.
npc.kjesse.stdmod_9: Tyvärr, du har inte tillräckligt med pengar.
npc.kjesse.walkaway_msg_1: Kom ihåg: Om du är svårt sårad eller förgiftad kan jag bota dig gratis.
npc.klaus.farewell_msg_1: [EN] Whenever your throat is dry, you know where to find my tavern.
npc.klaus.say_1: [EN] Hmm, you look like a seasoned seadog. Kill Captain Ray Striker, bring me his lucky pillow as a proof and you are our hero!
npc.klaus.say_3: [EN] You DID it!!! Incredible! Boys, lets have a PAAAAAARTY!!!!
npc.klaus.say_4: [EN] Come back when you have his lucky pillow.
npc.klom_stonecutter.greet_msg_1: [EN] Greetings. A warning straight ahead: I don't like loiterin'. If you're not here to {help} us, you're here to waste my time. Which I consider loiterin'. Now, try and prove your {worth} to our alliance. ...
npc.klom_stonecutter.greet_msg_2: [EN] I have sealed some of the areas far too dangerous for anyone to enter. If you can prove you're capable, you'll get an opportunity to help destroy the weird machines, pumping lava into the caves leading to the most dangerous enemies.
npc.klom_stonecutter.multi_1: [EN] We need to find a way to drive off the exiles from these caves. Countless makeshift homes are popping up at every corner. Destroy them and get the Lost out of hiding to eliminate them. ...
npc.klom_stonecutter.multi_10: [EN] Prepared to get rid of some seriously foul creepers for us?
npc.klom_stonecutter.multi_2: [EN] If you can capture a few of them, you'll receive a bonus. Just bring 'em to the border of our outpost and we will take care of the rest. ...
npc.klom_stonecutter.multi_4: [EN] We need to find a way to drive off the exiles from these caves. Countless makeshift homes are popping up at every corner. Destroy them and get the Lost out of hiding to eliminate them. ...
npc.klom_stonecutter.multi_5: [EN] If you can capture a few of them, you'll receive a bonus. Just bring 'em to the border of our outpost and we will take care of the rest. ...
npc.klom_stonecutter.multi_7: [EN] Vermin. Everywhere. We get a lot of strange four-legged crawlers and worms down here lately. It's getting out of hand and... well, I need a real killer for this.
npc.klom_stonecutter.multi_8: [EN] Prepared to get rid of some seriously foul creepers for us?
npc.klom_stonecutter.multi_9: [EN] Vermin. Everywhere. We get a lot of strange four-legged crawlers and worms down here lately. It's getting out of hand and... well, I need a real killer for this.
npc.klom_stonecutter.say_1: [EN] You want to offer {} suspicious device{}. Which leader shall have it, (Gnomus) of the {gnomes}, (Klom Stonecutter) of the {dwarves} or the {scouts} (Lardoc Bashsmite)?
npc.klom_stonecutter.say_10: [EN] If you bring me any suspicious devices on creatures you slay down here, I'll make it worth your while by telling the others of your generosity. How many do you want to offer?
npc.klom_stonecutter.say_13: Du har inte tillräckligt med misstänkta enheter.
npc.klom_stonecutter.say_15: Du har inte tillräckligt med misstänkta enheter.
npc.klom_stonecutter.say_17: Du har inte tillräckligt med misstänkta enheter.
npc.klom_stonecutter.say_18: [EN] So you want to know what we all think about your deeds? What leader's opinion are you interested in, the {gnomes} (Gnomus), the {dwarves} (Klom Stonecutter) or the {scouts} (Lardoc Bashsmite)?
npc.klom_stonecutter.say_2: Tomtarna är fortfarande i behov av din hjälp, medlem av Bigfoot's Brigade. Bevisa ditt värde genom att svara på deras samtal! ({}/10)
npc.klom_stonecutter.say_3: Dvärgarna är fortfarande i behov av din hjälp, medlem av Bigfoot's Brigade. Bevisa ditt värde genom att svara på deras samtal! ({}/10)
npc.klom_stonecutter.say_4: Scouterna är fortfarande i behov av din hjälp, medlem av Bigfoot's Brigade. Bevisa ditt värde genom att svara på deras samtal! ({}/10)
npc.klom_stonecutter.say_5: Jag behöver inte din hjälp just nu. Kom tillbaka senare.
npc.klom_stonecutter.say_6: Kom tillbaka när du är klar med ditt jobb.
npc.klom_stonecutter.say_7: [EN] So you did it. Well, that won't be the last of 'em but this sure helps our situation down here. Return to me later if you want to help me again!
npc.klom_stonecutter.say_8: [EN] So you did it. And you even made prisoners, the bonus is yours! Well, that won't be the last of 'em but this sure helps our situation down here. Return to me later if you want to help me again!
npc.klom_stonecutter.say_9: [EN] Very well, now try to find some of their makeshift homes and tear'em down. There's bound to be some stragglers you can 'persuade' to surrender, eliminate any resistance. Get back here when you're done.
npc.klom_stonecutter.stdmod_1: [EN] Well, the biggest problem we need to address are the ever charging {subterraneans} around here. And on top of that, there's the threat of the Lost, who quite made themselves at {home} in these parts.
npc.klom_stonecutter.stdmod_7:
[EN] The attacks of the enemy forces are fierce but we hold our ground. ...  \z
	I'd love to face one of their generals in combat but as their masters they cowardly hide far behind enemy lines and I have other duties to fulfil. ...  \z
	I envy you for the chance to thrust into the heart of the enemy, locking weapons with their jaws... or whatever... and see the fear in their eyes when they recognise they were bested.
npc.klom_stonecutter.stdmod_8:
[EN] I welcome a fine battle as any dwarf worth his beard should do. As long as it's a battle against something I can hit with my trusty axe. ... \z
	But here the true {enemy} eludes us. We fight wave after wave of their lackeys and if the gnomes are right the true enemy is up to something far more sinister.
npc.klom_stonecutter.stdmod_9:
[EN] I have no idea what kind of creeps are behind all this. Even the gnomes don't and they have handled that stuff way more often. ... \z
	But even if we knew nothing more about them, the fact alone that they employ the help of those mockeries of all things dwarfish, marks them as an enemy of the dwarves and it's our obligation to annihilate them.
npc.kroox.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome to Kroox Quality Armor, |PLAYERNAME|! Wanna take a look, ask me for a trade.
npc.kroox.multi_1: [EN] Oh, so its you, he wrote me about? Sadly I have no dwarven armor in stock. But I give you the permission to retrive one from the mines. ...
npc.kroox.multi_2: [EN] The problem is, some giant spiders made the tunnels where the storage is their new home. Good luck.
npc.kroox.say_1: [EN] Hm, well I guess its ok to tell you ... <tells you about Lokurs measurements>
npc.kulag_the_guard.say_1: [EN] You adventurers become more and more of a pest.
npc.kulag_the_guard.say_2: [EN] They should throw you all into jail instead of giving you all those quests and rewards an honest watchman can only dream about.
npc.kulag_the_guard.stdmod_1: Det är min plikt att skydda staden.
npc.lailene.greet_msg_1: [EN] What do you want in my magical robe store? I doubt I have anything that's of interest to you.
npc.lailene.stdmod_1: [EN] ... what?! Uh - no, no. Of course I wouldn't have anything to do with... them.
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.greet_msg_1: [EN] Since you are obviously not one of my relatives who pays me a long overdue visit, we should get {work} right away. We'll see if you can prove your {worth} to our alliance.
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_1: [EN] I can't explain that stuff, even the gnomes don't know what grows in those caves. All we know is that this stuff brought about all the diremaws we are now facing. ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_10: [EN] We built an iron fence around it and added a mechanism to quickly get barrel if need be. Then an... accident happened to our guard down there and ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_11: [EN] Well, to make a long story short, the barrels are unguarded right now and the diremaws are now too numerous and we are in desperate need of volunteers. ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_12: [EN] We need someone to take those barrels to the source of the ever growing sponge and burn it down. All of it. There should be at least five locations. Are you up for that?
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_13: [EN] The gnomes say that these creatures seem to thrive on mushroom sponges. But not only that, apparently they also lay eggs in their own cadavers to breed even faster. ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_14: [EN] Yes, disgusting. I guess it provides everything their offspring needs... well, we probably shouldn't go into that much further. Instead we should focus on preventing that from happening. ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_15: [EN] If I understood that correctly, the gnomes 'grew' a device to completely neutralise diremaw corpses. Acting as a very effective counter measure. ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_16: [EN] A lot of corpses are lying around wherever these creatures are being hunted. Now all we need are, you guessed it, volunteers to clean up as many of those remains as possible ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_18: [EN] The gnomes say that these creatures seem to thrive on mushroom sponges. But not only that, apparently they also lay eggs in their own cadavers to breed even faster. ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_19: [EN] Yes, disgusting. I guess it provides everything their offspring needs... well, we probably shouldn't go into that much further. Instead we should focus on preventing that from happening. ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_2: [EN] This vermin is somehow attracted to this sponge, my guess is they use it as a nourishment, too. We need to get rid of the stuff regularly to reduce their numbers to a manageable level. ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_20: [EN] If I understood that correctly, the gnomes 'grew' a device to completely neutralise diremaw corpses. Acting as a very effective counter measure. ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_21: [EN] A lot of corpses are lying around wherever these creatures are being hunted. Now all we need are, you guessed it, volunteers to clean up as many of those remains as possible ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_3: [EN] We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_4: [EN] We built an iron fence around it and added a mechanism to quickly get barrel if need be. Then an... accident happened to our guard down there and ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_5: [EN] Well, to make a long story short, the barrels are unguarded right now and the diremaws are now too numerous and we are in desperate need of volunteers. ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_6: [EN] We need someone to take those barrels to the source of the ever growing sponge and burn it down. All of it. There should be at least five locations. Are you up for that?
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_7: [EN] I can't explain that stuff, even the gnomes don't know what grows in those caves. All we know is that this stuff brought about all the diremaws we are now facing. ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_8: [EN] This vermin is somehow attracted to this sponge, my guess is they use it as a nourishment, too. We need to get rid of the stuff regularly to reduce their numbers to a manageable level. ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_9: [EN] We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.say_1: [EN] You want to offer {} suspicious device{}. Which leader shall have it, (Gnomus) of the {gnomes}, (Klom Stonecutter) of the {dwarves} or the {scouts} (Lardoc Bashsmite)?
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.say_11: Du har inte tillräckligt med misstänkta enheter.
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.say_13: Du har inte tillräckligt med misstänkta enheter.
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.say_15: Du har inte tillräckligt med misstänkta enheter.
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.say_16: [EN] So you want to know what we all think about your deeds? What leader's opinion are you interested in, the {gnomes} (Gnomus), the {dwarves} (Klom Stonecutter) or the {scouts} (Lardoc Bashsmite)?
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.say_2: Tomtarna är fortfarande i behov av din hjälp, medlem av Bigfoot's Brigade. Bevisa ditt värde genom att svara på deras samtal! ({}/10)
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.say_3: Dvärgarna är fortfarande i behov av din hjälp, medlem av Bigfoot's Brigade. Bevisa ditt värde genom att svara på deras samtal! ({}/10)
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.say_4: Scouterna är fortfarande i behov av din hjälp, medlem av Bigfoot's Brigade. Bevisa ditt värde genom att svara på deras samtal! ({}/10)
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.say_5: Jag behöver inte din hjälp just nu. Kom tillbaka senare.
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.say_6: [EN] You did a great job out there, the stuff will continue to grow, however. Return to me later for more work.
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.say_7: [EN] Noted. Now, get down there and rain some fire on them.
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.say_8: Om du ger mig några misstänkta anordningar på varelser du dödar här, ska jag göra det värt mödan genom att berätta för de andra om din generositet. Hur många vill du erbjuda?
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.stdmod_1: [EN] Here's the situation: a tide of hazardous bugs, the gnomes named them {diremaws}, threatens our base. Then there is some kind of {growth} which seems connected to them somehow. We need to get rid of both.
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.stdmod_2: [EN] Bashsmite. That's all you need to know.
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.stdmod_3:
[EN] You're already known amongst the gnomes, member of the Bigfoot Brigade. I will make sure that the alliance learns of your deeds but you'll still need to help the dwarves and gnomes of this outpost to show your worth. ... \z
	We also found suspicious devices carried by all kinds of creatures down here. Down here, they are of extreme worth to us since they could contain the key to what's happening all around us. ...  \z
	If you can aquire any, return them to me and I make sure to tell the others of your generosity. Return to me afterwards to check on your current {status}.
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.stdmod_4:
[EN] Leading the charge! It's a war down here. I maintain the outer defences and supplies which are organised back in Kazordoon and also by the gnomes. ... \z
	I have sealed some of the areas far too dangerous for anyone to enter. If you can prove you're capable, you'll get an oportunity to help destroying the weird machines, pumping lava into the caves leading to the most dangerous enemies. \z
	But even if we knew nothing more about them, the fact alone that they employ the help of those mockeries of all things dwarfish, marks them as an enemy of the dwarves and it's our obligation to annihilate them.
npc.lazaran.greet_msg_1: [EN] Me greet. You no enemy of tribe.
npc.lazaran.multi_1: [EN] You well did! Great hunt is under best signs now. We prepare weapons and paint faces and then go! ...
npc.lazaran.multi_2: [EN] No no, you no need to help us. But can prepare afterparty! Little men sent us stuff some time ago. Was strange water in there. Brown and stinky! But when we tried all tribe became veeeeeeery happy. ...
npc.lazaran.multi_3: [EN] Now brown water is gone and we sad! Can you bring POT of brown water for party after great hunt? Just bring to me and me trade for shiny treasure.
npc.lazaran.multi_4: [EN] You brought back skull of first leader. Hero of tribe! But we more missions to do. ...
npc.lazaran.multi_5: [EN] Me and Ulala talk about land outside. We wanting to see more of land! Land over big water! But us no can leave tribe. No can cross water. Only way is skull of first leader. ...
npc.lazaran.multi_6: [EN] What holy skull sees, tribe sees. That we believe. Can you bring holy skull over big water and show places?
npc.lazaran.multi_7: [EN] Big problem we have! Skull of first leader gone. He ancestor of whole tribe but died long ago in war. We have keep his skull on our sacred place. ...
npc.lazaran.multi_8: [EN] Then one night, green men came with wolves... and one of wolves took skull and ran off chewing on it! We need back - many wisdom and power is in skull. Maybe they took to north fortress. But can be hard getting in. You try get our holy skull back?
npc.lazaran.say_1: [EN] Me people wanting {peace}. No war with others. No war with {little men}. We few. We weak. Need {help}. We not wanting make {war}. No hurt.
npc.lazaran.say_11: [EN] Here take holy skull. You bring where you think is good. See as much as possible! See where other people live!
npc.lazaran.say_12: [EN] We make big ritual soon and learn much about world outside. Me thank you many times for teaching us world. Very wise and adventurous you are!
npc.lazaran.say_13: [EN] The skull have not seen all yet!
npc.lazaran.say_14: [EN] We need to calm and make happy gods. Best go to Ulala. She is priest of us and can tell what needs doing.
npc.lazaran.say_15: [EN] We make big ritual soon and learn much about world outside. Me thank you many times for teaching us world. Very wise and adventurous you are!
npc.lazaran.say_16: [EN] You do not have the brown strange water!
npc.lazaran.say_17: [EN] Me have many small task, but also big {mission}. You say what want.
npc.lazaran.say_18: [EN] Many mighty monster rule land. We fight. We lose. We flee to mountain to hide.
npc.lazaran.say_19: [EN] We come and see little men. They like us, only very little. They having good weapon and armor, like the greens.
npc.lazaran.say_2: [EN] Oh! You found holy skull? In bone pile you found?! Thank Pandor you brought! Me can have it back?
npc.lazaran.say_3: [EN] You say you was to where sun is hot and burning? And where trees grow as high as mountain? And where Fasuon cries white tears? Me can't wait to see!! Can have holy skull back?
npc.lazaran.say_4: [EN] We been weak for too long! We prepare for great hunt. But still need many doings! You can help us?
npc.lazaran.say_5: [EN] You bring us big pot of strange water from little men?
npc.lazaran.say_6: [EN] Me people wanting peace. No war with others. No war with little men.
npc.lazaran.say_7: [EN] You mean you want help us?
npc.lazaran.say_8: [EN] You hero of our tribe if bring back holy skull!
npc.lazaran.say_9: [EN] Me thank you much! All wisdom safe again now.
npc.lea.stdmod_1: [EN] I am the archsorcerer of Carlin. I keep the secrets of our order.
npc.lea.stdmod_3: [EN] Sorry, I only sell spells to sorcerers.
npc.lea.stdmod_4: [EN] Time is a force we sorcerers will master one day.
npc.lea.stdmod_5: [EN] Any sorcerer dedicates his whole life to the study of the arcane arts.
npc.lea.stdmod_6: [EN] We sorcerers wield arcane powers beyond comprehension of men.
npc.lea.stdmod_7: [EN] We sorcerers wield arcane powers beyond comprehension of men.
npc.lector.sendtrade_msg_1: [EN] Of course, take a good look at my meat.
npc.lector.stdmod_1: [EN] I can offer you ham or meat. If you'd like to check the quality of my wares, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.lee_delle.greet_msg_1: [EN] Nice to see you, |PLAYERNAME|! Ask me for a {trade} if you like to see my exclusive offers.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_1: [EN] Ask me if you need help!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_10: [EN] There are many merchants in this village. Just ask them for a {trade} to see their offers. But I can promise you - my offers are the best around!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_11: [EN] I'm fine. I'm delighted to welcome you as my customer.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_12: [EN] What kind of information do you need? I could tell you about different topics such as {equipment}, {monsters} or {Rookgaard} in general.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_13: [EN] How can I help you? Would you like to {trade} with me? I can also give you general {hints}. Or just ask me anything you'd like to know.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_14: [EN] You should really take some time and travel around the marvellous areas of Tibia. There's everything - ice islands, deserts, jungles and mountains!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_15: [EN] The temple is the place to go when you are very low on {health} or poisoned. Ask {Cipfried} for a heal - he usually notices emergencies by himself.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_16: [EN] Health potions will heal you for about 75 hit points. It can't hurt to carry one with you, just in case.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_17: [EN] Well, very important equipment would be a {backpack}, a {rope}, a {shovel}, a {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}. Maybe also a torch if you're heading into a dark {dungeon}.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_18: [EN] I sell fishing rods and worms in case you want to go fishing. Simply ask me for a {trade}.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_19: [EN] You could check out which weapons I offer by asking me for a {trade}. Don't be shy!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_2: [EN] Buy and sell everything you want here!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_20: [EN] Oh, I'm sorry, that's one of the things I don't have for sale. But {Willie} or {Billy} surely have something to eat for you.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_21: [EN] The king supports our little village very much!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_22: [EN] In the academy you can get a lot of information from books. You can also try out a few things by yourself.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_23: [EN] Isn't it lovely here? You'll be surprised once you reach the {mainland} -  so much to explore!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_24: [EN] Well, the mainland also consists of several continents. You can go there once you've reached level 8 and talked to the {oracle}.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_25: [EN] Good monsters to start with are rats. They live in the {sewers} under the village of {Rookgaard}.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_26: Be mig bara om en {trade} för att se vad jag köper av dig.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_27: [EN] Be careful down there! Make sure you bought enough {torches} and a {rope} or you might get lost.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_28: [EN] There are many sewer entrances throughout Rookgaard. If you want to know more details about monsters and dungeons, best talk to one of the guards.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_29: [EN] Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers. Apart from that, I also sell {footballs}.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_3: [EN] No need to run from shop to shop, my place is all that's needed!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_30: [EN] I really love flowers. My favourites are {honey flowers}. Sadly, they are very rare on this isle. If you can find one for me, I'll give you a little reward.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_31: [EN] You could check out which armors or shields I offer by asking me for a {trade}. Don't be shy!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_32: [EN] Yes, I'm selling that. Simply ask me for a {trade} to view all my offers.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_33: Nåväl, inget guld, ingen affär. Tjäna guld genom att slåss mot {monsters} och plocka upp sakerna de bär. Sälj den till {merchants} för att tjäna pengar!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_34: [EN] He sells {weapons}. However, I can offer you better deals than him!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_35: [EN] I'm glad she stopped selling stuff. There was too much of a competition going on!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_36: [EN] Sometimes, I see him walking outside the village near some hole.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_37: Han ägnade sitt liv åt att välkomna nykomlingar till denna ö.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_38: Stackars gumman, hennes son {Tom} besöker henne aldrig.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_39: [EN] Al Dee has a general {equipment} store in the north-western part of the village.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_40: [EN] She lives under the {academy}. Always nice to chat with her!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_41: [EN] He's a local farmer. If you need fresh {food} to regain health, it's a good place to go. He's only trading with premium adventurers, though.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_42: [EN] He's a local farmer. If you need fresh {food} to regain your health, it's a good place to go. However, many monsters carry also food such as meat. Or you could simply pick {blueberries}.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_43: [EN] Visiting Cipfried in the {temple} is a good idea if you are injured or poisoned. He can heal you.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_44: [EN] She's {Obi's} granddaughter and deals with {armors} and {shields}, just as I do.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_45: Han stannar mest för sig själv. Han är en eremit utanför staden - lycka till att hitta honom.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_46: [EN] She buys all {blueberries} and {cookies} you can find.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_47: [EN] You can find the oracle on the top floor of the {academy}, just above {Seymour}. Go there when you are level 8 to reach more areas of {Tibia}.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_48: [EN] He is the {bank} clerk, just below the academy.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_49: [EN] Seymour is a teacher running the {academy}. He has a lot of important {information} about Tibia.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_50: Han är den lokala garvaren. Du kan försöka sälja färska lik eller läder till honom.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_51: [EN] He is a great warrior and our protector.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_52: Vill du köpa en fotboll för 111 guld?
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_6: [EN] I'm a merchant. If you like to see my offers, just ask me for a {trade}.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_8: [EN] Well, it's a good idea to leave most of your money in the bank and only take what you need. That way your gold is safe.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_9: [EN] Oh no! I've got to watch what I eat. {Lily} loves cookies, though.
npc.lee_delle.voice_1: [EN] Ask me if you need help!
npc.lee_delle.voice_2: [EN] Buy and sell everything you want here!
npc.lee_delle.voice_3: [EN] No need to run from shop to shop, my place is all that's needed!
npc.leeland.say_1: [EN] Oh yes, that project the whole dwarven community is so excited about. I guess I already know why you are here, but speak up.
npc.leeland.say_2: [EN] Oh yes, that project the whole dwarven community is so excited about. I guess I already know why you are here, but speak up. Do you want to try again?
npc.leeland.say_3: [EN] Your pathetic whimpering amuses me. For this I grant you my assistance. But listen, one day I'll ask you to return this favour. From now on, you owe me one.
npc.leeland.say_5: [EN] The idea of a promising market and new resources suits us quite well. I think it is reasonable to send some assistance.
npc.leeland.say_6: [EN] Oh yes, that project the whole dwarven community is so excited about. I guess I already know why you are here, but speak up.
npc.leeland.say_7: [EN] Oh yes, that project the whole dwarven community is so excited about. I guess I already know why you are here, but speak up.
npc.legola.stdmod_1: [EN] Teaching paladin spells! Just come to me!
npc.legola.voice_1: [EN] Teaching paladin spells! Just come to me!
npc.liane.farewell_msg_1: Det var ett nöje att hjälpa dig, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.liane.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello. How may I help you |PLAYERNAME|? Ask me for a trade if you want to buy something. I can also explain the {mail} system.
npc.liane.say_1: [EN] I have more urgent problem to attend then that. Those hawks are hunting my carrier pigeons. Bring me 12 arrows and I'll see if I have the time for this nonsense. Do you have 12 arrows with you?
npc.liane.say_2: [EN] Great! Now I'll teach them a lesson ... For those measurements ... <tells you her measurements>
npc.liane.sendtrade_msg_1: Här. Glöm inte att du måste köpa en etikett också om du vill skicka ett paket. Skriv alltid namnet på {receiver} på första raden.
npc.liane.voice_2: Hej, skicka ett brev till din vän då och då. Håll kontakten, du vet.
npc.liane.voice_3: Behöver du hjälp med brev eller paket är det bara att fråga mig. Jag kan förklara allt.
npc.liane.voice_4: [EN] No, no, no, there IS no parcel bug, I'm telling you!
npc.liane.walkaway_msg_1: Det var ett nöje att hjälpa dig, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.lily.greet_msg_1: [EN] Oh hey, |PLAYERNAME|! Vascalir must have sent you to help me with a little {mission}, right?
npc.lily.greet_msg_2: [EN] Hello, |PLAYERNAME|! Back so soon? Have you delivered the herbs to Hyacinth?
npc.lily.greet_msg_3: [EN] Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! You look a little stressed today. If you like to view my offers of potions, just ask me for a {trade}. In case you're looking for the marketplace and dungeons, just follow the path to the east!
npc.lily.kw_premium_1: [EN] If you purchase premium time for your account, this opens up a lot of possibilities. ...
npc.lily.kw_premium_2: [EN] For example, you will be able to travel off the mainland, ride a mount and benefit from offline training as well as having more outfits and magic spells to choose from.
npc.lily.sendtrade_msg_1: [EN] Of course, just browse through my offers. If you buy a potion, don't forget that there's a {deposit} of 5 gold on the empty flask.
npc.lily.stdmod_1: [EN] Are you injured or poisoned? Get your potions here! All natural, no artificial ingredients!
npc.lily.stdmod_10: [EN] Is something... wrong? You didn't lose the herbs, did you?
npc.lily.stdmod_11: [EN] Well, at least you're honest. I can give you another sack, but only if you promise not to lose them this time. Okay?
npc.lily.stdmod_12: [EN] Phew. That's a relief. Well, don't forget to deliver them to Hyacinth! They have to be fresh to create potions.
npc.lily.stdmod_13: [EN] Oh. Well, if you change your mind, let me know.
npc.lily.stdmod_14: [EN] Just ask me for a {trade} to see what I buy from you. If you want to sell {blueberries}, ask me about them separately.
npc.lily.stdmod_15: [EN] Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers. If you want to sell {blueberries}, ask me about them separately.
npc.lily.stdmod_16: [EN] How can I help you? If you like to buy something, just ask me for a {trade}. We can also chat about {Tibia}. Or, I could give you general {hints} about the game.
npc.lily.stdmod_17: [EN] You definitely need a good {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}. Also, you should never leave for a {dungeon} without {rope}, {shovel} and {torch}.
npc.lily.stdmod_18: [EN] I'm in tune with myself and with nature. Thank you.
npc.lily.stdmod_19: [EN] I'm a {druid}, bound to the spirit of nature. My {potions} will help you if you feel bad. I also buy {blueberries} and {cookies}. Just ask me for a {trade}.
npc.lily.stdmod_2: [EN] Hey you, over there! Let's have a little chat, shall we?
npc.lily.stdmod_20: [EN] My name is Lily, like the flower. It also stands for purity, just like my {potions} are!
npc.lily.stdmod_21: [EN] It's about |TIME|. But does it really matter? Don't rush yourself and enjoy all these little moments.
npc.lily.stdmod_22: [EN] It's wise to store most of your gold at the bank below the academy. It's safer that way.
npc.lily.stdmod_23: Om du säger till mig namnet på en medborgare, ska jag berätta vad jag vet om honom eller henne.
npc.lily.stdmod_24: [EN] Antidote potions will cure {poisoning}. They also have a lovely {blueberry} taste. You only need them when you get poisoned deep down in a dungeon, else just go to the {temple} for a free heal!
npc.lily.stdmod_25: [EN] Some creatures like snakes or poison spiders can poison you. That will diminish your health over a certain amount of time, so be careful when dealing with those creatures!
npc.lily.stdmod_26: [EN] Being a druid is a wonderful profession. You control the forces of nature and can heal others.
npc.lily.stdmod_27: [EN] There are many shops around here which are owned by local {citizens}.
npc.lily.stdmod_28: [EN] The temple is just to the right. You can get a healing for free there if you are badly injured or poisoned.
npc.lily.stdmod_29: [EN] Tibia is our beautiful world, created by the gods. Being a {druid}, I'm a worshipper of {Crunor}.
npc.lily.stdmod_3: [EN] Oh, just in case you are looking for the marketplace and dungeons, just follow the path to the east.
npc.lily.stdmod_30: [EN] Crunor is the great lord of trees and the creator of all plants. Despite what some people believe, he didn't create the {monsters}, though.
npc.lily.stdmod_31: [EN] Oh, I'm sorry honey, I don't sell food. If you are hungry, visit one of the farmers {Billy} and {Willie}. I buy {blueberries} and {cookies}, though.
npc.lily.stdmod_32: [EN] I can offer you homemade {antidote} potions and small {health} potions. Ask me for a {trade} if you like to see them.
npc.lily.stdmod_33: [EN] Health potions will heal you for about 75 hit points. It can't hurt to carry one with you, just in case.
npc.lily.stdmod_34: [EN] I think Tibia would be a better place without authorities who lead others to war. Can't we just all live in peace?
npc.lily.stdmod_35: [EN] The academy is the big stone building in the town centre. If you're ready to leave Rookgaard, go there to see the {oracle}.
npc.lily.stdmod_36: [EN] Well, in this village and its surroundings you can {train} your skills until you are level 8. Then you should see the {oracle} and head to the {main} continent.
npc.lily.stdmod_37: [EN] To train your skills, simply help us {fighting} monsters.
npc.lily.stdmod_38: [EN]  If you want to fight monsters, you should get better {equipment} from the {merchants}. You should also talk to one of the bridge {guards} to find suitable monsters for you.
npc.lily.stdmod_39: För att se erbjudanden från en handlare, prata helt enkelt med honom eller henne och be om ett {trade}. De visar dig gärna sina erbjudanden och även de saker de köper av dig.
npc.lily.stdmod_4: [EN] Anyone got some cookies for me?
npc.lily.stdmod_40: [EN] The main continent is huge! The gods of Tibia created everything from great seas, deep jungles and large deserts.
npc.lily.stdmod_41: [EN] Sadly, our little village of {Rookgaard} is invaded by monsters. From the {dungeons} they creep to the surface and attack the city. We always need adventurers helping us to {fight} them.
npc.lily.stdmod_42: [EN] If you are looking for weapons, you should visit {Obi}'s shop east of here. Or, if you have a {premium} account, go to {Lee'Delle} for better offers.
npc.lily.stdmod_43: [EN] Armors? Best buy them at {Dixi}'s little counter, just upstairs from {Obi}'s shop. Or, if you have a {premium} account, go to {Lee'Delle} for better offers.
npc.lily.stdmod_44: [EN] Shields? Best buy them at {Dixi}'s little counter, just upstairs from {Obi}'s shop. Or, if you have a {premium} account, go to {Lee'Delle} for better offers.
npc.lily.stdmod_45: [EN] If you need information about the dungeons here, you should talk to one of the bridge {guards}. They will show you where to go.
npc.lily.stdmod_46: [EN] Our bridge guards are {Dallheim} and {Zerbrus}. You can find Dallheim if you follow the path to the right, then turn north at the {temple}.
npc.lily.stdmod_47: [EN] Yum, cookies! If you have some for me, just ask me for a trade.
npc.lily.stdmod_48: [EN] Earn gold by fighting {monsters} and picking up what they carry. Sell it to {merchants} to make profit!
npc.lily.stdmod_49: [EN] I will pay you 5 gold for every empty vial and potion flask. Just ask me for a {trade}.
npc.lily.stdmod_5: [EN] Do you need help? Just ask me about anything you'd like to know!
npc.lily.stdmod_50: [EN] You best buy such equipment at {Al Dee}'s store in the North of the village. Or, if you have a {premium} account, go to {Lee'Delle} for better offers.
npc.lily.stdmod_51: [EN] Oh yes, I love cookies! Will you accept 1 gold for it?
npc.lily.stdmod_53: [EN] Sorry, you do not have one.
npc.lily.stdmod_55: [EN] Oh, do you have blueberries for sale? I need them for my {antidote potion}. I give you 1 gold for 5 of them, yes?
npc.lily.stdmod_57: [EN] Oh, I'm sorry. I'm not buying less than 5 blueberries.
npc.lily.stdmod_59: [EN] He sells {weapons}. His shop is east of here.
npc.lily.stdmod_6: [EN] I'm buying all of your blueberries for my famous blueberry juice!
npc.lily.stdmod_60: [EN] I don't know what to think about all this new bar. {Rookgaard} needs a little peace!
npc.lily.stdmod_61: [EN] He used to help me gather blueberries. Then, one day, he suddenly stopped comming here. They say he went a little out of his mind.
npc.lily.stdmod_62: [EN] We tried everything to fight that cockroach plague in his cellar, but natural anti-bug potions simply won't help. I guess those roaches need to be fought with stronger weapons.
npc.lily.stdmod_7: [EN] Oh. In that case, maybe you're interested in a {trade} - I sell potions and buy a few other things.
npc.lily.stdmod_77:
[EN] That's great to hear! You see, I'm not the only potion brewer on Rookgaard. The hermit Hyacinth has his little alchemy lab outside the village. ... \z
	He's old and can't make his way into the village anymore, but needs some of the herbs that grow only around here. Could you please deliver a bag of herbs to Hyacinth?
npc.lily.stdmod_78:
[EN] Here you go, honey. I really appreciate your help. To find Hyacinth, leave the village to the north and go pretty much straight to the east. ... \z
	His little alchemy lab is on top of a mountain. I'll mark the ramp leading up on your map, here. Don't stray from the path! There are dangerous monsters roaming the island.
npc.lily.stdmod_79:
[EN] Here you go, honey. I really appreciate your help. To find Hyacinth, leave the village to the north and go pretty much straight to the east. ... \z
	His little alchemy lab is on top of a mountain. I'll mark the ramp leading up on your map, here. Don't stray from the path! There are dangerous monsters roaming the island.
npc.lily.stdmod_8: [EN] Oh. Well, if you change your mind, let me know.
npc.lily.stdmod_9: [EN] No, you haven't. If you're looking for the way to Hyacinth, just leave the village to the north and then go east. I've marked it on your map!
npc.lily.voice_1: [EN] Are you injured or poisoned? Get your potions here! All natural, no artificial ingredients!
npc.lily.voice_2: [EN] Hey you, over there! Let's have a little chat, shall we?
npc.lily.voice_3: [EN] Oh, just in case you are looking for the marketplace and dungeons, just follow the path to the east.
npc.lily.voice_4: [EN] Anyone got some cookies for me?
npc.lily.voice_5: [EN] Do you need help? Just ask me about anything you'd like to know!
npc.lily.voice_6: [EN] I'm buying all of your blueberries for my famous blueberry juice!
npc.lisander.greet_msg_1: [EN] I'd rather be left in {peace}. Keep it short.
npc.lisander.say_1: [EN] A cookie? Sure, is it for free?
npc.lisander.say_2: [EN] Whatever you have there, I think I don't want it.
npc.lisander.say_3: Errrkss - hosta - vad fan stoppade du in där? Försvinn ur min syn!
npc.lizard_tunnel_guard.spotted: [EN] The guards have spotted you. You were forcibly dragged into a small cell. It looks like you need to build another disguise.
npc.lokur.greet_msg_1: Ja? Vad kan jag göra för dig, |PLAYERNAME|? Bankaffärer kanske?
npc.lokur.say_1: Din veckobiljett är fortfarande giltig. Skulle vara slöseri med pengar att köpa en andra
npc.lokur.say_2: Vill du köpa en veckobiljett till malmvagnarna? Med den kan du resa fritt och snabbt genom Kazordoon i en vecka. Endast 250 guld. Handla?
npc.lokur.say_3: Du har inte tillräckligt med pengar.
npc.lokur.say_4: Här är din stämpel. Det kan inte överföras till en annan person och kommer att pågå en vecka från och med nu. Du får ett meddelande när du använder en malmvagn när den inte är giltig längre.
npc.lokur.say_6: [EN] Come on, I have no clue what they are. Better ask my armorer Kroox for such nonsense.Go and ask him for good ol' Lokurs measurements, he'll know.
npc.lokur.voice_1: [EN] Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Tibian Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.lorbas.say_1: [EN] You want me to eat this cookie?
npc.lorbas.say_2: Du har ingen kaka som jag vill ha.
npc.lorbas.say_3: [EN] Well, you don't mind if I play around with this antidote rune a bit ... UHHH, YOU LOU ... uhm that was so ... funny, haha ... ha. Mhm, you better leave now.
npc.lorek.stdmod_1: Söker du en passage till {0} för {1}?
npc.lorek.stdmod_3: [EN] I heard he is some scary magician or so.
npc.lorek.stdmod_4: [EN] I can travel you to west, centre, darama, chor or banuta.
npc.lorietta.greet_msg_1: Välkommen, unga |PLAYERNAME|! Om du är svårt sårad eller förgiftad kan jag {heal} dig gratis.
npc.lorietta.keyword_1: Så ta emot skyddet av ödets vändning, pilgrim.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_1: Så ta emot skyddet av ödets vändning, pilgrim.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_11: Du är sårad, mitt barn. Jag ska läka dina sår.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_12: Du ser inte så illa ut. Tyvärr, jag kan inte hjälpa dig. Men om du letar efter ytterligare skydd bör du gå på {pilgrimage} av aska eller få skyddet av {twist of fate} här.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_13: Närhelst du får ett dödligt sår skadas din livskraft och det finns en chans att du tappar bort en del av din utrustning. Med varenda av de fem {blessings} du har kommer denna skada och risken för förlust att minska.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_14: [EN] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_15: Jag ser att du fick den andliga avskärmningen i det vita blomtemplet söder om Thais.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_16: Jag kan ana att druiderna norr om Carlin har försett dig med omfamningen Tibia.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_17: Jag kan se att du fick välsignelsen av de två solarna i soltornet nära Ab'Dendriel.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_18: Jag kan ana att gnistan från Fenix ​​redan gavs till dig av dvärgprästerna av jord och eld i Kazordoon.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_19: Jag kan känna att du redan pratade med eremiten Eremo på ön Cormaya och fick denna välsignelse.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_2: Bra. Du är fri att tacka nej till mitt erbjudande.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_20: Du kan be om välsignelsen av andlig avskärmning i whiteflower-templet söder om Thais.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_21: Druiderna norr om Carlin kommer att förse dig med Tibia.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_22: Du kan be om välsignelsen av de två solarna i soltornet nära Ab'Dendriel.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_23: Fenixens gnista ges av jord- och eldens dvärgpräster i Kazordoon.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_25:
Detta är en speciell välsignelse som jag kan skänka dig när du har fått åtminstone en av de andra välsignelserna och som fungerar lite annorlunda. ... \z
	Det fungerar bara när du dödas av andra äventyrare, vilket betyder att minst hälften av skadan som ledde till din död orsakades av andra, inte av monster eller miljön. ... \z
	{twist of fate} kommer inte att minska dödsstraffet som de andra välsignelserna, utan istället hindra dig från att förlora dina andra välsignelser såväl som förlustamuletten, om du bär en. Det kostar lika mycket som de andra välsignelserna. ... \z
	Skulle du vilja få det skyddet för ett offer på |PVPBLESSCOST| guld, barn?
npc.lorietta.stdmod_4: Ah, vill du byta ut din äventyrarsten gratis?
npc.lorietta.stdmod_5: Här är du. Ta hand om dig.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_7: Ah, vill du byta ut din äventyrarsten mot 30 guld?
npc.lorietta.stdmod_8: Här är du. Ta hand om dig.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_9: Tyvärr, du har inte tillräckligt med pengar.
npc.lorietta.walkaway_msg_1: Kom ihåg: Om du är svårt sårad eller förgiftad kan jag bota dig gratis.
npc.lothar.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome to my humble hut, |PLAYERNAME|. What brings you {here}?
npc.lothar.multi_1: [EN] The stampor in the back? She's my friend, but she came to me out of her own free will. I must admit I've never managed to tame any other stampor. ...
npc.lothar.multi_2: [EN] I heard that there's some sort of voodoo magic which would allow you to summon a stampor, but I'm not a voodoo expert, so I wouldn't know.
npc.lothar.multi_3: [EN] It is said that ferocious creatures once thrived on lush islands in the far northern sea. They died aeons ago when times of great cold came and formed the icy wastes of Svargrond as we know them today. ...
npc.lothar.multi_4: [EN] Travellers from the north have told stories of these creatures, watching them from within the ice in the deepest caves, still vigilant as if frozen in time. 'Ursagrodon' they called them. ...
npc.lothar.multi_5: [EN] With tinder and some kind of fireproof vessel, you could create a device to melt the ice surrounding their remains and see for yourself what this is all about.
