npc.oldrak.multi_3: [EN] It belongs to a Daramian nobleman named 'Teme Saiyid'. I knew him well and he told me -almost augured- that someone will come who is worthy to obtain his treasure. I'm sure this 'someone' is you. Good luck in finding it!
npc.oldrak.name: [EN] My name is Oldrak.
npc.oldrak.say_1: [EN] How do you know? Did you go into the infested area?
npc.oldrak.say_10: [EN] What a pity! Let me know when you managed to get in there. Maybe I can help you when we know what we are dealing with.
npc.oldrak.say_12: [EN] Ah, the curse of the Plains of Havoc, the hidden beast, the unbeatable foe. I've been living here for years and I'm sure this is only a myth.
npc.oldrak.say_13: [EN] There are many tales about the fearsome Hugo. It's said it's an abnormality, accidentally created by Yenny the Gentle. It's half demon, half something else and people say it's still alive after all these years.
npc.oldrak.say_14: [EN] Yenny, known as the Gentle, was one of the most powerful wielders of magic in ancient times. She was known throughout the world for her mercy and kindness.
npc.oldrak.say_15: [EN] Would you like to buy a The Holy Tible for 1000 gold?
npc.oldrak.say_16: [EN] You need to complete the quest for the book first before you can buy The Holy Tible.
npc.oldrak.say_17: [EN] Here is your The Holy Tible.
npc.oldrak.say_18: Du har inte tillräckligt med pengar.
npc.oldrak.say_2: [EN] You better don't return here until you've defeated the Demon Oak.
npc.oldrak.say_3: [EN] A demon oak?!? <mumbles some blessings> May the gods be on our side. You'll need a {hallowed axe} to harm that tree. Bring me a simple {axe} and I'll prepare it for you.
npc.oldrak.say_4: [EN] I don't believe a word of it! How rude to lie to a monk!
npc.oldrak.say_5: [EN] Ahh, you've got an axe. Very good. I can make a hallowed axe out of it. It will cost you... er... a donation of 1,000 gold. Alright?
npc.oldrak.say_6: [EN] You have to first talk about {demon oak} or the {mission} before we continue.
npc.oldrak.say_7: [EN] Let's see....<mumbles a prayer>....here we go. The blessing on this axe will be absorbed by all the demonic energy around here. I presume it will not last very long, so better hurry. Actually, I can refresh the blessing as often as you like.
npc.oldrak.say_8: [EN] There is no axe with you.
npc.oldrak.say_9: [EN] There is not enough of money with you.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_1: [EN] This ancient order was created by a circle of wise humans who were called 'The {Dreamers}'. The order became {extinct} a long time ago.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_10: [EN] That's where we are. The world of Tibia.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_11: [EN] They created Tibia and all life on it ... and unlife, too.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_14: [EN] A weapon of myth and legend. It was lost in ancient times ... perhaps lost forever.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_15: [EN] Yenny, known as the Gentle, was one of most powerfull magicwielders in ancient times and known throughout the world for her mercy and kindness.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_16: [EN] I can offer you the holy tible for a small fee.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_17: [EN] I can offer you the holy tible for a small fee.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_18: [EN] I can offer you the holy tible for a small fee.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_19: [EN] I can offer you the holy tible for a small fee.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_2: [EN] Many perished in their battles against evil, some went mad, not able to stand their nightmares any longer. Others were seduced by the darkness.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_20: [EN] I can offer you the holy tible for a small fee.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_3: [EN] They learned the ancient art of {dreamwalking} from some elves they befriended.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_4: [EN] While the dreamwalkers of the elves experienenced the brightest dreams of pleasure, the humans strangely had dreams of {dark omen}.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_5: [EN] They dreamed of doom, destruction, talked to dead, tormented souls, and gained unwanted insight into the {schemes of darkness}.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_6: [EN] They figured out how to interpret their dark dreams and so could foresee the plans of the dark gods and their minions.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_7: [EN] Using this knowledge they formed an order to thwart these plans, and because they battled their nightmares as brave as knights, they named their order accordingly.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_8: [EN] It is rumoured to open the entrance to the pits of inferno, also called the nightmare pits. Even if I knew about this secret I wouldn't tell you.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_9: [EN] Before the battles raged across them, they were called the fair plains.
npc.oldrak.walkaway_msg_1: [EN] Take care, it's dangerous out there.
npc.oliver.say_1: [EN] Nobody knows the trouble I've seen .. <tells a quite detailed report>.
npc.oliver.say_2: [EN] You can {pass} either to the {Factory Quarter} or {Sunken Quarter}. Which one will it be?
npc.olrik.farewell_msg_1: Det var ett nöje att hjälpa dig, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.olrik.greet_msg_1: Hej. Hur kan jag hjälpa dig |PLAYERNAME|? Be mig om en {trade} om du vill köpa något. Jag kan också förklara {mail}-systemet.
npc.olrik.say_1: [EN] Ok, here we go ... {}! You lose! Try again.
npc.olrik.sendtrade_msg_1: Här. Glöm inte att du måste köpa en etikett också om du vill skicka ett paket. Skriv alltid namnet på {receiver} på första raden.
npc.omrabas.greet_msg_1: [EN] At last, a visitor! Welcome to my... humble abode. {Scroll} or {mission}?
npc.omrabas.multi_1: [EN] I knew it! I knew I had made a copy! Oh, I am so clever! ...
npc.omrabas.multi_10: [EN] Beneath one of the chests is a secret stash, under a loose stone tile. The scroll piece should be inside. Off you go.
npc.omrabas.multi_100: [EN] We are close now. Only one important thing remains: the incantation itself. We need the {scroll} for that.
npc.omrabas.multi_101: [EN] Ah, finally. Exceptional! Don't you feel the earth awakening to our call? No? Oh. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_102: [EN] Anyway, you succeeded in hallowing the Fireglass Altar! Only one altar remains to be hallowed! Shall we {proceed}?
npc.omrabas.multi_103: [EN] Ah, it is invigorating to fell the dark flows, rushing through Drefia, once again! Capital. This has earned you a reward. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_105: [EN] Yes, I said blood. Important ingredient in necromantic rituals, usually. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_106: [EN] You need to spill some vials of blood tincture for this task. Probably means killing blood priests to get those vials. Ready to do this?
npc.omrabas.multi_107: [EN] Ah, welcome, welcome! I felt that one! The Dark Lord is pleased with the gift you brought, so now we can proceed with everything as planned. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_108: [EN] If it had gone wrong though, he would have had your guts for gart... er... well, here you are, so - ready to get some {blood} flowing?
npc.omrabas.multi_109: [EN] Are you still here? Come on, let's not laze about, go to the Gardens of Night - where? ...
npc.omrabas.multi_11: [EN] Hah, developed a taste for it, have you? I believe the next scroll piece was hidden somewhere, my old friend being of a somewhat distrustful nature. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_110: [EN] East of the Necromancer Halls, you can't miss it, just look for a lot of dark and white sand, dried trees, and priestesses! ...
npc.omrabas.multi_111: [EN] Or got a {problem} with finding bones? Hah!
npc.omrabas.multi_112: [EN] I expected no less. Next is the Bonemarrow Altar, where the Dark Lord feasts upon the hallowed bones of...err. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_113: [EN] Ahem. Just take a yellowed bone or big bone, and hallow it - you don't know how? ...
npc.omrabas.multi_114: [EN] Huh. To HALLOW a yellowed bone, use it with one of the hallowed bonepiles in the Gardens Of Night. There are always bones around there - or were, in my days. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_115: [EN] Then, place the hallowed bone on the firebasin of the Bonemarrow Altar so the Dark Lord can consume it and grants us his power. Return to me after that.
npc.omrabas.multi_116: [EN] Good. As you may have gathered, the body parts you brought need to be assembled to form a whole body. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_117: [EN] This will happen through a necromantic ritual that we - or rather, you - now have to prepare. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_118: [EN] In a first step, it will involve retrieving specific artefacts of dark magic and hallowing the altars of the dark powers with them. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_119: [EN] After that, you will have to speak an ancient incantation to animate the body and fuse my soul within. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_12: [EN] The scent may not be lost, though - ask a shadow pupil if he can help - but be careful. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_120: [EN] But first things first. Are you ready to {undertake} the hallowing of the five altars?
npc.omrabas.multi_121: [EN] Now that you have shown you've got the brains, I need you to show initiative. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_122: [EN] I will need something that can be adequately used as intestines. Something alive. Stuff it into this storage flask and return it to me!
npc.omrabas.multi_123: [EN] I will need brains - don't laugh! Ahem. I will need a stimulated brain, to be precise. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_124: [EN] Use two half-eaten brains with the Brain Heater Machine in the Necromancer halls and bring me the fused, stimulated brain. Now go!
npc.omrabas.multi_125: [EN] Yes? You have it? You what? Not in the amphoras? You picked it off someone else?!? ...
npc.omrabas.multi_126: [EN] Well, the important thing is that you have it. Let's see if it's still in good shape. {Give} it to me.
npc.omrabas.multi_127: [EN] I need my heart back. I know where they have hidden it. Too afraid to destroy my beating heart, hah! ...
npc.omrabas.multi_128: [EN] It is in a dusty amphora in a sealed mass grave in the downmost cellar of my ancient home. The ruins lie to the north at the beach. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_129: [EN] Crash the amphoras to find my heart, and bring it to me.
npc.omrabas.multi_13: [EN] Those shadow pupils are - strange. Try to find one who will answer and not kill you!
npc.omrabas.multi_14: [EN] Oh, praise the Dark Lord! It is my scroll piece! Give it here! You can have this instead. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_15: [EN] Ahh, that feels GOOD. Now, only two pieces left to hunt down! On to the {next} scroll piece, yes?
npc.omrabas.multi_16: [EN] Well, it is a rather long story. The short version: I had friends - no need to snigger. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_17: [EN] We were five highly brilliant dark summoners. We joined our forces to find the scroll of Youth and Life Eternal. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_18: [EN] But when we finally found it after years of toiling and danger, we quarreled over who could have it. The scroll tore. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_19: [EN] We each retained one piece of the scroll. Well, that was a long time ago. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_2: [EN] Now, watch this. <mumbles darkly> THERE. THE COMPLETE INCANTATION SCROLL. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_20: [EN] But I think I have a clue where we can find the first piece of the scroll. Would you go looking?
npc.omrabas.multi_21: [EN] <reverential> The final altar that remains to be hallowed... the Shadowthrone. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_22: [EN] Only a candle made of human tallow placed before each shadow statue in the right order, will awaken it. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_23: [EN] I say, are you sick? Human tallow candles are a perfectly good tool - don't look at me like that! Be professional about this, will you? ...
npc.omrabas.multi_24: [EN] I have some candles hidden deep down in the lich caves, east of here. Here's the key that opens the trapdoor to the cache. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_25: [EN] And take this parchment. Identify the right candles with it, take three with you and place one in front of the three shadowthrone statues, starting counterclockwise. Now go!
npc.omrabas.multi_26: [EN] Yes, I said blood. Important ingredient in necromantic rituals, usually. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_27: [EN] You need to spill some vials of blood tincture for this task. Probably means killing blood priests to get those vials. Ready to do this?
npc.omrabas.multi_28: [EN] I expected no less. Next is the Bonemarrow Altar, where the Dark Lord feasts upon the hallowed bones of...err. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_29: [EN] Ahem. Just take a yellowed bone or big bone, and hallow it - you don't know how? ...
npc.omrabas.multi_3: [EN] You have done well. Only one thing remains, and you shall be rich beyond your dreams. Ready for the really final task?
npc.omrabas.multi_30: [EN] Huh. To HALLOW a yellowed bone, use it with one of the hallowed bonepiles in the Gardens Of Night. There are always bones around there - or were, in my days. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_31: [EN] Then, place the hallowed bone on the firebasin of the Bonemarrow Altar so the Dark Lord can consume it and grants us his power. Return to me after that.
npc.omrabas.multi_32: [EN] Good! Let's not waste time. The first altar you must hallow is the Dragonsoul Altar, at the eastern side of the room. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_33: [EN] To hallow it, dig out three dragon tears and place them on the altar to appease the dark powers. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_34: [EN] What? Oh, you'll find some dragon tears near dragon skulls... where? ...
npc.omrabas.multi_35: [EN] In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
npc.omrabas.multi_36: [EN] Then let's go. Take my skull and the incantation scroll to the working station in the fiveserrated room ...
npc.omrabas.multi_37: [EN] Where the lava flows and the southern legs of the room meet. Place the Skull on the sacrificial stone and use the scroll ...
npc.omrabas.multi_38: [EN] AND I shall be made whole, and YOU shall be RICH!
npc.omrabas.multi_39: [EN] I am so excited! Finally, we - wait. What is this? That... is not the complete scroll piece. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_4: [EN] Hahah, eager for it, I like that! ...
npc.omrabas.multi_40: [EN] I don't care what you say! This is a disaster! We need a complete scr - wait. I have an idea. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_41: [EN] There must be a copy or something in my old library. something to use with the scroll, to find the missing words. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_42: [EN] There must be. Go look there. Next to the fiveserrated room, a small library. Go go go!
npc.omrabas.multi_43: [EN] That's the spirit! Speaking of which, you will have to look for a White Shade ...
npc.omrabas.multi_44: [EN] That's a ghost, in case you don't know. Goes by name of... Zarifan, if I recall correctly. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_45: [EN] His grave is somewhere to the south, somewhere deeper. And he only reacts to magic words. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_46: [EN] Err... it's embarrassing... the magic words are <mumble> <mumble> <ahem> ...
npc.omrabas.multi_47: [EN] 'Friendship lives forever.' Silly, really. Untrue, as well. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_48: [EN] Anyway, say those three words - don't make me repeat them - and the old softie will tell you where the scroll is. Pathetic.
npc.omrabas.multi_49: [EN] Ahhh, capital, capital. Good girl for keeping it for me. I'll take back my cape now, thank you. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_5: [EN] One piece stayed in the hands of a beautiful priestess. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_50: [EN] Now - the final part of the scroll! Ready to go retrieve it?
npc.omrabas.multi_51: [EN] Hahah, eager for it, I like that! ...
npc.omrabas.multi_52: [EN] One piece stayed in the hands of a beautiful priestess. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_53: [EN] As they never throw anything away that looks like an incantation - you get my drift. Find out where they still keep it! ...
npc.omrabas.multi_54: [EN] Oh, one more thing! They only talk to you when you look like a fellow summoner. It's dangerous to go without a cape. Use this.
npc.omrabas.multi_55: [EN] Oh, praise the Dark Lord! It is my scroll piece! Give it here! You can have this instead. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_56: [EN] Ahh, that feels GOOD. Now, only two pieces left to hunt down! On to the {next} scroll piece, yes?
npc.omrabas.multi_57: [EN] Good! As you can imagine, I had a scroll piece, too. I hid it in my old quarters, northwest of the library. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_58: [EN] The door is magically sealed. Use this copper key with it to get inside. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_59: [EN] Beneath one of the chests is a secret stash, under a loose stone tile. The scroll piece should be inside. Off you go.
npc.omrabas.multi_6: [EN] As they never throw anything away that looks like an incantation - you get my drift. Find out where they still keep it! ...
npc.omrabas.multi_60: [EN] Hah, developed a taste for it, have you? I believe the next scroll piece was hidden somewhere, my old friend being of a somewhat distrustful nature. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_61: [EN] The scent may not be lost, though - ask a shadow pupil if he can help - but be careful. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_62: [EN] Those shadow pupils are - strange. Try to find one who will answer and not kill you!
npc.omrabas.multi_63: [EN] Superb! You won't regret this. I will reward you beyond your wildest dreams! ...
npc.omrabas.multi_64: [EN] I know that one of my former friends joined the blood priests later on. He made it quite high before he was ritually killed. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_65: [EN] Go find a blood priest you can talk to. Ask him, but subtly. And never tell anyone what the scroll does!
npc.omrabas.multi_66: [EN] Excellent. To bind the earthly powers, we, I mean you, must worship at the Fireglass Altar. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_67: [EN] This means scattering sacred ashes from the Ember Chamber on the sacrificial stones of the Fireglass Altar. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_68: [EN] To gather the sacred ashes, you have to use magic chalk with the Shadow Fire in the Ember Chamber. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_69: [EN] Gather the resulting ashes from the Shadow Hearth, and scatter them on the Fireglass Altar's sacrificial stones. Then return here.
npc.omrabas.multi_7: [EN] Oh, one more thing! They only talk to you when you look like a fellow summoner. It's dangerous to go without a cape. Use this.
npc.omrabas.multi_70: [EN] Ah, I knew you were a sturdy fellow! Necromancer material if ever I saw one! ...
npc.omrabas.multi_71: [EN] Well then, the next task is to anoint the Bloodgong Altar. This will animate the dark flows we need for the ritual. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_72: [EN] You need to spill a vial of blood tincture on each of the four sacrifical stones of the altar in order to anoint them. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_73: [EN] Then, toll the Bloodgong north of the sacrificial stones to set the dark flows going. Return to me after that.
npc.omrabas.multi_74: [EN] Ah... interesting. A snake? Not bad, not bad at all. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_75: [EN] Right. Now, we need to waken the old powers through ritual. Let me know when you are ready for this {mission}.
npc.omrabas.multi_76: [EN] Very sensible of you. I will pay you handsomely for your help. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_77: [EN] All you have to do is fetch diverse fresh body parts and then prepare the resurrection ritual. Nothing out of the ordinary. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_78: [EN] First, I need two arms. Ghouls usually carry some as a snack. Two ghoul snacks should not be hard to get! Return when you have them.
npc.omrabas.multi_79: [EN] It failed! IT FAILED! WHY? What have you done! This must be your fault! ...
npc.omrabas.multi_8: [EN] Good! As you can imagine, I had a scroll piece, too. I hid it in my old quarters, northwest of the library. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_80: [EN] You... did... that was a recipe for chicken soup! No wonder the scroll failed! Now... all is lost ...
npc.omrabas.multi_81: [EN] <sobs drily> I never want to see you again! You and your dirty gravedigger hands! Take this, you ungrateful, useless, imbecile... human! ...
npc.omrabas.multi_82: [EN] Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
npc.omrabas.multi_83: [EN] That's the spirit! Speaking of which, you will have to look for a White Shade ...
npc.omrabas.multi_84: [EN] That's a ghost, in case you don't know. Goes by name of... Zarifan, if I recall correctly. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_85: [EN] His grave is somewhere to the south, somewhere deeper. And he only reacts to magic words. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_86: [EN] Err... it's embarrassing... the magic words are <mumble> <mumble> <ahem> ...
npc.omrabas.multi_87: [EN] 'Friendship lives forever.' Silly, really. Untrue, as well. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_88: [EN] Anyway, say those three words - don't make me repeat them - and the old softie will tell you where the scroll is. Pathetic.
npc.omrabas.multi_89: [EN] Hahah, eager for it, I like that! ...
npc.omrabas.multi_9: [EN] The door is magically sealed. Use this copper key with it to get inside. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_90: [EN] One piece stayed in the hands of a beautiful priestess. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_91: [EN] As they never throw anything away that looks like an incantation - you get my drift. Find out where they still keep it! ...
npc.omrabas.multi_92: [EN] Oh, one more thing! They only talk to you when you look like a fellow summoner. It's dangerous to go without a cape. Use this.
npc.omrabas.multi_93: [EN] Good! As you can imagine, I had a scroll piece, too. I hid it in my old quarters, northwest of the library. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_94: [EN] The door is magically sealed. Use this copper key with it to get inside. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_95: [EN] Beneath one of the chests is a secret stash, under a loose stone tile. The scroll piece should be inside. Off you go.
npc.omrabas.multi_96: [EN] Hah, developed a taste for it, have you? I believe the next scroll piece was hidden somewhere, my old friend being of a somewhat distrustful nature. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_97: [EN] The scent may not be lost, though - ask a shadow pupil if he can help - but be careful. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_98: [EN] Those shadow pupils are - strange. Try to find one who will answer and not kill you!
npc.omrabas.multi_99: [EN] Yes! YES! I have felt that! The altars are alive again! Well done! ...
npc.omrabas.say_1: [EN] Hmm. You could be of assistance, I presume. I need several body parts. I will reward you adequately. Interested?
npc.omrabas.say_10: [EN] Hello - what? You have the {scroll} piece, you say?
npc.omrabas.say_11: [EN] Hello, young apprentice. Do you have that {scroll} piece from the priestess?
npc.omrabas.say_12: [EN] Don't keep me waiting. The last scroll piece - were you able to {restore} it?
npc.omrabas.say_13: [EN] Splendid! What? They're half gnawed! There are no hands! Hrmmm. Let me think of a solution. Ask me for a new {mission}.
npc.omrabas.say_14: [EN] You don't have two ghoul snacks.
npc.omrabas.say_15: [EN] Yes. Those will be adequate. Talk to me again if you want to continue with your next {mission}.
npc.omrabas.say_16: [EN] You don't have two demonic skeletal hands.
npc.omrabas.say_17: [EN] Ah... <sighs> Very good. Just say the word when you are ready for the next {mission}.
npc.omrabas.say_19: [EN] Ah... <sighs> Very good. Just say the word when you are ready for the next {mission}.
npc.omrabas.say_2: [EN] Ah hello, young friend! Did you bring me two ghoul snacks as requested?
npc.omrabas.say_22: [EN] This is it! This is it! Well done, well done! And now, on to the {next} scroll piece, {yes}?
npc.omrabas.say_24: [EN] Indeed it is! The second scroll piece! Splendid! Here you go - for your trouble. And now, on to the {next} scroll piece, {yes}?
npc.omrabas.say_29: [EN] What? Hack some off from a demon skeleton, of course! Now get moving.
npc.omrabas.say_3: [EN] Ah, young friend, I found a solution! Find me two {demonic skeletal hands}. That should do it. Now run along! Ask me for {mission} when you're done.
npc.omrabas.say_30: [EN] Ah... <sighs> Very good. Just say the word when you are ready for the next {mission}.
npc.omrabas.say_32: [EN] What? No bones around you say? Hrmmm. Wait. Check the skull heap here - that's right - hah! There! Now get to work!
npc.omrabas.say_33: [EN] Yes? Do you have the {scroll} piece?
npc.omrabas.say_34: [EN] Ah, hello! I take it you have the next {scroll} piece for me, {yes}?
npc.omrabas.say_36: [EN] Hello, young apprentice. Do you have that {scroll} piece from the priestess?
npc.omrabas.say_37: [EN] Hello, young apprentice. Do you have that scroll piece from the priestess?
npc.omrabas.say_38: [EN] Welcome, welcome! Finally! The last {scroll} piece.... you do have it, haven't you?
npc.omrabas.say_4: [EN] Ah hello again! You look as if you could, er, lend me a hand or two? Yes?
npc.omrabas.say_5: [EN] Yes, yes, hello. Tell me if you lost something. If not, do you have that stimulated brain with you?
npc.omrabas.say_6: [EN] Hello, hello. Let's come to the point - did you find me some intestines?
npc.omrabas.say_7: [EN] Ah hello! Well done there, I felt the old powers settling down. Now, {ready} to hallow the next altar?
npc.omrabas.say_8: [EN] Yes? Do you have the {scroll} piece?
npc.omrabas.say_9: [EN] Ah, hello! I take it you have the next scroll piece for me, {yes}?
npc.omrabas.voice_2: [EN] He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
npc.omrabas.voice_4: [EN] If I ever lay hands on him again...
npc.one_eyed_joe.greet_msg_1: [EN] Well done! But know this: The cursed crystal seems to regenerate over time. It could be necessary to come back and repeat whatever you have done down there.
npc.one_eyed_joe.greet_msg_2: [EN] Hello there. I'm sorry, I hardly noticed you. I'm a bit nervous. The spooky {sounds} down there, you know
npc.one_eyed_joe.multi_1: [EN] But there are few volunteers. Often the crystal gatherers disappear and are never seen again. Other poor fellows then meet their former shipmates in the form of ghosts or skeletons. It's a {cursed} area, something evil is down there!
npc.one_eyed_joe.multi_10: [EN] At first glance it seems to be a beautiful - and precious - surrounding. But in truth, deep down in these caverns exists an old evil. Want to hear more?
npc.one_eyed_joe.multi_2: [EN] But there are few volunteers. Often the crystal gatherers disappear and are never seen again. Other poor fellows then meet their former shipmates in the form of ghosts or skeletons. It's a {cursed} area, something evil is down there!
npc.one_eyed_joe.multi_3: [EN] As for myself I haven't been down there. But I heard some disturbing rumours. In these caves are wonderful crystal formations. Some more poetically inclined fellows call them the crystal gardens. ...
npc.one_eyed_joe.multi_4: [EN] At first glance it seems to be a beautiful - and precious - surrounding. But in truth, deep down in these caverns exists an old evil. Want to hear more?
npc.one_eyed_joe.multi_5: [EN] In my humble opinion a pirate should win a fortune by boarding ships not by crawling through caves and tunnels. But who am I to bring into question the captain's decision. All I know is that they sell the crystals at a high price. ...
npc.one_eyed_joe.multi_6: [EN] A certain amount of the crystals is ground to crystal dust with a special kind of mill. Don't ask me why. Some kind of magical component perhaps that they sell to mages and sorcerers.
npc.one_eyed_joe.multi_7: [EN] The evil I mentioned is a strange crystal, imbued with some kind of unholy energy. It is very hard to destroy, no weapon is able to shatter the thing. Maybe a jarring, very loud sound could destroy it. ...
npc.one_eyed_joe.multi_8: [EN] I heard of creatures, that are able to utter ear-splitting sounds. Don't remember the name, though. Would you go down there and try to destroy the crystal?
npc.one_eyed_joe.multi_9: [EN] As for myself I haven't been down there. But I heard some disturbing rumours. In these caves are wonderful crystal formations. Some more poetically inclined fellows call them the crystal gardens. ...
npc.one_eyed_joe.say_1: [EN] Hmm. No, I don't think so. I still feel this strange prickling in my toes.
npc.one_eyed_joe.say_3: [EN] Protect your ears? Hmm ... Wasn't there some fabulous seafarer who used wax or something to plug his ears? There was a story about horrible bird-women or something ...? No, sounds like hogwash, doesn't it.
npc.one_eyed_joe.say_4: [EN] Great! Good luck and be careful down there!
npc.one_eyed_joe.say_5: [EN] I'm a pirate. Normally I'm sailing the seas, boarding other ships and gathering treasures. But at the moment my captain graciously assigned me to watch this {cursed} entrance.
npc.one_eyed_joe.say_6: [EN] I'm One-Eyed Joe. From Josephina, got that? And I regard this eye patch as a personal feature of beauty!
npc.one_eyed_joe.say_7: [EN] Good bye adventurer. It was nice to talk with you.
npc.one_eyed_joe.say_8: [EN] Ah, the brave adventurer who sought to destroy the evil crystal down there. Have you been successful?
npc.ongulf.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello, |PLAYERNAME|. You've come at a good time for our {project}.
npc.ongulf.multi_1: [EN] Oh, my! That sounds like a real mess. For now this dragon empire seems otherwise engaged, but we will be on guard thanks to you my friend. We will continue to fortify the base. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_10: [EN] If the orcs are right, they are somewhere in or behind those mountains in the north. I doubt you can reason with them in any way, but you'll have to try for the sake of Farmine.
npc.ongulf.multi_11: [EN] Our new friends, those primitive humans sent us a warning. According to them, the 'green men' of the plains plan an attack on the mountains. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_12: [EN] Considering their expected number, there is no chance for us to beat them off. We might be able to hold our ground for a while, but without access to the surface and under constant attacks, we might have to abandon the base. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_13: [EN] Now, I'm aware that you cannot stop an entire army by yourself, but desperate situations call for desperate measures. I ask you to find the leaders of the orcs and - well do something. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_14: [EN] Scare them, bribe them, give them another target or whatever. As futile as it may sound: Try to talk to their leaders in some way and make them stop their attack plans. This is our only hope.
npc.ongulf.multi_15: [EN] Things are getting more and more complicated. You need to convince our friends that some intervention for their part is needed. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_16: [EN] We've come a long way with our own resources, but now our resources are short and we need the others to step in. I want you to negotiate some more support from our partners. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_17: [EN] You'll need all your diplomacy and influence. If you blow the negotiations, look for a guy called Black Bert in Thais. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_18: [EN] He has access to all kind of odd items, and he might have just the right bribe to convince someone to continue negotiations. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_19: [EN] It will not be as easy as it might sound. So watch your words and your manners and keep in mind whom you are talking to. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_2: [EN] This leaves not much to do for you down here. I recommend you continue to explore this strange new land. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_20: [EN] Different strategies might be necessary for different people. You may try to FLATTER, THREATEN, IMPRESS, BLUFF, PLEA or to REASON with them. You probably need some luck as well. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_21: [EN] And now listen: We need more workers for the mines. The technomancers told us that a guy named Telas, who lives in Edron, copied the worker golem technology from Yalahar. Convince him to send us some of these golems. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_22: [EN] Further, we have more ore and end products than we can use right now. So we need someone to buy all the surplus. Convince Leeland Slim in Venore that the local traders step in as resellers. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_23: [EN] Another issue at hand is our lack of drilling worms. That should not be a big problem though. Just talk to the worm tamer in Kazordoon. If he does not get mad about you, there should be no problem to get his support. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_24: [EN] Also, now that our monetary resources are used up and not much cash is coming in, we need additional help to finance this venture. Thais has promised money in advance, but we haven't seen any of this support, yet. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_25: [EN] Convince the Thaian king to send us the promised money right now. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_26: [EN] Another problem we need to solve is the exploration of our surroundings. We need to know friends and enemies, and find out about the plants and beasts in the vicinity and learn what is edible and what is dangerous. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_27: [EN] This is all stuff the Explorer Society is interested in. It should be easy to convince their representative in Port Hope. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_28: [EN] At last, with the growing numbers of adventurers here, not only the security of the base is growing but also the demand for certain supplies. I'd like the Edron academy to open up a shop in the base. We need to keep you adventurers happy, don't we? ...
npc.ongulf.multi_29: [EN] Well, I hope you understand the importance of this mission and got what it takes to fulfil it. So hurry up and get us the needed support.
npc.ongulf.multi_3: [EN] I'm pretty sure there are several opportunities at hand for an adventurer like you. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_30: [EN] It seems things went from bad to worse! First we had some problems with the mine shafts we were building, and now that we found some precious veins in one of the new mines, and it happens to be the holiday resort of some hostile stone creatures! ...
npc.ongulf.multi_31: [EN] Nothing we dwarfs couldn't handle alone, but I rather thought this could be something interesting for an adventurer like you. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_32: [EN] So I reserved you the privilege to slay the leader! Use the mining lift to reach mine A07. The more stone creatures you kill, the better. Your mission, however, is to slay their leader, most likely some special stone beast.
npc.ongulf.multi_33: [EN] Primitive humans you say? These are most startling news, that's for sure. Well, I guess I'll send some victuals we can spare as a sign of our good will. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_34: [EN] However, our miners encountered another problem in the meantime. I'm afraid this will be your next {mission}
npc.ongulf.multi_35: [EN] Our guards reported some nightly visitors. They chased them through the mountains but lost them when the fugitives climbed up some vines. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_36: [EN] It could easily be some trap and I'm somewhat reluctant to send you there, but we can't allow some invisible aggressor to spy on us and maybe to prepare an attack. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_37: [EN] Find these vines in this mountain, climb up there and find out who is spying on us! If they mean harm, get rid of them if possible. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_38: [EN] If they are too powerful, just retreat and we will have to re-evaluate the situation. If they are harmless, all the better.
npc.ongulf.multi_39: [EN] Things are running fine so far. Actually so fine that we are short of supplies and men. I'd send a letter home but I guess sending you to get some assistance gives the whole affair a bit more urgency. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_4: [EN] Perhaps you can help the primitives you encountered. Who knows, maybe even those minotaurs give you a chance to fortify this fragile peace between us. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_40: [EN] So please travel back to Kazordoon. In the western mines outside of The Big Old One, you'll find Melfar of the imperial mining guild. Ask him to send some more miners and wood. When you return, I might have some more interesting missions for you.
npc.ongulf.multi_41: [EN] Listen, I can handle the organisation down here and my boys will handle the construction of the base fine enough. Actually, all you do down here is to stand in the workers' way. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_42: [EN] But there might be something for you to do outside the base. We need to learn more about the land up there. Take the lift and do some exploring. Find a passage leading out of the mountains. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_43: [EN] Do not explore any further though. You never know whom you might be messing with.
npc.ongulf.multi_44: [EN] <grumbles> Well, we have found this place here full of promising resources and plan to create a new mining outpost. Of course this takes a lot of effort and organisation. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_45: [EN] For some of the tasks at hand we need help, even from outsiders like you. So if you are interested in some missions, let me know.
npc.ongulf.multi_46: [EN] After centuries the resources beneath and around the Big Old One became alarmingly short. Some decades ago, the imperial mining guild financed a project to search and establish new mines far away from Kazordoon. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_47: [EN] After several tries with mixed success, the project of the technomancers proved the most successful. Their steamships studied and mapped the great underwater rivers deep beneath the earth. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_48: [EN] With the help of certain apparatuses, they tracked deposits of ore and compiled ship routes to reach them. These mining bases had some obvious advantages and disadvantages. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_49: [EN] The suitable spots had no connection to the surface. On the one hand, this meant that the new mines were safe from most kinds of beasts. On the other hand, it meant that all food and material had to be brought there by ship. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_5: [EN] Even some of the people here in the base might offer you some tasks sooner or later. If you prefer, you can also do some exploring, hunting and good ol' plundering on your own of course. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_50: [EN] Special, heavy ships were built to carry ore and supplies back and forth. The only limitation for such bases had been the range of the steamships. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_51: [EN] Recently, the technomancers with the help of the temples of fire and earth made some crucial discoveries that allowed the ships to extend their cruising range almost limitlessly. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_52: [EN] The survey ships of the technomancers were once again sent out to find new, promising resources. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_53: [EN] Sadly some of the ships never returned and others only found minor deposits of ore, not worth the effort. But one of the ships made some groundbreaking discovery - a cave that had a connection to the surface. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_54: [EN] As far as the explorers could tell, the area had been unknown to dwarfhood and mankind so far. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_55: [EN] What was more, the said cave system had an abundance of rare ores. The imperial mining guild agreed to fund a new project and to name it 'project far far away'. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_56: [EN] Don't look at me, I'm not the one who came up with that name! Those technomancers are such an imaginative bunch. But where have we been? Oh, yes, the new project! ...
npc.ongulf.multi_57: [EN] Well, some ships were sent to establish a first base. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_58: [EN] It became painfully obvious that the number of workers needed there could not easily be supplied by the ships alone. Also such a base would require an amount of money, expertise and manpower that the guild could not provide. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_59: [EN] We would need help and additional resources. That's were you come into play. If you are interested, let's talk about possible missions.
npc.ongulf.multi_6: [EN] This new land is yours to be taken, so to say. Go out and make your fortune! With Farmine you have always a safe haven to return to. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_60: [EN] Well, it's a long story but you really should listen to understand what is going on here. You can also hear a short version of the story, but then don't blame me if you mess something up due to your undwarfish impatience. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_61: [EN] So what would you like to hear, the {long} story or the {short} version?
npc.ongulf.multi_7: [EN] Oh and one last thing: We convinced a carpet pilot to join us here. You'll find him on top of our lift in the mountains. I think he can offer you fast access to some cities back home.
npc.ongulf.multi_8: [EN] Ooook. Now that we managed to keep those orcs and minotaurs at bay at least for a while, we learn that the real meanies over here are some lizardmen. Just great, isn't it?. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_9: [EN] So you might already guess your next mission: Find a way to hold those lizards off. Find them, contact them, talk to them, scare them, bribe them, whatever. Just keep that snakes away if anyhow possible. ...
npc.ongulf.say_1: [EN] Excellent. Although we have no idea what awaits us in this foreign land, it is always good to know something more about our surroundings.
npc.ongulf.say_2: [EN] That's good news for sure. It will give our operation a new impulse. However, only if there is not some unexpected trouble ahead. Well, we'll talk about that when we discuss your next {mission}.
npc.ongulf.say_3: [EN] Shortly after you killed that creature, the others crumbled to dust and stone. I hope this incident does not foreshadow similar problems in our mines. However, for now I have other things to take care of and you have other {missions} to accomplish.
npc.ongulf.say_4: [EN] You did an excellent job! With all this help Farmine will grow and prosper. While we put all available resources into building this base, I have another urgent {mission} for you.
npc.ongulf.say_5: [EN] Oh my. What a mess you have gotten yourself into. Well, at least you made it out alive. Whatever the value of a minotaur's promise might be, I guess that is the best we can get. ...
npc.ongulf.voice_1: [EN] Great, another supply ship is due. How is a dwarf supposed to work under these conditions?
npc.ongulf.voice_2: [EN] Ah, there's nothing like the sound of hammers in the morning.
npc.oressa.choose_prompt_1: [EN] I'll help you decide. Tell me: Do you like to keep your {distance}, or do you like {close} combat?
npc.oressa.druid_confirm_1: [EN] So tell me: DO YOU WISH TO BECOME A SAGACIOUS DRUID? Answer with a proud {YES} if that is your choice!
npc.oressa.druid_info_1: [EN] Druids are healers and powerful masters of ice and earth magic. They can also do a little energy, fire or death damage as well. ...
npc.oressa.druid_info_2: [EN] Druids cannot take much damage or carry many items, but they deal more damage than paladins or knights, and can target several enemies. ...
npc.oressa.druid_info_3: [EN] If you wish to be a healer and wielder of powerful natural magic, you should consider choosing the druid vocation.
npc.oressa.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome, young adventurer. Tell me if you need help in \z {choosing} your {vocation}, or if you have {decided} on the {vocation} you want to choose.
npc.oressa.greet_msg_2: [EN] Welcome to the temple of Dawnport, child. \z If you need {healing}, I can help you. Ask me about a {vocation} if you need counsel.
npc.oressa.knight_confirm_1: [EN] DO YOU WISH TO BECOME A VALIANT KNIGHT? Answer with a proud {YES} if that is your choice!
npc.oressa.knight_info_1: [EN] Knights are stalwart melee fighters, the toughest of all vocations. They can take more damage and carry more items than the other vocations, but they will deal less damage than paladins, druids or sorcerers. ...
npc.oressa.knight_info_2: [EN] Knights can wield one- or two-handed swords, axes and clubs, and they can cast a few spells to draw a monster's attention to them. ...
npc.oressa.knight_info_3: [EN] If you want to be a tough melee fighter who can resist much longer than anyone else, you should consider choosing the knight vocation.
npc.oressa.magic_prompt_1: [EN] Tell me: Do you prefer to {heal} and cast the power of nature and ice, or do you want to rain fire and {death} on your foes?
npc.oressa.paladin_confirm_1: [EN] So tell me: DO YOU WISH TO BECOME A DARING PALADIN? Answer with a proud {YES} if that is your choice!
npc.oressa.paladin_info_1: [EN] Paladins are sturdy distance fighters. They are tougher than druids or sorcerers and can carry more items, but they are less tough than a knight. ...
npc.oressa.paladin_info_2: [EN] Paladins have the longest attack range, and can deal the most damage on a single target. ...
npc.oressa.paladin_info_3: [EN] They can also use holy magic to slay the unholy and undead in particular. ...
npc.oressa.paladin_info_4: [EN] If you like to keep a distance to your enemy, shooting while you outdistance him, you should consider choosing the paladin vocation.
npc.oressa.say_1: [EN] Then you should choose the {vocation} of a knight and become a valiant fighter with sword and shield. ...
npc.oressa.say_10: [EN] Then you should learn the ways of the druids, healers and powerful masters of natural magic. ...
npc.oressa.say_11: [EN] Druids can heal their friends and allies, but they can also cast powerful ice and earth magic to kill their enemies. They can do a little energy, fire or death damage as well. ...
npc.oressa.say_12: [EN] Druids cannot take much damage or carry many items, but they deal much more damage than paladins or knights. ...
npc.oressa.say_13: [EN] So tell me: DO YOU WISH TO BECOME A SAGACIOUS DRUID? Answer with a proud {YES} if that is your choice!
npc.oressa.say_14: [EN] Then you should become a sorcerer, a mighty wielder of deathly energies and arcane fire. ...
npc.oressa.say_15: [EN] Sorcerers are powerful casters of magic. They use fire, energy and death magic to lay low their enemies. They can do a little ice or earth damage as well. ...
npc.oressa.say_16: [EN] Sorcerers cannot take much damage or carry many items, but they deal much more damage than paladins or knights. ...
npc.oressa.say_17: [EN] So tell me: DO YOU WISH TO BECOME A POWERFUL SORCERER? Answer with a proud {YES} if that is your choice!
npc.oressa.say_18: [EN] SO BE IT. CAST OFF YOUR TRAINING GEAR AND RISE, NOBLE
npc.oressa.say_2: [EN] Knights are the toughest of all vocations. They can take more damage and carry more items than the other vocations, but they will deal less damage than paladins, druids or sorcerers. ...
npc.oressa.say_20: [EN] Go through the second door from the right. Open the chest and take the equipment inside before you leave to the north. ...
npc.oressa.say_21: [EN] Take the ship to reach the Mainland. Farewell, friend and good luck in all you undertake!
npc.oressa.say_22: [EN] As you wish. If you wish to learn something about the
npc.oressa.say_3: [EN] Knights can wield one- or two-handed swords, axes and clubs, and they can cast a few spells to draw a monster's attention to them. ...
npc.oressa.say_4: [EN] So tell me: DO YOU WISH TO BECOME A VALIANT KNIGHT? Answer with a proud {YES} if that is your choice!
npc.oressa.say_5: [EN] Then you should join the ranks of the paladins, noble hunters and rangers of the wild, who rely on the swiftness of movement and ranged attacks. ...
npc.oressa.say_6: [EN] Paladins are jacks of all trades. They are tougher than the magically gifted and can carry more items than druids or sorcerers, but they can take not as much damage as a knight can. ...
npc.oressa.say_7: [EN] Paladins deal more damage than knights but less than druids or sorcerers, and have the longest range in their distance attacks. ...
npc.oressa.say_8: [EN] They can also use holy magic to slay the unholy and undead in particular. ...
npc.oressa.say_9: [EN] DO YOU WISH TO BECOME A DARING PALADIN? Answer with a proud {YES} if that is your choice!
npc.oressa.sorcerer_confirm_1: [EN] So tell me: DO YOU WISH TO BECOME A POWERFUL SORCERER? Answer with a proud {YES} if that is your choice!
npc.oressa.sorcerer_info_1: [EN] Sorcerers are powerful casters of death, energy and fire magic. They can do a little ice or earth damage as well. ...
npc.oressa.sorcerer_info_2: [EN] Sorcerers cannot take much damage or carry many items, but they deal more damage than paladins or knights, and can target several enemies. ...
npc.oressa.sorcerer_info_3: [EN] If you wish to be a caster of fire and energy, hurling death magic at your foes, you should consider choosing the sorcerer vocation.
npc.oressa.stdmod_10: [EN] I can {heal} you if you are hurt. I can also help you choose your {vocation}.
npc.oressa.stdmod_11:
[EN] Behind each of those doors, the equipment and skills of one vocation lies - \z
		sorcerer, paladin, knight or druid. ...
npc.oressa.stdmod_12:
[EN] He has seen much, and likes to help the younger ones. If you have questions about what to do, \z
			or whom to ask for anything, go to Inigo.
npc.oressa.stdmod_13: [EN] Found a new way of living and took to it like a fish to water.
npc.oressa.stdmod_14: [EN] Ah. Some wounds never heal. <sighs> Shipwrecked in body and mind. Nowhere to go, so he doesn't leave.
npc.oressa.stdmod_15: [EN] He broods over problems he won't share. But maybe you can help him with a little quest or two.
npc.oressa.stdmod_16: [EN] He lives only for his experiments and potions
npc.oressa.stdmod_17: [EN] I have heard of it, yes.
npc.oressa.stdmod_18: [EN] This is a strange place. Many beings are called to it. I dreamed of it long before I came here. ... Something spoke to me, telling me I had to be its voice; a voice of the Oracle here for the sake of the adventurers that would come to defend {World} against evil and need to {choose} their destiny.
npc.oressa.stdmod_9: [EN] If you are hurt my child, I will {heal} your wounds.
npc.oressa.vocation_default_1: [EN] A vocation is your profession and destiny, determining your skills and way of fighting. There are four vocations in Tibia: {knight}, {sorcerer}, {paladin} or {druid}. Each one has its unique special abilities. ...
npc.oressa.vocation_default_2: [EN] When you leave the outpost through one of the four gates upstairs, you will be equipped with training gear of a specific vocation in order to defend yourself against the monsters outside. ...
npc.oressa.vocation_default_3: [EN] You can try them out as often as you wish to. When you have gained enough experience to reach level 8, you are ready to choose the definite vocation that is to become your destiny. ...
npc.oressa.vocation_default_4: [EN] Think carefully, as you can't change your vocation later on! You will have to choose your vocation in order to leave Dawnport for the main continent through one of these {doors} behind me. ...
npc.oressa.vocation_default_5: [EN] Talk to me again when you are ready to choose your vocation, and I will set you on your way.
npc.oressa.voice_1:
[EN] You can't take it all with you - sell your Dawnport things before \z
		you receive the gear of your definite vocation!
npc.oressa.voice_2: [EN] Leave all Dawnport things behind you and choose your destiny!
npc.oressa.voice_3: Kom till mig om du behöver läkning!
npc.oressa.voice_4: [EN] Choose your vocation and explore the mainland!
npc.oressa.voice_5: [EN] Talk to me to choose your definite vocation! Become a knight, paladin, druid or sorcerer!
npc.oressa.voice_6: [EN] World needs brave adventurers like you. Choose your vocation and sail to the mainland!
npc.oressa.voice_7: [EN] Poisoned? Bleeding? Wounded? I can help!
npc.ormuhn.stdmod_1: [EN] In this category I have '{Bruise Bane}', '{Cure Bleeding}', '{Wound Cleansing}', '{Cure Poison}', '{Intense Wound Cleansing}', '{Recovery}' and '{Intense Recovery}'.
npc.ormuhn.stdmod_2: [EN] In this category I have '{Light}', '{Find Person}', '{Magic Rope}', '{Levitate}', '{Haste}', '{Charge}' and '{Great Light}'.
npc.ormuhn.stdmod_3: [EN] I can teach you {healing spells}, {attack spells} and {support spells}. What kind of spell do you wish to learn? You can also tell me for which level you would like to learn a spell, if you prefer that.
npc.ormuhn.stdmod_4: [EN] In this category I have '{Whirlwind Throw}', '{Groundshaker}', '{Berserk}' and '{Fierce Berserk}' as well as ... '{Brutal Strike}', '{Front Sweep}', '{Inflict Wound}' and '{Annihilation}'.
npc.orockle.say_1: [EN] You can help in the fight against the hive. There are several missions available to destabilise the hive. Just ask for them if you want to learn more. After completing many missions you might be worthy to get a reward.
npc.orockle.say_2: [EN] You could try to blind the hive, you might disrupt its digestion, you could gather acid or you can disable the swarm pores. ...
npc.orockle.say_3: [EN] So be it. Now you are a member of the inquisition. You might ask me for a mission to raise in my esteem.
npc.ortheus.greet_msg_1: [EN] What's your business here with the {magicians}, |PLAYERNAME|?
npc.ortheus.say_1: [EN] A cookie? Well... I have to admit I haven't had one for ages. Can I have it?
npc.ortheus.say_2: Det är bättre för dig att gå nu.
npc.ortheus.say_3: [EN] Well thanks, it looks tasty, I'll just take a bi - COUGH! Are you trying to poison me?? Get out of here before I forget myself!
npc.ortheus.say_4: [EN] Wow. These polite young adventurers nowadays. Thank you.
npc.ortheus.say_5: [EN] Hmmm, you don't have tea with you.
npc.ortheus.say_6: [EN] Have you actually brought me a mug of tea??
npc.ortheus.stdmod_1: [EN] I can't imagine a better place to live.
npc.ortheus.stdmod_10: [EN] He used to visit me for a chat, but ever since that new tavern opened I haven't seen him much anymore.
npc.ortheus.stdmod_11: [EN] He sometimes delivers fruit and vegetables to this quarter.
npc.ortheus.stdmod_12: [EN] Though the city has seen better days, the quality of life is still much better than in most other cities.
npc.ortheus.stdmod_13: [EN] I can't imagine a better place to live
npc.ortheus.stdmod_15: [EN] I don't have anything that I could give you as a reward. Guess you aren't so selfless after all, huh?
npc.ortheus.stdmod_16: [EN] They try to protect the city and do a decent job. Well - no, a poor job, I mean a poor job.
npc.ortheus.stdmod_17: [EN] You can bring me a mug of tea if you want to.
npc.ortheus.stdmod_2: [EN] Though the city has seen better days, the quality of life is still much better than in most other cities.
npc.ortheus.stdmod_3: [EN] Hm, good question. Maybe old, wise man?
npc.ortheus.stdmod_4: [EN] I'm used to being called old man. Simple as that.
npc.ortheus.stdmod_5: [EN] I don't know what you're talking about.
npc.ortheus.stdmod_6: [EN] Yes, it's a bit messy down there. Sorry.
npc.oswald.say_33: [EN] What? So why in the world should I give you an invitation? It's not as if you were someone important, are you?
npc.oswald.say_34: [EN] Well, rich and generous people are always welcome in the palace.If you donate 1000 gold to a fund I oversee, I'll give you an invitation, ok?
npc.oswald.say_36: Du har inte tillräckligt med pengar.
npc.oswald.say_37: [EN] Not that I am bribeable but I doubt that you own 1000 gold pieces. Or do you?
npc.oswald.stdmod_1: [EN] I think the gods are too busy to care about us mortals, hmm... that makes me feel godlike, too.
npc.oswald.stdmod_10: [EN] It is nearly tea time, so please hurry!
npc.oswald.stdmod_11: [EN] It's rumoured that Sam does not forge all weapons himself, but buys them from his cousin, who is married to a cyclops.
npc.oswald.stdmod_12: [EN]  If you want to see dungeons just don't pay your taxes.
npc.oswald.stdmod_13: [EN] It's beyond all doubt that certain sinister elements in our city have certain knowledge about this myth.
npc.oswald.stdmod_14: [EN] You are not the first one to ask about that. Am I the only one that preferes wine to such disgusting stuff?
npc.oswald.stdmod_15: [EN] What do you expect from ex-soldiers? He is nuts! Hacked on the head far too often.
npc.oswald.stdmod_16: [EN] Isn't he the artist formerly known as the prince?
npc.oswald.stdmod_17: [EN] I never found any rumour concerning him, isn't that odd?
npc.oswald.stdmod_18: [EN] They say she killed over a dozen husbands already.
npc.oswald.stdmod_19: [EN] This man lives in the darkness like a rat and is also as handsome as one of them. He surely is up to no good and often consorts with sinister strangers.
npc.oswald.stdmod_2: [EN] I am honored to be the assistant of the great, the illustrious, the magnificent {Durin}!
npc.oswald.stdmod_20: [EN] Just last week a one eyed man, who had a room at Frodo's, met him in the middle of the night.
npc.oswald.stdmod_21: [EN] He sells his scrolls far too expensive.
npc.oswald.stdmod_22: [EN] I was told he lost a body part or two in duels... if you know what I mean.
npc.oswald.stdmod_23: [EN] He is rumoured to summon kinky demons to... well you know.
npc.oswald.stdmod_24: [EN] You know a rumour? TELL ME! TELL ME! TELL ME!
npc.oswald.stdmod_26: [EN] I heard he was a ladies' man in younger days. In our days he is rumoured to wear women clothes now and then.
npc.oswald.stdmod_27: [EN] A simple shopkeeper with minor intelligence.
npc.oswald.stdmod_28: [EN] They say he isn't truly dead. He was... or is a necromant after all.
npc.oswald.stdmod_29: [EN]  Some say he is Ferumbras in disguise.
npc.oswald.stdmod_3: [EN] I am honored to be the assistant of the great, the illustrious, the magnificent {Durin}!
npc.oswald.stdmod_30: [EN] What a shame. He claimed to be the king of thiefs and was caught stealing some fruit.
npc.oswald.stdmod_31: [EN] Just between you and me, he can be quite a tyrant.
npc.oswald.stdmod_4: [EN] I have a job of great responsibility, mostly I keep annoying persons away from my boss.
npc.oswald.stdmod_5: [EN] You better don't ask, you wouldn't like the answer.
npc.oswald.stdmod_6: [EN] Ah, yes, yes, hail to King {Tibianus}! Long live the king and so on...
npc.oswald.stdmod_7: [EN] I overheard a conversation of officials, that magic will be forbidden soon.
npc.oswald.stdmod_8: [EN] My name is Oswald, but let's proceed, I am a very busy man.
npc.oswald.stdmod_9: [EN] Hey, I am not a shopkeeper, I am an important man!
npc.oswald.walkaway_msg_1: [EN] Good bye, and don't come back too soon.
npc.ottokar.say_1: [EN] Did you bring me the medicine pouch?
npc.ottokar.say_2: [EN] I need a {medicine pouch}, to give you the {belongings of deceased}. Come back when you have them.
npc.ottokar.say_4: [EN] You do not have the required items.
npc.padreia.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome to our humble guild, wanderer. May I be of any assistance to you?
npc.padreia.multi_1: [EN] I knew I could count on you. Take this highly intensified vermin poison. In my vision, I saw some kind of 'pool' where these slimes came from. ...
npc.padreia.multi_2: [EN] Pour the poison in the water to stop the demise of Carlin. Tell me about your mission after you fulfilled your task.
npc.padreia.multi_4: [EN] , thank god you came to me. Last night, I had a vision about an upcoming plague here in Carlin. ...
npc.padreia.say_1: [EN] Do you want to buy a bottle of cough syrup for 50 gold?
npc.padreia.say_10: [EN] They thought they had to bring Crunor to the people, if the people had not found Crunor on their own. To achieve this, they founded the inn called Crunor's Cottage, south of Mt. Sternum.
npc.padreia.say_2: [EN] You MUST find that slime pool immediately or life here in Carlin will not be the same anymore.
npc.padreia.say_3: [EN] You did it! Even if only few of the Carliners will ever know about that, you saved all of their lives. Here, take this as a reward. Farewell!
npc.padreia.say_4: [EN] Maybe the guards have something to do for you or know someone who could need some help.
npc.padreia.say_5: Du har inte tillräckligt med pengar.
npc.padreia.say_8: [EN] Then the downfall of Carlin is inescapable. Please think about it. You know where to find me.
npc.padreia.say_9: [EN] Don't ask. They were only an unimportant footnote of history.
npc.padreia.stdmod_1: [EN] I am the grand druid of Carlin. I am responsible for the guild, the fields, and our citizens' health.
npc.padreia.stdmod_2: [EN] Every druid is able to learn the numerous spells of our craft.
npc.padreia.stdmod_3: [EN] Sorry, I don't teach spells for your vocation.
npc.padreia.stdmod_4: [EN] I am Padreia, grand druid of our fine city.
npc.padreia.stdmod_5: [EN] Time is just a crystal pillar - the centre of creation and life.
npc.padreia.stdmod_6: [EN] We are druids, preservers of life. Our magic is about defence, healing, and nature.
npc.padreia.stdmod_7: [EN] Sorcerers are destructive. Their power lies in destruction and pain.
npc.palimuth.multi_1: [EN] You'll find our seven guards at the gates of each quarter. Just ask them for their report and they will tell you all you need to know.
npc.palimuth.multi_10: [EN] I'm afraid we have not seen the last chapter of Yalahar's drama. But anyhow, I wish to thank you for putting your life at stake for our cause. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_11: [EN] I allow you to enter the Yalaharian treasure room. I'm sure that you can put what you find inside to better use than them. Choose one chest, but think before takingone! ...
npc.palimuth.multi_12: [EN] Also, take this Yalaharian outfit. Depending on which side you chose previously, you can also acquire one specific addon. Thank you again for your help.
npc.palimuth.multi_13: [EN] I cannot tell you how we acquired this information, but we have heard that a circle of Yalahari is planning some kind of ritual. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_14: [EN] They plan to create a portal for some powerful demons and to unleash them in the city to 'purge' it once and for all. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_15: [EN] I doubt those poor fools will be able to control such entities. I can't figure out how they came up with such an insane idea, but they have to be stopped. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_16: [EN] The entrance to their inner sanctum has been opened for you. Please hurry and stop them before it's too late. Be prepared for a HARD battle! Better gather some friends to assist you.
npc.palimuth.multi_17: [EN] Listen, I know you have worked for Azerus and his friends, but it is not too late to change your mind! I beg you to rethink your loyalties. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_18: [EN] The fate of the whole city might depend on your decision! Think about your options carefully.
npc.palimuth.multi_19: [EN] The constant unrest in the city is to a great extent caused by the lack of food. Weapons will only serve to suppress the poor. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_2: [EN] I must warn you, the quarters are in a horrible state. I strongly advise you to stay on the main roads whenever possible while you get those reports. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_20: [EN] The factory you were sent to was once used for the production of food. Somewhere in the factory you might find an old pattern crystal for the production of food. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_21: [EN] If you use it on the controls instead of the weapon pattern, you will ensure that our people are supplied with the desperately needed food. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_22: [EN] The quara are indeed a threat. Yet, they are numerous and reproduce quickly. Slaying some of them will only enrage them even more. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_23: [EN] The quara have been there for many generations. They have never threatened anyone who stayed out of their watery realm. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_24: [EN] It would be much more useful to find out what the quara are so upset about. Better avoid slaying their leaders as this will only further the animosities.
npc.palimuth.multi_25: [EN] I thank you also in the name of these poor lost souls. I will send the charm to a priest who is able to release them. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_26: [EN] Tell the Yalahari that the charm was destroyed by the energy it contained.
npc.palimuth.multi_27: [EN] What a sick idea to misuse tortured souls to power some device! Though, this charm might be useful to free these poor souls. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_28: [EN] Please capture the souls as you have been instructed and then bring the charm to me. I will see to it that the souls are freed to go to the afterlife in peace.
npc.palimuth.multi_29: [EN] Warbeasts? Is this true? People are already starving. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_3: [EN] I'm pleased to hear that. Rarely we meet outsiders that care about our problems. Most people come here looking for wealth and luxury. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_30: [EN] How can we afford to feed an army of hungry beasts? They will not only strengthen the power of the Yalahari over the citizens, they also mean starvation and deathfor the poor. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_31: [EN] Instead of breeding warbeasts, this druid should breed cattle to feed our people. Please I beg you, convince him to do that!
npc.palimuth.multi_32: [EN] You did quite well in gaining a new friend who will work together with us. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_33: [EN] I'm sure he'll still try to gain some profit but that's still better than his former one-man rule during which he dictated his own laws.
npc.palimuth.multi_34: [EN] Mr. West is a little paranoid. That's the reason for his immense private army of bodyguards. He could surely be helpful, especially as he rules over the former trade quarter. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_35: [EN] If you were able to reach him without killing his henchmen, you could probably convince him that you mean no harm to him. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_36: [EN] That would certainly cement our relationship without any needless bloodshed. Perhaps you could use the way through the sewers to avoid his men. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_37: [EN] Mr. West is not a bad man. We should be able to work out some plans to reconstruct the city's safety as soon as he overcomes his paranoia towards us.
npc.palimuth.multi_38: [EN] This quarter has been sealed off years ago. To send someone there poses a high risk to spread the plague. I assume these research notes you've mentioned must be very important. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_39: [EN] After all those years it is more than strange that someone shows interest in these notes now. Considering what has happened to the alchemists, it is rather unlikely that they contain harmless information. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_4: [EN] However, I have to tell you that our ranking system is quite rigid. So, I'm not allowed to entrust you with important missions as long as you haven't proven yourself as reliable. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_40: [EN] I fear these notes will be used to turn the plague into some kind of weapon. Someone with this plague at his disposal could subdue the whole city by blackmailing. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_41: [EN] I beg you to destroy these notes. Just put them into some burning oven to get rid of them and report that you did not find the notes.
npc.palimuth.multi_42: [EN] Now you know as much as we do about the things happening in Yalahar. It's up to you what you do with this information. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_43: [EN] Now leave and talk to my superior Azerus in the city centre to get your next mission. I urge you, though, to talk to me whenever he sends you on a new mission. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_44: [EN] I think it is important that you hear my opinion about them. Now hurry. I suppose Azerus is already waiting.
npc.palimuth.multi_45: [EN] I did my best to impress my superiors with your accomplishments and it seems that it worked quite well. They want you for their own missions now. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_46: [EN] Missions that are more important than the ones you've fulfilled for me. However, before you leave, there are still some things I need to tell you. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_47: [EN] Listen, I can't explain you everything in detail right now and here. You never know who might be eavesdropping. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_48: [EN] I left some notes in the small room there. Get them and read them. Talk to me again when you've read the notes.
npc.palimuth.multi_49: [EN] We are still present at each quarter's city wall, even though we can do little to stop the chaos from spreading. Still, our garrisons are necessary to maintain some sort of order in the city. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_5: [EN] If you are willing to work for the city of Yalahar, you can ask me for a {mission} any time, be it night or day.
npc.palimuth.multi_50: [EN] My superiors ask for a first hand report about the current situation in the single city quarters. I need someone to travel to our garrisons to get the reports from the guards. Are you willing to do that?
npc.palimuth.multi_51: [EN] I hope your first mission will not scare you off. Even though, we cut off our sewer system from other parts of the city to prevent the worst, it still has deteriorated in the last decades. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_52: [EN] Certain parts of the controls are rusty and the drains are stuffed with garbage. Get yourself a crowbar, loosen the controls and clean the pipes from the garbage. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_53: [EN] We were able to locate the 4 worst spots in the sewers. I will mark them for you on your map so you have no trouble finding them. Report to me when you have finished your {mission}. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_54: [EN] You probably heard that we have numerous problems in different quarters of our city. Our forces are limited, so we really could need some help from outsiders. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_55: [EN] Would you like to assist us in re-establishing order in our city?
npc.palimuth.multi_6: [EN] So the Yalahari that opposed us are dead or fled from the city. This should bring us more stability and perhaps a true chance to rebuild the city. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_7: [EN] Still, I wonder from where they gained some of the Yalahari secrets. Did they find some source of knowledge? ...
npc.palimuth.multi_8: [EN] And if so, is this source still around so that we can use it for the benefit of our city? What really troubles me is that none of those false Yalahari had the personality of agreat leader. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_9: [EN] Quite the opposite, they were opportunistic and not exactly bold. Perhaps they were led by some greater power which stayed behind the scenes. ...
npc.palimuth.say_1: [EN] I'm an Augur of the city of Yalahar. My special duty consists of coordinating the efforts to keep the city and its services running.
npc.palimuth.say_10: [EN] Thank you very much. You have no idea how hard it was to find someone volunteering for that job. If you feel ready for further {missions}, just tell me.
npc.palimuth.say_11: [EN] Excellent! My superiors will be pleased to get these reports. I will for sure emphasise your efforts in this mission. Please come back soon to see if there are any more {missions} available for you.
npc.palimuth.say_13: [EN] You have no idea how much I hoped to hear that, my friend! But I have an urgent mission for you!
npc.palimuth.say_14: [EN] Great! Here, take this yalaharian addon in a return.
npc.palimuth.say_2: [EN] Did you bring me the vampiric crest?
npc.palimuth.say_3: [EN] So are you done with your work?
npc.palimuth.say_4: [EN] Did you get all the reports my superiors asked for?
npc.palimuth.say_5: [EN] These are great news indeed. The people of Yalahar will be grateful. The Yalahari probably not, so take care of yourself.
npc.palimuth.say_6: [EN] Rumours travel fast in Yalahar. So the Yalahari will soon have some new toys at their disposal. I strongly doubt this has any positive effect.
npc.palimuth.say_7: [EN] Oh no! So that's the reason for the quara attacks! I will do my best to close these sewage pipes. We will have to use other drains.
npc.palimuth.say_8: [EN] You can be proud of your decision, my friend.
npc.palimuth.say_9: [EN] So do you want to side with me?
npc.palomino.greet_msg_1: Hälsningar, |PLAYERNAME| Jag ​​antar att du är här för {horses}.
npc.palomino.say_1: [EN] We can bring you to Venore with one of our coaches for 125 gold. Are you interested?
npc.palomino.say_2: Vill du hyra en häst för en dag till ett pris av 500 guld?
npc.palomino.say_3: Få först bort de där blodfläckarna!
npc.palomino.say_4: Du har inte tillräckligt med pengar.
npc.palomino.say_7: Du har inte tillräckligt med pengar för att hyra en häst!
npc.palomino.say_8: Jag ska ge dig en av våra erfarna. Ta hand om dig! Håll utkik efter lågt hängande grenar.
npc.partos.farewell_msg_1: [EN] Good bye, visit me again. I will be here, promised.

npc.phillip.stdmod_1: [EN] I am fine, thank you very much.

npc.phillip.stdmod_11: [EN] An interesting place you should consider to visit.

npc.phillip.stdmod_25: [EN] This weapon is said to be very powerful and unique. It was hidden in ancient times and now is thought to be lost.
npc.phillip.stdmod_3: [EN] I am honored to be teacher in this school.

npc.phillip.stdmod_5: [EN] If you are lucky you'll meet one in your journeys.
npc.phillip.stdmod_8: [EN] I will provide you with all knowledge I have.

npc.prezil.stdmod_21: Druiderna norr om Carlin kommer att förse dig med Tibia.
npc.prezil.stdmod_22: Du kan be om välsignelsen av de två solarna i soltornet nära Ab'Dendriel.
npc.prezil.stdmod_23: Fenixens gnista ges av jord- och eldens dvärgpräster i Kazordoon.
npc.prezil.stdmod_25:

npc.prezil.stdmod_8: Här är du. Ta hand om dig.
npc.prezil.stdmod_9: Tyvärr, du har inte tillräckligt med pengar.
npc.prezil.walkaway_msg_1: Kom ihåg: Om du är svårt sårad eller förgiftad kan jag bota dig gratis.
npc.prisoner.voice_6: [EN] Please! I beg you to stop!
npc.puffels.greet_msg_1: [EN] Yeah, another fool {disturbing} me, what a joy.
