npc.puffels.stdmod_4: [EN] In this category I have '{Whirlwind Throw}', '{Groundshaker}', '{Berserk}' and '{Fierce Berserk}' as well as ... '{Brutal Strike}', '{Front Sweep}', '{Inflict Wound}' and '{Annihilation}'.
npc.pukosch.greet_msg_1: Välkommen, |PLAYERNAME|! Känner du dig äventyrlig? Vill du ha en veckovis {ticket} för malmvagnssystemet här? Du kan använda den här för att komma till centrum av Kazordoon!
npc.pukosch.say_1: Vill du köpa en veckobiljett till malmvagnarna? Med den kan du resa fritt och snabbt genom Kazordoon i en vecka. Endast 250 guld. Handla?
npc.pukosch.say_2: Din veckobiljett är fortfarande giltig. Skulle vara slöseri med pengar att köpa en andra
npc.pukosch.say_3: Här är din stämpel. Det kan inte överföras till en annan person och kommer att pågå en vecka från och med nu. Du får ett meddelande när du använder en malmvagn när den inte är giltig längre.
npc.pukosch.say_4: Du har inte tillräckligt med pengar.
npc.pydar.farewell_msg_1: [EN] May the fire in your heart never die, |PLAYERNAME|!
npc.pydar.greet_msg_1: [EN] Be greeted |PLAYERNAME|! I can smell the scent of a phoenix on you!
npc.pydar.keyword_1: [EN] So receive the spark of the phoenix, pilgrim.
npc.pydar.stdmod_1: [EN] The Spark of the Phoenix is given by me and by the great geomancer of the local earth temple. Do you wish to receive my part of the Spark of the Phoenix for |BLESSCOST| gold?
npc.pydar.stdmod_10: [EN] May the great flame devour them all!
npc.pydar.stdmod_11: [EN] Life feeds on fire and ultimately fire will feed on life.
npc.pydar.stdmod_12: [EN] A weapon too powerful to be wielded by mortals. It has to be returned to the fire which gave birth to it.
npc.pydar.stdmod_13: [EN] If he ever dares enter Kazordoon I will gladly dump him into the lava. Tthe sacred flame shall bring justice upon him.
npc.pydar.stdmod_14: [EN] Our city was founded in ancient times. Abandoned by the gods we once fought for, we created a secure haven for our people.
npc.pydar.stdmod_15: [EN] This mountain is said to be the oldest in the world. It is the place where fire and earth meet and separate at the same time.
npc.pydar.stdmod_16: [EN] Bezil and Nezil are buying and selling equipment of all kinds.
npc.pydar.stdmod_17: [EN] Bezil and Nezil are buying and selling equipment of all kinds.
npc.pydar.stdmod_18: [EN] She is the first knight of Kazordoon. She is responsible for teaching our young warriors how to handle an axe.
npc.pydar.stdmod_19: [EN] Etzel is a true master of the elements. He is a role-model for our youngsters, jawoll.
npc.pydar.stdmod_2: [EN] So receive the spark of the phoenix, pilgrim.
npc.pydar.stdmod_20: [EN] He and his wife are running the Jolly Axeman tavern.
npc.pydar.stdmod_21: [EN] He is a smith. If you are looking for exquisite weapons and armour just talk to him.
npc.pydar.stdmod_22: [EN] She and her husband are running the Jolly Axeman tavern.
npc.pydar.stdmod_23: [EN] Uzgod is a weaponsmith just like those in the old legends.
npc.pydar.stdmod_24: [EN] Though we are through with the so-called gods, Durin, the first dwarf to aquire divine powers of his own, is considered a protector of our race.
npc.pydar.stdmod_25: [EN] Unlike the gods, the elements don't use mortals as toys, A skilled mind can understand and even control them to some extent.
npc.pydar.stdmod_26: [EN] The ways of the gods are imprehensible to mortals. On the other hand, the elements are raw forces and can be understood and tamed.
npc.pydar.stdmod_27: [EN] You can receive the Spiritual Shielding in the Whiteflower Temple south of Thais.
npc.pydar.stdmod_28: [EN] Ask for the Fire of the Suns in the Suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.pydar.stdmod_29: [EN] The druids north of Carlin can provide you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.pydar.stdmod_30: [EN] Talk to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya about this blessing.
npc.pydar.stdmod_31: [EN] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes.
npc.pydar.stdmod_32: [EN] I'm the head pyromancer of Kazordoon. I guess you are here for healing or looking for a blessing.
npc.pydar.stdmod_33: [EN] There are five different blessings available in five sacred places. These blessings are: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}.
npc.pydar.stdmod_4: [EN] The ways of the gods are imprehensible to mortals. On the other hand, the elements are raw forces and can be understood and tamed.
npc.pydar.stdmod_5: [EN] I am the head pyromancer of Kazordoon.
npc.pydar.stdmod_6: [EN] My name is Pydar Firefist, Son of Fire, from the Savage Axes.
npc.pydar.stdmod_7: [EN] Ask around. There's a lot to do, jawoll.
npc.pydar.stdmod_9: [EN] It's the fourth age of the yellow flame.
npc.pydar.walkaway_msg_1: [EN] May the fire in your heart never die.
npc.pythius_the_rotten.farewell_msg_1: [EN] COME BACK ANYTIME AND BRING ME TREASURES.
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_1: [EN] LIKE MY TREASURE? WANNA PICK SOMETHING OUT OF IT?
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_10: [EN] YOU LITTLE MAGGOT. COME BACK TO ME WHEN YOU CAN HANDLE A FIGHT AGAINST MY KIND.
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_11: [EN] I HAVE A MISSION FOR YOU BUT YOU NEED TO DIE FIRST AND RETURN AS AN {UNDEAD} CREATURE. COME BACK TO ME WHEN YOU ACHIEVED THIS GOAL.
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_12: [EN] EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_13: [EN] I HAVE A MISSION FOR YOU BUT YOU NEED TO DIE FIRST AND RETURN AS AN {UNDEAD} CREATURE. COME BACK TO ME WHEN YOU ACHIEVED THIS GOAL.
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_14: [EN] BOON AND BANE. I HAVE CHOSEN THIS LIFE VOLUNTARILLY AND I NEVER REGRET IT. MY {TREASURE} IS GROWING BIGGER EACH DAY.
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_2: [EN] ALRIGHT. BUT FIRST OF ALL I WANT YOU TO BRING ME SOMETHING IN EXCHANGE. SURPRISE ME....AND IF I LIKE IT, YOU MAY GET WHAT YOU DESERVE.
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_3: [EN] HAVE YOU SEEN THESE LEGENDARY ITEMS BACK THERE? WHO COULD REFUSE THE CHANCE OF OBTAINING ONE?!? SO WHAT IS YOUR ANSWER?
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_4: [EN] I GRANT YOU ACCESS TO THE DUNGEON IN THE NORTH. YOU'LL FIND SOME OF MY LIVING BROTHERS THERE....BUT.....EVERY TIME YOU WANT TO ENTER YOU HAVE TO GIVE ME SOMETHING PRECIOUS. ALRIGHT?
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_5: [EN] AS YOU WISH. WHAT DO YOU HAVE TO OFFER?
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_6: [EN] I LIKE THAT AND GRANT YOU ACCESS TO THE DUNGEON IN THE NORTH FOR THE NEXT FEW MINUTES. COME BACK ANYTIME AND BRING ME MORE TREASURES.
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_7: [EN] THIS IS NOT WORTH BEING PART OF MY TREASURE! BRING ME SOMETHING ELSE.
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_8: [EN] THIS IS NOT WORTH BEING PART OF MY TREASURE! BRING ME SOMETHING ELSE
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_9: [EN] TELL ME IF YOU CHANGE YOUR MIND. MY TREASURE THIRSTS FOR GOLD.
npc.pythius_the_rotten.walkaway_msg_1: [EN] COME BACK ANYTIME AND BRING ME TREASURES.
npc.quandons_ghost.greet_msg_2: [EN] He murdered me. I shouldn't have trusted him! The money! All that money blinded me! To the east I brought his stuff. In night and darkness, covered by some kind of magic of his. The minotaurs did not bother us, like he promised. ...
npc.quandons_ghost.greet_msg_3: [EN] His ... his true name is Shargon and he is a priest of some kind. He belongs to a powerful secret society and is looking for something on their behalves. ...
npc.quandons_ghost.greet_msg_4: [EN] We brought his stuff to a hideout, I'll mark it on your map! The things that I've seen there! Horrible, horrible things! I fled, but he found me, killed me. He murdered me!
npc.queen_eloise.multi_1: Excellent! Låt mig nu förklara. Om du donerar 1 000 000 000 guldpjäser har du rätt att bära en unik outfit. ...
npc.queen_eloise.say_1: [EN] In exchange for a truly generous donation, I will offer a special outfit. Do you want to make a donation?
npc.queen_eloise.say_10: [EN] You need to donate {armor} outfit first.
npc.queen_eloise.say_11: Ta dessa stövlar som ett tecken på stor tacksamhet. Låt oss för alltid minnas denna dag, min vän.
npc.queen_eloise.say_12: Du har inte tillräckligt med pengar för att donera det beloppet.
npc.queen_eloise.say_15: Så du skulle vilja donera 500.000.000 guldpjäser som i gengäld ger dig rätt att bära en unik rustning?
npc.queen_eloise.say_16: Så du skulle vilja donera 250.000.000 guldpjäser som i gengäld ger dig rätt att bära unik hjälm?
npc.queen_eloise.say_17: Så du skulle vilja skänka 250.000.000 guldpjäser som i gengäld ger dig rätt att bära en unik känga?
npc.queen_eloise.say_2: I så fall, återvänd till mig när du bestämt dig.
npc.queen_eloise.say_3: Ta denna rustning som ett tecken på stor tacksamhet. Låt oss för alltid minnas denna dag, min vän!
npc.queen_eloise.say_4: Se till att du har lediga platser i din butiks inkorg.
npc.queen_eloise.say_5: Du har inte tillräckligt med pengar för att donera det beloppet.
npc.queen_eloise.say_7: Ta den här hjälmen som ett tecken på stor tacksamhet. Låt oss för alltid minnas denna dag, min vän.
npc.queen_eloise.say_8: Du har inte tillräckligt med pengar för att donera det beloppet.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_1: Jag kan marknadsföra dig för 20 000 guldmynt. Vill du att jag ska marknadsföra dig?
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_10: [EN] I am Queen Eloise. For you it's 'My Queen' or 'Your Majesty', of course.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_11: [EN] I don't care about gossip like a simpleminded male would do.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_12: [EN] Soon the whole land will be ruled by women at last!
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_15: [EN] Sell? Your question shows that you are a typical member of your gender!
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_16: [EN] We honor the gods of good in our fair city, especially Crunor, of course.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_17: [EN] All citizens of Carlin are my subjects. I see them more as my childs, though, epecially the male population.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_18: [EN] This beast scared my cat away on my last diplomatic mission in this filthy town.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_19: [EN] He is the scourge of the whole continent!
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_20: [EN] The royal treasure is hidden beyond the grasps of any thieves by magical means.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_21: [EN] Go and hunt them! For queen and country!
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_22: [EN] Visit the church or the townguards for help.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_23: [EN] I will call for heroes as soon as the need arises again.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_24: [EN] Our city is rich and prospering.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_25: [EN] I don't want to talk about 'sewers'.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_26: [EN] Dungeons are places where males crawl around and look for trouble.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_27: [EN] Feel free to visit our town's magnificent shops.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_28: [EN] Don't worry about time in the presence of your Queen.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_29: [EN] We need the assistance of heroes now and then. Even males prove useful now and then.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_3: Okej då, kom tillbaka när du är redo.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_30: [EN] The taxes in Carlin are not high, more a symbol than a sacrifice.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_31: [EN] I am the Queen, the only rightful ruler on the continent!
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_32: [EN] Ask one of the soldiers about that.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_33: [EN] Our enemies are numerous. We have to fight vile monsters and have to watch this silly king in the south carefully.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_34: [EN] They dare to reject my reign over them!
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_35: [EN] Isn't our city marvellous? Have you noticed the lovely gardens on the roofs?
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_36: [EN] My subjects maintain many fine shops. Go and have a look at their wares.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_38: [EN] The four major guilds are the Knights, the Paladins, the Druids, and the Sorcerers.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_39: [EN] They haven't troubled our city lately. I guess, they fear the wrath of our druids.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_4: [EN] I remember about those uniforms, they had a camouflage inlay so they could be worn the inside out too. I will send some color samples via mail to Mr. Postner.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_41: [EN] It's a shame that the High Paladin does not reside in Carlin.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_42: [EN] The knights of Carlin are the bravest.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_43: [EN] The sorcerers have a small isle for their guild. So if they blow something up it does not burn the whole city to ruins.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_44: [EN] The druids of Carlin are our protectors and advisors. Their powers provide us with wealth and food.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_45: [EN] Carlin is a center of the forces of good, of course.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_46: [EN] The forces of evil have a firm grip on this puny city to the south.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_47: [EN] The order, Crunor gives the world, is essential for survival.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_48: [EN] Chaos is common in the southern regions, where they allow a man to reign over a realm.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_49: [EN] A mans tale ... that means 'nonsense', of course.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_7: [EN] The uniforms of our guards and soldiers are of unparraleled quality of course.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_8: [EN] I am {Queen} Eloise. It is my duty to reign over this marvellous {city} and the {lands} of the north.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_9: [EN] We women try to bring justice and wisdom to all, even to males.
npc.quentin.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free or you want the {adventurer stone}?
npc.quentin.keyword_1: Så ta emot skyddet av ödets vändning, pilgrim.
npc.quentin.stdmod_1: [EN] Alright, I guess you need a stake first. Maybe Gamon can help you, the leg of a chair or something could just do. Try asking him for a stake, and if you have one, bring it back to me.
npc.quentin.stdmod_11: Ah, vill du byta ut din äventyrarsten gratis?
npc.quentin.stdmod_12: Här är du. Ta hand om dig.
npc.quentin.stdmod_14: Ah, vill du byta ut din äventyrarsten mot 30 guld?
npc.quentin.stdmod_15: Här är du. Ta hand om dig.
npc.quentin.stdmod_16: Tyvärr, du har inte tillräckligt med pengar.
npc.quentin.stdmod_18: Du är sårad, mitt barn. Jag ska läka dina sår.
npc.quentin.stdmod_19: Du ser inte så illa ut. Tyvärr, jag kan inte hjälpa dig. Men om du letar efter ytterligare skydd bör du gå på {pilgrimage} av aska eller få skyddet av {twist of fate} här.
npc.quentin.stdmod_2: [EN] I guess you couldn't convince Gamon to give you a stake, eh?
npc.quentin.stdmod_20: Närhelst du får ett dödligt sår skadas din livskraft och det finns en chans att du tappar bort en del av din utrustning. Med varenda av de fem {blessings} du har kommer denna skada och risken för förlust att minska.
npc.quentin.stdmod_21: [EN] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.quentin.stdmod_22: Jag ser att du fick den andliga avskärmningen i det vita blomtemplet söder om Thais.
npc.quentin.stdmod_23: Jag kan ana att druiderna norr om Carlin har försett dig med omfamningen Tibia.
npc.quentin.stdmod_24: Jag kan se att du fick välsignelsen av de två solarna i soltornet nära Ab'Dendriel.
npc.quentin.stdmod_25: Jag kan ana att gnistan från Fenix ​​redan gavs till dig av dvärgprästerna av jord och eld i Kazordoon.
npc.quentin.stdmod_26: Jag kan känna att du redan pratade med eremiten Eremo på ön Cormaya och fick denna välsignelse.
npc.quentin.stdmod_27: Du kan be om välsignelsen av andlig avskärmning i whiteflower-templet söder om Thais.
npc.quentin.stdmod_28: Druiderna norr om Carlin kommer att förse dig med Tibia.
npc.quentin.stdmod_29: Du kan be om välsignelsen av de två solarna i soltornet nära Ab'Dendriel.
npc.quentin.stdmod_3: [EN] Ah, I see you brought a stake with you. Are you ready to receive my line of the prayer then?
npc.quentin.stdmod_30: Fenixens gnista ges av jord- och eldens dvärgpräster i Kazordoon.
npc.quentin.stdmod_32:
[EN] A blessed stake to defeat evil spirits? I do know an old prayer which is said to grant sacred power and to be able to bind this power to someone, or something. ... \z
	However, this prayer needs the combined energy of ten priests. Each of them has to say one line of the prayer. ... \z
	I could start with the prayer, but since the next priest has to be in a different location, you probably will have to travel a lot. ... \z
	Is this stake really important enough to you so that you are willing to take this burden?
npc.quentin.stdmod_33:
Detta är en speciell välsignelse som jag kan skänka dig när du har fått åtminstone en av de andra välsignelserna och som fungerar lite annorlunda. ... \z
	Det fungerar bara när du dödas av andra äventyrare, vilket betyder att minst hälften av skadan som ledde till din död orsakades av andra, inte av monster eller miljön. ... \z
	{twist of fate} kommer inte att minska dödsstraffet som de andra välsignelserna, utan istället hindra dig från att förlora dina andra välsignelser såväl som förlustamuletten, om du bär en. Det kostar lika mycket som de andra välsignelserna. ... \z
	Skulle du vilja få det skyddet för ett offer på |PVPBLESSCOST| guld, barn?
npc.quentin.stdmod_4: [EN] So receive my prayer: 'Light shall be near - and darkness afar'. Now, bring your stake to Tibra in the Carlin church for the next line of the prayer. I will inform her what to do.
npc.quentin.stdmod_6: [EN] You should visit Tibra in the Carlin church now.
npc.quentin.stdmod_7: Du har redan fått min bönrad.
npc.quentin.stdmod_8: Så ta emot skyddet av ödets vändning, pilgrim.
npc.quentin.stdmod_9: Bra. Du är fri att tacka nej till mitt erbjudande.
npc.quentin.walkaway_msg_1: Kom ihåg: Om du är svårt sårad eller förgiftad kan jag bota dig gratis.
npc.rabaz.greet_msg_1: [EN] Ah, a customer! Please feel free to browse my wares, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.rabaz.multi_1: [EN] Ah, thank you. Now look at that texture and fine colour, simply marvellous. ...
npc.rabaz.multi_10: [EN] If you lose it I will have to write a new one and put it in there again - which will undoubtedly take me a while. So keep an eye on it on your travels. ...
npc.rabaz.multi_11: [EN] Once you find what I need, best use a knife to carefully cut and gather a leaf or a scrap of their integument and press it directly under their appropriate entry into my botanical almanach. ...
npc.rabaz.multi_12: [EN] Simply return to me after you have done that and we will discuss your reward. What do you say, are you in?
npc.rabaz.multi_2: [EN] I hope the sun in the steppe did not exhaust you too much? Shellshock. A dangerous foe in the world of field science and exploration. ...
npc.rabaz.multi_3: [EN] Here, I always wore this comfortable hat when travelling, take it. It may be of use for you on further reconnaissances in Zao. Again you have my thanks, friend.
npc.rabaz.multi_4: [EN] Why yes, there is indeed some minor issue I could need your help with. I was always a friend of nature and it was not recently I discovered the joys of plants, growths, of all the flora around us. ...
npc.rabaz.multi_5: [EN] Botany my friend. The study of plants is of great importance for our future. Many of the potions we often depend on are made of plants you know. Plants can help us tending our wounds, cure us from illness or injury. ...
npc.rabaz.multi_6: [EN] I am currently writing an excessive compilation of all the knowledge I have gathered during my time here in Farmine and soon hope to publish it as 'Rabaz' Unabridged Almanach Of Botany'. ...
npc.rabaz.multi_7: [EN] However, to actually complete my botanical epitome concerning Zao, I would need someone to enter these dangerous lands. Someone able to get closer to the specimens than I can. ...
npc.rabaz.multi_8: [EN] And this is where you come in. There are two extremely rare species I need samples from. Typically not easy to come by but it should not be necessary to venture too far into Zao to find them. ...
npc.rabaz.multi_9: [EN] Explore the anterior outskirts of Zao, use my almanach and find the two specimens with missing samples on their pages. The almanach can be found in a chest in my storage, next to my shop. It's the door over there. ...
npc.rabaz.say_1: Naturligtvis, bara bläddra igenom mina varor. Du kan också titta på {}.
npc.rabaz.say_2: [EN] Yes? Yes! That's the enthusiasm I need! Remember to bring a sharp knife to gather the samples, plants - even mutated deformed plants - are very sensitive you know. Off you go and be careful out there, Zao is no place for the feint hearted mind you.
npc.rabaz.say_3: [EN] Oh, you don't have my book.
npc.rachel.say_1: Så du ber mig om en {{}} för att börja ditt äventyr?
npc.rachel.say_2: Vad? Jag har redan gett dig en {{}}!
npc.rachel.say_3: Naturligtvis, bara bläddra igenom mina varor. Du kan också titta på {}.
npc.rachel.stdmod_1: [EN] Okay, then just browse through all of my wares.
npc.raffael.greet_msg_1: Ja? Vad kan jag göra för dig, |PLAYERNAME|? Bankaffärer kanske?
npc.raffael.voice_1: Glöm inte att sätta in dina pengar här i Global Bank innan du ger dig ut på äventyr.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_1: [EN] Are you here to get a task or to report you finished task?
npc.rafzan.stdmod_10: [EN] They are mean and cruel. Humble goblin rarely trades with them. They would rather kill poor me if not too greedy for stuff only me can get them. Still, they rob me of it for a few spare coins and there is noooo profit for poor goblin.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_11: [EN] Me job merchant is. Me trade with all kinds of things. Me not good trader though, so you get everything incredibly cheap! You might think me mad, but please don't rip off poor goblin too much. Me has four or five wives and dozens of kids to feed!
npc.rafzan.stdmod_12: [EN] Humans so clever. Much, much smarter than poor, stupid goblin. They have big rich town. Goblin lives here poor and hungry. Me so impressed by you strong and smart humans. So much to learn from you. Poor goblin only sees pretty city from afar. Poor goblin too afraid to go there.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_13: [EN] Me have seen a gold coin once or twice. So bright and shiny it hurt me poor eyes. You surely are incredibly rich human who has even three or four coins at once! Perhaps you want to exchange them for some things me offer? Just don't rob me too much, me little stupid goblin, have no idea what stuff is worth... you look honest, you surely pay fair price like I ask and tell if it's too cheap.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_14: [EN] Furry guys are strange fellows. Always collecting things and stuff. Not easy to make them share, oh there is noooo profit for little, poor me to be made. They build underground dens that can stretch quite far. Rumour has it the corym have strange tunnels that connect their different networks all over the world.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_2: [EN] Me humble name is Rafzan. Good old goblin name meaning honest, generous and nice person, I swear!
npc.rafzan.stdmod_3: [EN] Most goblins so afraid of everything, that they fight everything. Me different. Me just want trade.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_4: [EN] You humans are so big, strong, clever and beautiful. Me really feel little and green beside you. Must be sooo fun to be human. You surely always make profit!
npc.rafzan.stdmod_5: [EN] To be honest to me human friend, me only heard about it, never seen one. I imagine it's something cute and cuddly.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_6: [EN] Swamp is horrible. Slowly eating away at health of poor little goblin. No profit here at all. Me will die poor and desperate, probably eaten by giant mosquitoes.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_7: [EN] Beardmen are nasty. Always want to kill little goblin. No trade at all. Not good, not good.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_8: [EN] So much to do, so little help. Me poor goblin desperately needs help. Me have a few tasks me need to be done. I can offer you all money I made if you only help me a little with stuff which is easy to strong smart human but impossible for poor, little me.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_9: [EN] Me heard Thais is big city with king! Must be strong and clever, to become chief of all humans. Me cannot imagine how many people you have to beat up to become king of all humans. Surely he makes lot of profit in his pretty city.
npc.rahkem.keyword_1: Så ta emot skyddet av ödets vändning, pilgrim.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_1: [EN] Please, not so loud, not so loud. Some of us are trying to rest in peace here.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_10: Tyvärr, du har inte tillräckligt med pengar.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_12: Du är sårad, mitt barn. Jag ska läka dina sår.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_13: Du ser inte så illa ut. Tyvärr, jag kan inte hjälpa dig. Men om du letar efter ytterligare skydd bör du gå på {pilgrimage} av aska eller få skyddet av {twist of fate} här.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_14: Jag tror att du har glömt att ta med din påle, pilgrim.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_15: Ja, jag fick besked om vad jag skulle göra. Är du beredd att ta emot min bönelinje?
npc.rahkem.stdmod_16: [EN] So receive my prayer: 'Let there be power and compassion'. Now, bring your stake to Brewster in Port Hope for the next line of the prayer. I will inform him what to do.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_18: [EN] You should visit Brewster in Port Hope now.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_19: Du har redan fått min bönrad.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_2: Så ta emot skyddet av ödets vändning, pilgrim.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_20: [EN] A blessed stake? That is a strange request. Maybe Quentin knows more, he is one of the oldest monks after all.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_21: Närhelst du får ett dödligt sår skadas din livskraft och det finns en chans att du tappar bort en del av din utrustning. Med varenda av de fem {blessings} du har kommer denna skada och risken för förlust att minska.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_22: [EN] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_23: Jag ser att du fick den andliga avskärmningen i det vita blomtemplet söder om Thais.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_24: Jag kan ana att druiderna norr om Carlin har försett dig med omfamningen Tibia.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_25: Jag kan se att du fick välsignelsen av de två solarna i soltornet nära Ab'Dendriel.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_26: Jag kan ana att gnistan från Fenix ​​redan gavs till dig av dvärgprästerna av jord och eld i Kazordoon.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_27: Jag kan känna att du redan pratade med eremiten Eremo på ön Cormaya och fick denna välsignelse.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_28: Du kan be om välsignelsen av andlig avskärmning i whiteflower-templet söder om Thais.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_29: Druiderna norr om Carlin kommer att förse dig med Tibia.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_3: Bra. Du är fri att tacka nej till mitt erbjudande.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_30: Du kan be om välsignelsen av de två solarna i soltornet nära Ab'Dendriel.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_33:
[EN] This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
npc.rahkem.stdmod_5: [EN] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.rahkem.stdmod_8: [EN] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.rahkem.voice_1: [EN] Please, not so loud, not so loud. Some of us are trying to rest in peace here.
npc.rapanaio.stdmod_1: [EN] Now that we have arrived you should waste no time and fight your way to the lair of evil and destroy its master before its too late!
npc.rapanaio.stdmod_2: [EN] Me humble name is Rapanaio. Good old goblin name meaning honest, generous and nice person, I swear!
npc.rapanaio_boat.farewell_msg_1: Hej då. Rekommendera oss om du är nöjd med vår tjänst.
npc.rapanaio_boat.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. I can travel you to {evil isle}.
npc.rapanaio_boat.stdmod_2: [EN] Do you seek a passage to {0} for {1}?
npc.rapanaio_boat.stdmod_3: [EN] We would like to serve you some time.
npc.rapanaio_boat.stdmod_4: [EN] My name is Rapanaio from the Royal Tibia Line.
npc.rapanaio_isle_of_evil.farewell_msg_1: Hej då. Rekommendera oss om du är nöjd med vår tjänst.
npc.rapanaio_isle_of_evil.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. I can travel you to {kazordoon}.
npc.rapanaio_isle_of_evil.stdmod_2: [EN] Do you seek a passage to {0} for {1}?
npc.rapanaio_isle_of_evil.stdmod_3: [EN] We would like to serve you some time.
npc.rapanaio_isle_of_evil.stdmod_4: [EN] My name is Rapanaio from the Royal Tibia Line.
npc.rashid.farewell_msg_1: [EN] Farewell, |PLAYERNAME|, may the winds guide your way.
npc.rashid.multi_1: [EN] My friend, it seems you have already learnt a lot about the art of trading. I think you are more than worthy to become a recognised trader. ...
npc.rashid.multi_10: [EN] Well, that's good to hear. From you as my trader and deliveryman, I expect more than bringing stinky cheese. ...
npc.rashid.multi_11: [EN] I wonder if you are able to deliver goods so fragile they almost break when looked at. ...
npc.rashid.multi_12: [EN] I have ordered a special elven vase from Briasol in Ab'Dendriel. Get it from him and don't even touch it, just bring it to me while I'm in Ankrahmun. Everything clear and understood?
npc.rashid.multi_13: [EN] Well, that's good to hear. From you as my trader and deliveryman, I expect more than carrying heavy packages. ...
npc.rashid.multi_14: [EN] You also need to be fast and deliver wares in time. I have ordered a very special cheese wheel made from Darashian milk. ...
npc.rashid.multi_15: [EN] Unfortunately, the high temperature in the desert makes it rot really fast, so it must not stay in the sun for too long. ...
npc.rashid.multi_16: [EN] I'm also afraid that you might not be able to use ships because of the smell of the cheese. ...
npc.rashid.multi_17: [EN] Please get the cheese from Miraia and bring it to me while I'm in Port Hope. Everything clear and understood?
npc.rashid.multi_18: [EN] Alright, that's good to hear. From you as my trader and deliveryman, I expect more than finding rare items. ...
npc.rashid.multi_19: [EN] You also need to be able to transport heavy wares, weaklings won't get far here. I have ordered a special package from Edron. ...
npc.rashid.multi_2: [EN] There is just one little favour that I would ask from you... something personal, actually, forgive my boldness. ...
npc.rashid.multi_20: [EN] Pick it up from Willard and bring it back to me while I'm in Liberty Bay. Everything clear and understood?
npc.rashid.multi_21: [EN] Very good! I need talented people who are able to handle my wares with care, find good offers and the like, so I'm going to test you. ...
npc.rashid.multi_22: [EN] First, I'd like to see if you can dig up rare wares. Something like a ... mastermind shield! ...
npc.rashid.multi_23: [EN] Haha, just kidding, fooled you there, didn't I? Always control your nerves, that's quite important during bargaining. ...
npc.rashid.multi_24: [EN] Okay, all I want from you is one of these rare deer trophies. I have a customer here in Svargrond who ordered one, so I'd like you to deliver it tome while I'm in Svargrond. ...
npc.rashid.multi_3: [EN] I have always dreamed to have a small pet, one that I could take with me and which wouldn't cause problems. ...
npc.rashid.multi_4: [EN] Could you - just maybe - bring me a small goldfish in a bowl? I know that you would be able to get one, wouldn't you?
npc.rashid.multi_5: [EN] Fine! There's one more skill that I need to test and which is cruicial for a successful trader. ...
npc.rashid.multi_6: [EN] Of course you must be able to haggle, else you won't survive long in this business. To make things as hard as possible for you, I have the perfect trade partner for you. ...
npc.rashid.multi_7: [EN] Of course, it has to be cheap. Don't come back with anything more expensive than 400 gold. ...
npc.rashid.multi_8: [EN] And the quality must not suffer, of course! Everything clear and understood?
npc.rashid.multi_9: [EN] And the quality must not suffer, of course! Everything clear and understood?
npc.rashid.say_1: [EN] Well, you could attempt the mission to become a recognised trader, but it requires a lot of travelling. Are you willing to try?
npc.rashid.say_10: [EN] Have you brought a cheap but good crimson sword?
npc.rashid.say_11: [EN] So, my friend, are you willing to proceed to the next mission to become a recognised trader?
npc.rashid.say_12: [EN] Have you brought me a gold fish??
npc.rashid.say_13: [EN] Ah, right. <ahem> I hereby declare you - one of my recognised traders! Feel free to offer me your wares, just ask me for a {trade}!
npc.rashid.say_14: [EN] Fine. Then get a hold of that deer trophy and bring it to me while I'm in Svargrond. Just ask me about your mission.
npc.rashid.say_15: [EN] Well done! I'll take that from you. <snags it> Come see me another day, I'll be busy for a while now.
npc.rashid.say_16: [EN] Fine. Then off you go, just ask Willard about the 'package for Rashid'.
npc.rashid.say_17: [EN] Great. Just place it over there - yes, thanks, that's it. Come see me another day, I'll be busy for a while now.
npc.rashid.say_18: [EN] Okay, then please find Miraia in Darashia and ask her about the {'scarab cheese'}.
npc.rashid.say_19: [EN] Mmmhh, the lovely odeur of scarab cheese! I really can't understand why most people can't stand it. Thanks, well done!
npc.rashid.say_2: [EN] Have you managed to obtain a rare deer trophy for my customer?
npc.rashid.say_20: [EN] Okay, then please find {Briasol} in {Ab'Dendriel} and ask for a {'fine vase'}.
npc.rashid.say_21: [EN] I'm surprised that you managed to bring this vase without a single crack. That was what I needed to know, thank you.
npc.rashid.say_22: [EN] Okay, I'm curious how you will do with {Uzgod}. Good luck!
npc.rashid.say_23: [EN] Ha! You are clever indeed, well done! I'll take this from you. Come see me tomorrow, I think we two might get into business after all.
npc.rashid.say_24: [EN] Thanks so much! I'll be waiting eagerly for your return then.
npc.rashid.say_25: [EN] Thank you!! Ah, this makes my day! I'll take the rest of the day off to get to know this little guy. Come see me tomorrow, if you like.
npc.rashid.say_3: [EN] So, my friend, are you willing to proceed to the next mission to become a recognised trader?
npc.rashid.say_4: [EN] Did you bring me the package?
npc.rashid.say_48: [EN] Sorry, but you do not belong to my exclusive customers. I have to make sure that I can trust in the quality of your wares.
npc.rashid.say_5: [EN] So, my friend, are you willing to proceed to the next mission to become a recognised trader?
npc.rashid.say_7: [EN] So, my friend, are you willing to proceed to the next mission to become a recognised trader?
npc.rashid.say_9: [EN] So, my friend, are you willing to proceed to the next mission to become a recognised trader?
npc.rashid.sendtrade_msg_1: [EN] Take all the time you need to decide what you want!
npc.rashid.stdmod_1: [EN] I am a travelling trader. I don't buy everything, though. And not from everyone, for that matter.
npc.rashid.stdmod_10: [EN] Too few customers there, it's not worth the trip.
npc.rashid.stdmod_12: [EN] I don't like being underground much. I also tend to get lost in these labyrinthine dwarven tunnels, so I rather avoid them.
npc.rashid.stdmod_13: [EN] When you avoid the slums, it's a really pretty city. Almost as pretty as the governor's daughter.
npc.rashid.stdmod_15: [EN] I like the settlement itself, but I don't set my foot into the jungle. Have you seen the size of these centipedes??
npc.rashid.stdmod_17: [EN] I wish it was a little bit warmer there, but with a good mug of barbarian mead in your tummy everything gets a lot cosier.
npc.rashid.stdmod_18: [EN] I feel uncomfortable and rather unsafe in Thais, so I don't really travel there.
npc.rashid.stdmod_2: [EN] I am Rashid, son of the desert.
npc.rashid.stdmod_20: [EN] Although it's the flourishing trade centre of Tibia, I don't like going there. Too much competition for my taste.
npc.rashid.stdmod_21: [EN] It's almost time to journey on.
npc.rashid.stdmod_22: [EN] Kings, queens, emperors and kaliphs... everyone claims to be different and unique, but actually it's the same thing everywhere.
npc.rashid.stdmod_3: [EN] Of course, old friend. You can also browse only armor, legs, shields, helmets, boots, weapons, enchanted weapons, jewelry or miscellaneous stuff.
npc.rashid.stdmod_4: [EN] Elves... I don't really trust them. All this talk about nature and flowers and treehugging... I'm sure there's some wicked scheme behind all this.
npc.rashid.stdmod_5: [EN] My beloved hometown! Ah, the sweet scent of the desert sands, the perfect shape of the pyramids... stunningly beautiful.
npc.rashid.stdmod_6: [EN] I have to go to Carlin once in a while, since the queen wishes to see my exclusive wares in regular intervals.
npc.rashid.stdmod_7: [EN] Cormaya? Not a good place to make business, it's way too far and small.
npc.rashid.stdmod_8: [EN] It's not the real thing, but almost as good. The merchants there claim ridiculous prices, which is fine for my own business.
npc.rashid.stdmod_9: [EN] Ah yes, Edron! Such a lovely and quiet island! I usually make some nice business there.

npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_17: [EN] I wish it was a little bit warmer there, but with a good mug of barbarian mead in your tummy everything gets a lot cosier.
npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_18: [EN] I feel uncomfortable and rather unsafe in Thais, so I don't really travel there.
npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_2: [EN] I am Rashid, son of the desert.
npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_20: [EN] Although it's the flourishing trade centre of Tibia, I don't like going there. Too much competition for my taste.
npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_21: [EN] It's almost time to journey on.
npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_22: [EN] Kings, queens, emperors and kaliphs... everyone claims to be different and unique, but actually it's the same thing everywhere.
npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_3: [EN] Of course, old friend. You can also browse only armor, legs, shields, helmets, boots, weapons, enchanted weapons, jewelry or miscellaneous stuff.
npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_4: [EN] Elves... I don't really trust them. All this talk about nature and flowers and treehugging... I'm sure there's some wicked scheme behind all this.
npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_5: [EN] My beloved hometown! Ah, the sweet scent of the desert sands, the perfect shape of the pyramids... stunningly beautiful.
npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_6: [EN] I have to go to Carlin once in a while, since the queen wishes to see my exclusive wares in regular intervals.
npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_7: [EN] Cormaya? Not a good place to make business, it's way too far and small.
npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_8: [EN] It's not the real thing, but almost as good. The merchants there claim ridiculous prices, which is fine for my own business.
npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_9: [EN] Ah yes, Edron! Such a lovely and quiet island! I usually make some nice business there.
npc.rata_mari.greet_1: [EN] Meep? I mean - hello! Sorry, |PLAYERNAME|... Being a {rat} has kind of grown on me.
npc.rata_mari.greet_msg_1: [EN] Meep? I mean - hello! Sorry, |PLAYERNAME|... Being a {rat} has kind of grown on me.
npc.rata_mari.multi_1: [EN] You have come for the report? Great! I have been working hard on it during the last months. And nobody came to pick it up. I thought everybody had forgotten about me! ...
npc.rata_mari.multi_2: [EN] Do you have any idea how difficult it is to hold a pen when you have claws instead of hands? ...
npc.rata_mari.multi_3: [EN] But - you know - now I have worked so hard on this report I somehow don't want to part with it. At least not without some decent payment. ...
npc.rata_mari.multi_4: [EN] All right - listen - I know Fa'hradin would not approve of this, but I can't help it. I need some cheese! I need it now! ...
npc.rata_mari.multi_5: [EN] And I will not give the report to you until you get me some! Meep!
npc.rata_mari.say_1: [EN] Ok, have you brought me the cheese, I've asked for?
npc.rata_mari.say_2: [EN] I already gave you the report. I'm not going to write another one!
npc.rata_mari.say_4: [EN] Meep! Meep! Great! Here is the spyreport for you!
npc.rata_mari.stdmod_1: [EN] Your power of observation is stunning. Yes, I'm a rat.
npc.raymond_striker.greet_msg_1: [EN] Be greeted. Is there anything I can {do for you}?
npc.raymond_striker.multi_1: [EN] So you went into the leaders' hideout? I hope you were successful and got what you were looking for! Thank you, my friend. Pirates still keep coming here, unfortunately. ...
npc.raymond_striker.multi_10: [EN] It doesn't matter how long it takes, but... would you be willing to kill 3000 pirates for us?
npc.raymond_striker.multi_11: [EN] Incredible! You did what no other did even dare to think about! You are indeed a true hero to our cause ...
npc.raymond_striker.multi_12: [EN] Sadly I have no ship that lacks a captain, else you would of course be our first choice. I am still true to my word asbest as I am able. ...
npc.raymond_striker.multi_13: [EN] So take this as your very own ship. Oh, and remind me about the pirate outfit sometime.
npc.raymond_striker.multi_14: [EN] Well done, my friend. That will help us a lot. Of course there are other things to be done though. ...
npc.raymond_striker.multi_15: [EN] I learned that Klaus, the owner of the tavern, wants me dead. He is offering any of those pirates a mission to kill me....
npc.raymond_striker.multi_16: [EN] If we could convince him that you fulfilled that mission, the pirates will have the party of their lives. This would beour chance for a sneak attack to damage their boats and steal their plunder! ...
npc.raymond_striker.multi_17: [EN] Obtain this mission from him and learn what he needs as a proof. Then return to me and report to me about yourmission so we can formulate an appropriate plan.
npc.raymond_striker.multi_18: [EN] If you manage to accomplish this vital mission you will prove yourself to be a worthy member of our community. Imight even grant you your own ship and pirate clothing! ...
npc.raymond_striker.multi_19: [EN] So listen to the first step of my plan. I want you to infiltrate their base. Try to enter their tavern, which meansthat you have to get past the guard. ...
npc.raymond_striker.multi_2: [EN] Do you, by chance, would like to kill pirates again for us?
npc.raymond_striker.multi_20: [EN] You will probably have to deceive him somehow, so that he thinks you are one of them. ...
npc.raymond_striker.multi_21: [EN] In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
npc.raymond_striker.multi_22: [EN] Afterwards, return here and report to me about your mission.
npc.raymond_striker.multi_23: [EN] The mission on which I will send you is vital to our cause. It is a sabotage mission. Nargor is guarded by several heavy catapults. ...
npc.raymond_striker.multi_24: [EN] I need you to sabotage the most dangerous of those catapults which can be found right in their harbour, aiming at ships passing by the entrance. ...
npc.raymond_striker.multi_25: [EN] Get a fire bug - you can buy them in Liberty Bay - and set this catapult on fire. ...
npc.raymond_striker.multi_26: [EN] Make sure to use the bug on the left part of the catapult where its lever is. That is where it's most vulnerable. ...
npc.raymond_striker.multi_27: [EN] If you see a short explosion, you will know that it worked. I will tell Sebastian to bring you to Nargor, but beware. ...
npc.raymond_striker.multi_28: [EN] Of course, he can't drop you off directly in the pirate's base. However, we have discovered a secret way into the Howling Grotto. ...
npc.raymond_striker.multi_29: [EN] Try to make your way through the caves of Nargor to reach their harbour. This is where you will find the catapult in question.
npc.raymond_striker.multi_3: [EN] This was probably the last time you will be able to enter that hideout. Well done, my friend, our thanks are with you. ...
npc.raymond_striker.multi_30: [EN] Indeed, I could use some help. The evil pirates of Nargor have convinced an alchemist from Edron to supply them with a substance called Fafnar's Fire ...
npc.raymond_striker.multi_31: [EN] It can burn even on water and is a threat to us all. I need you to travel to Edron and pretend to the alchemist Sandra that you are the one whom the other pirates sent to get the fire ...
npc.raymond_striker.multi_32: [EN] When she asks for a payment, tell her 'Your continued existence is payment enough'. That should enrage any member of the Edron academy enough to refuse any further deals with the pirates.
npc.raymond_striker.multi_4: [EN] You are most welcome to keep on killing pirates for us though for some bucks and experience. If you want to do so, just ask me about a {task} anytime.
npc.raymond_striker.multi_5: [EN] Hey, great. You've done well! As a small reward I give you some coins from our treasure box. Also, let me tell you an interesting piece of information. ...
npc.raymond_striker.multi_6: [EN] One of our spies told us about a secret hideout somewhere on Nargor. Supposedly, one of the four pirate leaders can be found there sometimes. If you dare go there, you might be able to face him or her in one on one combat. ...
npc.raymond_striker.multi_7: [EN] Beware though - prepare yourself well and only flee if you must. This might be your only chance to get into there, so be careful and don't die!
npc.raymond_striker.multi_8: [EN] The pirates on Nargor are becoming more and more of a threat to us each day. I wish someone could get rid of them once and for all, but unfortunately they just keep coming! ...
npc.raymond_striker.multi_9: [EN] Only a dead pirate is a good pirate. I think killing a large number of them would definitely help us to make Sabrehaven a safer place. ...
npc.raymond_striker.say_1: [EN] Eleonore ... Yes, I remember her... vaguely. She is a pretty girl ... but still only a girl and now I am in love with a beautiful and passionate woman. A true {mermaid} even.
npc.raymond_striker.say_10: [EN] Ahh, thank you, my friend! What would we do without you? Here, take this reward for your efforts. If you want to continue to help us killing pirates, just ask me about that {task}.
npc.raymond_striker.say_12: [EN] Do you, by chance, would like to kill pirates again for us?
npc.raymond_striker.say_13: [EN] Perfect. I know it sounds like a lot, but really, take your time. You won't do it for nothing, I promise.
npc.raymond_striker.say_2: [EN] Don't ask about silly missions. All I can think about is this lovely {mermaid}.
npc.raymond_striker.say_3: [EN] Ask around in the settlement where you can help out. If you have proven your worth I might have some missions for you.
npc.raymond_striker.say_4: [EN] I think that means 'mission accomplished'. Hehe. I guess that will put an end to their efforts to buy any alchemical substance from Edron.
npc.raymond_striker.say_6: [EN] My pillow?? They know me all too well... <sigh> I've owned it since my childhood. However. Here, take it and convincehim that I am dead.
npc.raymond_striker.say_7: [EN] The mermaid is the most beautiful creature I have ever met. She is so wonderful. It was some kind of magic as we first met. A look in her eyes and I suddenly knew there would be never again another woman in my life but her.
npc.raymond_striker.say_8: [EN] I am deeply ashamed that I lacked the willpower to resist her spell. Thank you for your help in that matter. Now my head is once more free to think about our {mission}.
npc.raymond_striker.say_9: [EN] Ah, right! The pirate outfit! Here you go, now you are truly one of us.
npc.razan.ape_fur_ask: [EN] Have you really managed to fulfil the task and brought me 100 pieces of ape fur?
npc.razan.ape_fur_done: [EN] Ahhh, this softness! I'm impressed, |PLAYERNAME|. You're on the best way to earn that turban. Now, please retrieve 100 fish fins.
npc.razan.ape_fur_info: [EN] Only ape fur is good enough to touch the feet of our Caliph.
npc.razan.blue_cloth_ask: [EN] Ah, have you brought the 100 pieces of blue cloth?
npc.razan.blue_cloth_done: [EN] Ah! Congratulations - even if you are not a true weaponmaster, you surely deserve to wear this turban. Here, I'll tie it for you.
npc.razan.blue_cloth_info: [EN] It's a great material for turbans.
npc.razan.chicken_wings_ask: [EN] Were you able to get hold of two enchanted chicken wings?
npc.razan.chicken_wings_done: [EN] Great, thank you very much. Just bring me 100 pieces of blue cloth now and I will happily show you how to make a turban.
npc.razan.chicken_wings_info: [EN] Enchanted chicken wings are actually used to make boots of haste, so they could be magically extracted again. Djinns are said to be good at that.
npc.razan.fish_fins_ask: [EN] Were you able to discover the undersea race and retrieved 100 fish fins?
npc.razan.fish_fins_done: [EN] I never thought you'd make it, |PLAYERNAME|. Now we only need two enchanted chicken wings to start our waterwalking test!
npc.razan.fish_fins_info: [EN] I really wonder what the explorer society is up to. Actually I have no idea how they managed to dive unterwater.
npc.razan.greet_msg_1: [EN] Greetings |PLAYERNAME|. What leads you to me?
npc.razan.multi_1: [EN] Alright, then listen to the following requirements. We are currently in dire need of ape fur since the Caliph has requested a new bathroom carpet. ...
npc.razan.multi_2: [EN] Thus, please bring me 100 pieces of ape fur. Secondly, it came to our ears that the explorer society has discovered a new undersea race of fishmen. ...
npc.razan.multi_3: [EN] Their fins are said to allow humans to walk on water! Please bring us 100 of these fish fin. ...
npc.razan.multi_4: [EN] Third, if the plan of walking on water should fail, we need enchanted chicken wings to prevent the testers from drowning. Please bring me two. ...
npc.razan.multi_5: [EN] Last but not least, just drop by with 100 pieces of blue cloth and I will happily show you how to make a turban. ...
npc.razan.multi_6: [EN] Did you understand everything I told you and are willing to handle this task?
npc.razan.say_1: [EN] My turban? Eh no, you can't have it. Only oriental weapon masters may wear it after having completed a difficult task.
npc.razan.say_2: [EN] You mean, you would like to prove that you deserve to wear such a turban?
npc.razan.say_3: [EN] Excellent! Come back to me once you have collected 100 pieces of ape fur.
npc.red_lilly.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello sweetie. If you need general equipment, stuff like that, let me know.
npc.red_lilly.sendtrade_msg_1: [EN] Of course, just browse through my wares. Remember that if you buy vials of oil, there's a deposit of 5 gold on the empty one.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_1: [EN] Come visit my little pawnshop! General equipment and such. Don't miss it!
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_10: [EN] What interest could a king have in this little settlement? If a king cares about us, there must be something important behind all this.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_11: [EN] Liberty comes, liberty goes, only the bay stays. Hehe.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_12: [EN] I sell torches, candelabra, and oil.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_13: [EN] That guy is a shrewd trader, sweetie. I bet even I could learn a thing or two from him.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_14: [EN] I have shovels, picks, scythes, bags, ropes, backpacks, plates, scrolls, watches, some lightsources, and other stuff. Just ask me for a {trade}.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_15: [EN] Mostly, pirates are bad for business. But sometimes, they are good for business.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_16: [EN] Sadly the workers have hardly enough money to buy something to eat and to drink. That is bad also for my business.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_17: [EN] Ah, there is little in the world that comes close to the taste of rum.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_18: [EN] I heard there is a fine bounty on his head. Would be a shame though to lose such a handsome man to the executioner <winks>.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_19: [EN] Sugar lets the money flow. We depend heavily on it.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_2: [EN] Just between you and me hun, that woman is a witch. Love potions, poison, voodoo dolls to torture your neighbour. You name it, she got it.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_20: [EN] Thais might be a splendid town, but this is of no use to us here. The situation in our town gets worse with every ship full of foreigners that arrives here.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_21: [EN] I heard Venore will soon acquire several trade monopolies that will grant them wealth for centuries.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_22: [EN] Well, <lowers the voice to a whisper> there are several people around who know this or that about voodoo and not all of them are up to something good. Just buy some lucky charms from that old hag Charlotta to be on the safe side.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_23: [EN] A handsome man but a bit too stiff. I think no one has ever had a chance to see him smiling.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_24: [EN] I will pay you 5 gold for every empty vial. Ok?
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_25: [EN] Hmm, but please keep Tibia litter free.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_27:
[EN] The quara are the curse of the sea. Everybody that dares to enrage the sea spirits has to fear their vengeance. They come at night to kidnap people who forgot their lucky charms at home ... \z
	Sometimes those evil beings take the most naughty children to raise them as their own underwater.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_3: [EN] Uh! <whispers> There are ... rumours, you know? About bloody rituals and gruesome curses ... better don't talk aloud about such issues.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_4: [EN] Kshh!! No talks about ... the magic folk here ... This might draw their attention.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_5: [EN] Hard to imagine that this fat man has such a pretty daughter.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_6: [EN] Don't mention HIM in my house you fool. You call evil and mayhem upon us.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_7: [EN] I am not dealing with food.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_8: [EN] I won't say anything bad about such a high-born person. That's why I remain silent hun .
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_9: [EN] I run this little pawnshop, hun, but I think you knew that already.
npc.red_lilly.voice_1: [EN] Come visit my little pawnshop! General equipment and such. Don't miss it!
npc.reed.say_1: [EN] You have NO idea what we have to endure each day .. <gives a shocking and disturbing report>.
npc.reed.say_2: [EN] You can {pass} either to the {Cemetery Quarter} or {Magician Quarter}. Which one will it be?
npc.rehon.say_1: [EN] By the Gods! You have the key to the cell! Thank you sooo much, mate. And now leave. I'll wait here until the air is clean and then I'm out of here.
npc.richard.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello there, mate. Here for a {trade}? My stock's just been refilled.
npc.richard.say_1: [EN] I was a carpenter, back on Main. Wanted my own little shop. Didn't sit with the old man. So I shipped to somewhere else. Terrible storm.
npc.richard.say_2: [EN] Woke up on this island. Had to eat squirrels before the adventurers found me and took me in. End of story.
npc.richard.say_3: [EN] Only the best quality, I assure you. A rope in need is a friend indeed! Imagine you stumble into a rat hole without a rope - heh, your bones will be gnawed clean before someone finds ya!
npc.richard.say_4: [EN] Now, about that rope - ask me for {equipment} to see my wares. <winks>
npc.richard.stdmod_1: [EN] Don't forget to always have a rope with you! Buy one here, only the best quality!
npc.richard.stdmod_10:
[EN] You know, I really don't want to poke into someone else's private life. \z
			Suffice it to say that everyone has chapters of his life he doesn't want to mention. \z
			Judging by Coltrayne's looks, we're looking at a trilogy here.
npc.richard.stdmod_11:
[EN] Old Inigo was the one who found me, actually, and brought me to the outpost. \z
			I was half starved by then. He taught me how to make better traps and how to fish... I owe much to Inigo.
npc.richard.stdmod_2: [EN] Don't complain to ME when you fell down a hole without a rope to get you out! You can buy one here now!
npc.richard.stdmod_4: [EN] A rope is the adventurer's best friend!
npc.richard.stdmod_5: [EN] Fresh meat! Durable provisions! Ropes and shovels!
npc.richard.stdmod_6:
[EN] Feeling like a bit of treasure-seeking? \z
		Buy a shovel or a pick and investigate likely-looking stone piles and cracks!
npc.richard.stdmod_7: [EN] Richard. Just Richard. Lost my surname with my past in that storm. <winks>
npc.richard.stdmod_8:
[EN] This lovely island here. Once I didn't have to live off squirrels, it became quite enjoyable. \z
			Nasty things though live underground, so take care where you tread and ALWAYS have a rope with you!
npc.richard.stdmod_9: [EN] <shrugs> Never been, mate. Heard it's kinda cute, though.
npc.richard.voice_1: [EN] Don't forget to always have a rope with you! Buy one here, only the best quality!
npc.richard.voice_2: [EN] Don't complain to ME when you fell down a hole without a rope to get you out! You can buy one here now!
npc.richard.voice_4: [EN] A rope is the adventurer's best friend!
npc.richard.voice_5: [EN] Fresh meat! Durable provisions! Ropes and shovels!
npc.richard.voice_6:
[EN] Feeling like a bit of treasure-seeking? \z
		Buy a shovel or a pick and investigate likely-looking stone piles and cracks!
npc.riddler.farewell_msg_1: [EN] HEHEHE! I knew you don't have the stomach.
npc.riddler.greet_msg_1: [EN] |PLAYERNAME| HEHEHEHE! Another fool visits the {tower}! Excellent!
npc.riddler.say_1: [EN] FOOL! Now you're doomed! But well ... \z So be it! Let's start out with the Seal of Knowledge and the first question: \z What name did the necromant king choose for himself?
npc.riddler.say_10: [EN] HOHO! You have learned your lesson well. Question number two then: Who or what is the feared Hugo?
npc.riddler.say_11: [EN] Hm. I bet you think you're smart. All right. How about this: What does everybody want to become but nobody to be?
npc.riddler.say_12: [EN] UHM UH OH ... How could you guess that? Are you mad??? All right. Penultimate question: What is the opposite?
npc.riddler.say_13: [EN] NO! NO! NO! That can't be true. You're not only mad, you are a complete idiot! Ah well. Here is the last question: What is 1 plus 1?
npc.riddler.say_2: [EN] HOHO! You have learned your lesson well. \z Question number two then: Who or what is the feared Hugo?
npc.riddler.say_3: [EN] Hm. I bet you think you're smart. All right. \z How about this: What does everybody want to become but nobody to be?
npc.riddler.say_4: [EN] UHM UH OH ... How could you guess that? Are you mad??? All right. \z Penultimate question: What is the opposite?
npc.riddler.say_5: [EN] NO! NO! NO! That can't be true. You're not only mad, you are a complete idiot! \z Ah well. Here is the last question: What is 1 plus 1?
npc.riddler.say_6: [EN] That was an easy one. Let's try the second: If you name it, you break it.
npc.riddler.say_7: [EN] ARGH! You did it again! Well all right. Do you wish to break the Seal of Madness?
npc.riddler.say_8: [EN] GOOD! So I will get you at last. Answer this: What is your favourite colour?
npc.riddler.say_9: [EN] FOOL! Now you're doomed! But well ... So be it! Let's start out with the Seal of Knowledge and the first question: What name did the necromant king choose for himself?
npc.riddler.stdmod_1: [EN] This tower, of course, silly one. It holds my {master'}s {treasure}.
npc.riddler.stdmod_2: [EN] His name is none of your business
npc.riddler.stdmod_3: [EN] I am guarding the treasures of the tower. Only those who pass the {test} of the three sigils may pass.
npc.riddler.stdmod_4: [EN] I am known as the riddler. That is all you need to know.
npc.riddler.stdmod_5: [EN] I am the guardian of the paradox tower.
npc.riddler.stdmod_6: [EN] The key of this tower! You will never find it! A malicious plant spirit is guarding it!.
npc.robson.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hrmpf, I'd say welcome if I felt like lying.
npc.robson.say_1: [EN] Do you want to buy a parcel for 15 gold?
npc.robson.say_2: [EN] Do you want to buy a label for 1 gold?
npc.robson.say_3: [EN] Sorry, that's only dust in your purse.
npc.robson.say_5: [EN] Sorry, that's only dust in your purse.
npc.robson.say_7: [EN] I knew I would be stuck with that stuff.
npc.robson.voice_2: [EN] Just great. Getting stranded on a remote underground isle was not that bad but now I'm becoming a tourist attraction!
npc.rock_in_a_hard_place.farewell_msg_1: [EN] Promise to come back sometime, will ya?
npc.rock_in_a_hard_place.greet_msg_1: [EN] Everyone on this island has gone crazy! Except for me and you, it seems. Let's {trade} like normal people would.
npc.rock_in_a_hard_place.say_1: [EN] Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.
npc.rock_in_a_hard_place.say_2: [EN] You would be surprised how many things are washed ashore here. I trade {}.
npc.rock_in_a_hard_place.stdmod_1: [EN] Have you noticed that I'm actually the only rock on this island with a proper job? Those lazy pebbleheads! I'm proud to announce: I'm a trader
npc.rock_in_a_hard_place.stdmod_2: [EN] No, you got it all wrong! I said I'm stuck between a rock and a hard place!
npc.rock_in_a_hard_place.stdmod_3: [EN] I can help you buy trading stuff with you. Good for me, good for you. It's a win-win!
npc.rock_in_a_hard_place.stdmod_4: [EN] Have you noticed that I'm actually the only rock on this island with a proper job? Those lazy pebbleheads! I'm proud to announce: I'm a trader
npc.rock_in_a_hard_place.walkaway_msg_1: [EN] Hey! Don't leave me alone with all these lunatics!
npc.rock_steady.multi_1: [EN] Have you got anything... what? You want what? A reward? HAHAHAHAAAA!! ...
npc.rock_steady.multi_2: [EN] No I'm just teasing you. I'm really happy about my collection now. ...
npc.rock_steady.multi_3: [EN] Well, I found some kind of weapon a long time ago. I believe it may be especially helpful underwater as it is from the deep folk. In any case it is of more use for you than it would be for me.
npc.rock_steady.multi_4: [EN] I collect everything that reflects light in strange ways. However, I am bored by my collection. And there wasn't anything new to add for years. ...
npc.rock_steady.multi_5: [EN] I like pearls for example - but I have already enough. I also like shells - but I can't even count how many I already own. ...
npc.rock_steady.multi_6: [EN] If you find anything of REAL VALUE - bring it to me. I will reward you well. You don't already have something for me by chance?
npc.rock_steady.say_1: [EN] If you want anything, you should talk to Old Rock Boy over there. I do {collect} stuff, though. So just ask if you're interested in helping me.
npc.rock_steady.say_2: [EN] Have you got anything for me today?
npc.rock_steady.say_3: [EN] Have you got anything for me today?
npc.rock_steady.say_4: [EN] Great! Let me see. Amazing! I will take this, thank you!
npc.rock_steady.say_5: [EN] Great! Let me see. Amazing! I will take this, thank you!
npc.rock_steady.say_6: [EN] Great! Let me see. Amazing! I will take this, thank you!
npc.rock_steady.say_7: [EN] You dont have the required items!
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome, this is the {Gray Beach temple}, |PLAYERNAME|. Whether you are wounded, poisoned - or wait, don't tell me - yes, this is probably a case of being more emotionally hurt, I will do my best to {heal} you.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.keyword_1: [EN] So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_1: [EN] So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_11: [EN] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_12: [EN] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_13: [EN] Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_14: [EN] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_15: [EN] I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_16: [EN] I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_17: [EN] I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_18: [EN] I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_19: [EN] I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_2: [EN] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_20: [EN] You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_21: [EN] The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_22: [EN] You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_23: [EN] The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_25:
[EN] This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_4: [EN] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_7: [EN] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_9: [EN] Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.rokyn.greet_msg_1: Ja? Vad kan jag göra för dig, |PLAYERNAME|? Bankaffärer kanske?
npc.rokyn.voice_1: [EN] Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.romella.farewell_msg_1: [EN] Goodbye and please bring more gold next time <chuckles>. I mean, it would be nice to see you again.
npc.romella.greet_msg_1: [EN] I welcome thee, |PLAYERNAME|! I suppose you are looking for a trade in fine weapons!
npc.romella.stdmod_1: [EN] Check out my good and sturdy weapons!
npc.romella.stdmod_2: [EN] I am Romella and I will be serving you today.
npc.romella.stdmod_3: [EN] I have many weapons to offer. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.romella.stdmod_4: [EN] I sell and buy weapons. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.romella.stdmod_5: [EN] Our warehouse is the main supplier of the local garrison.
npc.romella.stdmod_6: [EN] It says the amazons are looking for a certain magical weapon in this area.
npc.romella.stdmod_7: [EN] I wonder how they finance themselves. I bet they are secretly trading in some strange stuff.
npc.romella.stdmod_8: [EN] Make sure to buy some extra weapons before facing that one.
npc.romella.stdmod_9: [EN] I heard the amazons are after it.
npc.romella.voice_1: [EN] Check out my good and sturdy weapons!
npc.romir.greet_msg_1: [EN] Greetings, traveller. I'm a magical trader and trainer for sorcerer spells. How may I help you?
npc.romir.say_1: [EN] Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.
npc.rose.say_1: [EN] Do you want to buy a Hydra Tongue for 100 gold?
npc.rose.say_2: [EN] Here you are. A Hydra Tongue!
npc.rose.say_3: Du har inte tillräckligt med pengar.
npc.roswitha.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello, my lad. Sit down, have a drink, why don't you?
npc.roswitha.say_1: [EN] I'm sorry, but Harsin no longer lives here. He ordered a local named Quandon to transport all his stuff somewhere. I don't know where he moved, but Quandon should be able to help you with this information.
npc.rotem_valos.voice_1: [EN] <sigh> The world has grown complicated since my youth.
npc.rottin_wood.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hunter's greeting! I assume you want something from me since you came all the way out here on your own. This is a dangerous place to be, I doubt that all my men will accept strangers like I do. You don't seem to have any problems with that, though.
npc.rottin_wood.multi_1: [EN] Alright very good. Now the only thing you need to do is taking these traps and moving out to the area I have marked on your map where you need to place them. ...
npc.rottin_wood.multi_10: [EN] There is but a tiny little catch - we cannot help you laying these traps. You know, some of the guys became sick recently, we talk about several broken legs here, one almost lost his arm ...
npc.rottin_wood.multi_11: [EN] So... it's entirely up to you, will you do this or not?
npc.rottin_wood.multi_12: [EN] Mmmmh, I have to say - good workmanship. No doubt. Yes, the person who made that tool you used to fix all this was a pure professional. Something I can't say about your work, though. ...
npc.rottin_wood.multi_13: [EN] The walls look as if they will come off in a matter of hours. Oh well, you can always come back and repair this mess, ask me for a task if you want to. Yeah, yeah and here's your reward for today.
npc.rottin_wood.multi_14: [EN] Fine, now hurry into the woods and find some rabbits. Find them and kill them that is. Use a sharp, thin knife to get the rabbit foot and be careful not to destroy it - no one would buy it in a bad condition after all. ...
npc.rottin_wood.multi_15: [EN] Once you gathered some rabbit feet, put one of our - handcrafted by the guys - ribbons on each of them. That will make two lucky charms per rabbit. ...
npc.rottin_wood.multi_16: [EN] We will need at least seven. And seven is a lucky number, don't you think? Heh. ...
npc.rottin_wood.multi_17: [EN] If you need some more ribbons just come back to me and ask.
npc.rottin_wood.multi_18: [EN] Oh |PLAYERNAME| my good friend, good to see you! Today you will help us with a very important task. Very important indeed. ...
npc.rottin_wood.multi_19: [EN] You know, a large group of merchants is travelling from Thais to Venore and they are crossing the forest to shorten their way - can you believe it? ...
npc.rottin_wood.multi_2: [EN] Once you did that go to the large high seat near the camp and watch for the travelling merchants. ...
npc.rottin_wood.multi_20: [EN] They will enter the forest near our camp which is where you come in - uhm I mean you do want to help us with this, right?
npc.rottin_wood.multi_21: [EN] Of course, of course, there is indeed something you can help us with. Remember that we also have some tasks for you. So, are you ready for another quest to help the men of the forest?
npc.rottin_wood.multi_22: [EN] There is a problem with one of our deer stands. Right. Well, there are two problems, our deer stands - and some of the walls of the buildings in the camp are broken. ...
npc.rottin_wood.multi_23: [EN] You know, the guys built all of that themselves. Sure, at first it didn't quite work out as we planned and in the end we had to tear down half the forest - but - it was worth it. ...
npc.rottin_wood.multi_24: [EN] Still, most of the camp is kind of... broken now. And someone with a good hammer and a steady hand needs to fix that. Or I am afraid we will have to freeze... during the cold evenings... well you know, hard times. ...
npc.rottin_wood.multi_25: [EN] So what do you say, in for this one?
npc.rottin_wood.multi_3: [EN] Once all of them are trapped in the nets, you can go down and gather anything of value you can find. But only take what we... you really need - around 100 gold should be enough for any man to take. ...
npc.rottin_wood.multi_4: [EN] We have manners after all, haven't we. ...
npc.rottin_wood.multi_5: [EN] My men will take their share of course and... help you relieve the merchants of any valuables. ...
npc.rottin_wood.multi_6: [EN] You're done if you get at least... let's say 5 of these fools. Return to me and you will be rewarded. ...
npc.rottin_wood.multi_7: [EN] Off you go and - good hunt, heh.
npc.rottin_wood.multi_8: [EN] Right, now before the merchants enter the woods, you will install several traps - nothing too dangerous, just nets and ropes. ...
npc.rottin_wood.multi_9: [EN] When they enter said area which is located close to our hidden camp, they will be trapped and you can... lighten their heavy burden of valuable goods. ...
npc.rottin_wood.say_1: [EN] Oh, you want some work? You can help us, alright. Did you know that the people of the city think those rabbit feet are actually lucky charms?
npc.rottin_wood.say_10: [EN] Good, because that is exactly what you will help us with - getting more 'lucky charms'. If we won't get our hands on new charms in time, we will surely have to starve... during the autumn. That would be a hard time for all of us. So... you in?
npc.rottin_wood.say_11: [EN] Good hunt. That will be enough to help us uhm... get through the winter yes. Now if you want to help us getting even more lucky charms, you can always ask.
npc.rottin_wood.say_12: [EN] You do not have sufficient rabbit's foot.
npc.rottin_wood.say_13: [EN] Good, good. Do you remember the old saying? If it ain't broken, it was not made by us. Now, off you go!
npc.rottin_wood.say_2: [EN] You need to wait some hours to take another mission again or you are still on a mission.
npc.rottin_wood.say_3: [EN] Good to see you back. Now, did you bring us the lucky charms?
npc.rottin_wood.say_4: [EN] You need to wait some hours to take another mission again or you are still on a mission.
npc.rottin_wood.say_5: [EN] Ah there you are. So, did you repair all the broken structures?
npc.rottin_wood.say_6: [EN] You need to wait some hours to take another mission again or you are still on a mission.
npc.rottin_wood.say_7: [EN] You need to wait some hours to take another mission again or you are still on a mission.
npc.rottin_wood.say_8: [EN] You did it!! And I assume you took only what you needed? Heh. No, I know it. Because my men took the rest. Thanks for helping us, you did a very good job. In fact I have a little 'extra' for you here, thanks again.
npc.rottin_wood.say_9: [EN] You need to wait some hours to take another mission again or you are still on a mission.
npc.rowenna.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome to the finest weaponshop in the land, |PLAYERNAME|! Tell me if you're looking for a good {trade}.
npc.rowenna.sendtrade_msg_1: Naturligtvis, bara bläddra igenom mina varor.
npc.rudolph.greet_msg_1: [EN] Oh, a customer. Hello |PLAYERNAME|. If you'd like to see my wonderful self-tailored clothes, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.rudolph.sendtrade_msg_1: Naturligtvis, bara bläddra igenom mina varor.
npc.ruprecht.multi_1: [EN] Well, he does not really like it if someone tells his story ... but I do! A long, long time ago Santa was nothing but a greedy little dwarf. A real miser, I tell ya ...
npc.ruprecht.multi_10: [EN] Over the years he turned it into a game. He hid somewhere to reward those who found him ...
npc.ruprecht.multi_11: [EN] But once every year, on a very special day which happens to be his curse's anniversary, he goes out and brings presents to the people, and especially to the children ...
npc.ruprecht.multi_12: [EN] Well, that is his story ... Nah, that's not a tear in my eye. It's just the wind, you know.
npc.ruprecht.multi_2: [EN] He was greedy even by dwarven standards. He would never share anything or give away the cheapest thing in his possession ...
npc.ruprecht.multi_3: [EN] One day a woman came to his house and asked him for a cup of water ...
npc.ruprecht.multi_4: [EN] Of course he refused. He even mocked her for being so naive. But what he did not know was that this woman was some kind of mighty faery or perhaps a goddess in disguise ...
npc.ruprecht.multi_5: [EN] Be it as it may, the woman cursed old Santa, forcing him to share his fortune with everyone he met ...
npc.ruprecht.multi_6: [EN] Santa was horrified. Of course, he could not bear the thought of sharing anything at all. So he went into hiding ...
npc.ruprecht.multi_7: [EN] He hid in the most remote places in the world, but time and again someone found him out, and the curse made him share his wealth ...
npc.ruprecht.multi_8: [EN] And know something? Old Santa actually came to like it! He saw the joy his presents brought, and this opened his old stony heart ...
npc.ruprecht.multi_9: [EN] And he learned that this way his fortune gave him more joy and pleasure than it ever did when he locked it away. ...
npc.ruprecht.say_1: [EN] So you want to exchange {}, for {} christmas tokens?
npc.ruprecht.say_2: [EN] So you want to exchange {} to {} christmas token(s)?
npc.ruprecht.say_5: [EN] You don't have enough of tokens.
npc.ruprecht.say_6: [EN] Come back when you are ready to trade some tokens!
npc.saideh.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello, my name is Saideh. Once this was the entry to the crypt of our heroes. One of the graves belongs to our beloved hero Dayyan. Nowadays it is not a good idea to visit this place.
npc.saideh.say_1: [EN]  I would like you to visit the grave of our beloved hero Dayyan. His remains have to be reburied, because a horde of ogres controls this place. Do you want to start this holy mission?
npc.saideh.say_2: [EN] Well, I appreciate that. Good luck!
npc.sam.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome to my shop, adventurer |PLAYERNAME|! I {trade} with weapons and armor.
npc.sam.multi_1: [EN] Thank you very much! This brings back good old memories! Please, as a reward, travel to Kazordoon and ask my old friend Kroox to provide you a special dwarven armor. ...
npc.sam.multi_2: [EN] I will mail him about you immediately. Just tell him, his old buddy Sam is sending you.
npc.sam.say_1: [EN] Oh, Gregor sent you? I see. It will be my pleasure to adorn your helmet. Please give me some time to finish it.
npc.sam.say_11: [EN] I can't believe it. Finally I will be rich! I could move to Edron and enjoy my retirement! But ... wait a minute! I will not start working without a contract! Are you willing to sign one?
npc.sam.say_12: [EN] Fine! Here is the contract. Please sign it. Talk to me about it again when you're done.
npc.sam.say_13: [EN] You don't have a signed contract.
npc.sam.say_14: [EN] Excellent! I will start working right away! Now that I am going to be rich, I will take the opportunity to tell some people what I REALLY think about them!
npc.sam.say_16: [EN] This deal sounded too good to be true anyway.
npc.sam.say_2: [EN] Just in time, |PLAYERNAME|. Your helmet is finished, I hope you like it.
