npc.the_first_dragon.multi_18: [EN] They used {weaknesses} to their advantage. It took some time before a dragon could be killed in a fair fight.
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_19: [EN] I really enjoy a good fight now and then. ...
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_2: [EN] A young dragon appreciates diving into a lava pool, while an old dragon just can't stand to get rid of the {lava} afterwards and prefers bathing in boiling water.
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_20: [EN] A real pain, however, is the constant annoyance caused by tedious fights against adventurers with more healing pots than brain.
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_21: [EN] You are my greatest fans after all. ...
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_22: [EN] If it becomes popular, I might consider an orcish translation or even one in bonelord language. ...
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_23: [EN] By the way, it's a funny story how I learnt the bonelord language. However, I saved it for a possible part two of my memoirs.
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_24: [EN] By the way, it's a funny story how I learnt the bonelord language. However, I saved it for a possible part two of my memoirs.
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_25: [EN] Eventually there comes a time when you decide all the {hassle} isn't worth it anymore and you decide to concentrate on the {finer} things life has to offer.
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_26: [EN] Eventually there comes a time when you decide all the {hassle} isn't worth it anymore and you decide to concentrate on the {finer} things life has to offer.
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_27: [EN] Even in {retirement} I sometimes succumb to the temptation of sweet battle. Fighting was so different back in the old {times}. You can read about it in my {memoirs}. There should be a copy lying here somewhere.
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_28: [EN] Have a look at the chests over there. Feel free to take the things you find within. You know, gold, gems and the like. There's also a garment I'm storing here for a while. As it doesn't fit me I have no need for it. ...
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_29: [EN] But it might be a nice outfit for a little human. You also can take the porcelain mask and the feathers. There's a wizard named Muriel in Thais who reportedly embellishes outfits with stuff like this.
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_3: [EN] Well, surely some of my kin might whine and complain as they always do. ...
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_4: [EN] You have no idea how backwards thinking some dragons can be. A few are even still idealising the times before the {mists}.
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_5: [EN] Being powerful creatures themselves, dragons had no need for inventions. ...
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_6: [EN] However, now that times have changed and the pressure increases, even my kin might slowly start to change in order to {adapt}.
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_7: [EN] Your books are an amazing thing. Draconic glyphs are so different. ...
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_8: [EN] They are not only more complicated but also more specific. A single word which always keeps the same meaning is astonishingly effective in its primitive way. ...
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_9: [EN] Books are a wonderful {invention}. If you are ever tired of your heroic exploits, take the time to read one.
npc.the_first_dragon.stdmod_1: [EN] Times have changed <sigh>. In the past dragons were feared and respected. Only the {demons} rivalled our notoriety.
npc.the_first_dragon.stdmod_2: [EN] Those upstarts! I wonder why would anyone care about them. They lack our style. For them it is all about brute force and showing-off.
npc.the_first_dragon.stdmod_3: [EN] Breathing fire is an art! Instead of setting everything on fire, you exhale a cone of fire to give a worthy opponent a chance to avoid it.
npc.the_first_dragon.stdmod_4: [EN] Your lives are so short and meaningless and yet you are here! And as a race you even have your own history and remember things with the help of {books}, which amazes me.
npc.the_first_dragon.stdmod_5: [EN] I like the idea of books so much that I acquired a human servant to record my memoirs. You find a copy somewhere in my lair.
npc.the_first_dragon.stdmod_6: [EN] Lava is only fun as long as it doesn't harden - then it turns into an annoyance.
npc.the_librarian.greet_msg_1: [EN] Greetings, dear guest. If you are interested in paperware such as books or scrolls, ask me for a trade.
npc.the_librarian.multi_1: [EN] To extract memories from the ring, you have to enter a trance-like state with the help of a hallucinogen. Like this you can see all memories that are stored in the ring. Ask Faloriel for a respective potion. ...
npc.the_librarian.multi_2: [EN] Drink it while wearing the ring in the Temple of Bastesh and say: 'Sa Katesa Tarsani na'. If the legends are true you will be able to take memories with you in the form of memory shards.
npc.the_librarian.say_1: [EN] You don't need any instructions about the ring right now.
npc.the_librarian.voice_1: [EN] I really have to find this scroll. Where did I put it?
npc.the_librarian.voice_2: [EN] Too much dust here. I should tidy up on occasion.
npc.the_librarian.voice_3: [EN] Someone opened the Grimoire of Flames without permission. Egregious!
npc.the_lootmonger.greet_msg_1: [EN] Ah, a customer! Be greeted, |PLAYERNAME|! I buy all kinds of loot, would you like a {trade}? I can also show you my {shop options}.
npc.the_lootmonger.say_2: [EN] Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.
npc.the_oracle.farewell_msg_1: [EN] COME BACK WHEN YOU ARE PREPARED TO FACE YOUR DESTINY!
npc.the_oracle.greet_msg_1: [EN] {}, ARE YOU PREPARED TO FACE YOUR DESTINY?
npc.the_oracle.say_1: [EN] {}, I CAN'T LET YOU LEAVE - YOU ARE TOO STRONG ALREADY! \z YOU CAN ONLY LEAVE WITH LEVEL 9 OR LOWER.
npc.the_oracle.say_2: [EN] IN {}! AND WHAT PROFESSION HAVE YOU CHOSEN: \z {KNIGHT}, {PALADIN}, {SORCERER}, OR {DRUID}?
npc.the_oracle.say_3: [EN] IN WHICH TOWN DO YOU WANT TO LIVE: {CARLIN}, {THAIS}, OR {VENORE}?
npc.the_oracle.say_8: [EN] CHILD! COME BACK WHEN YOU HAVE GROWN UP!
npc.the_oracle.vocation_druid: [EN] A DRUID! ARE YOU SURE? THIS DECISION IS IRREVERSIBLE!
npc.the_oracle.vocation_knight: [EN] A KNIGHT! ARE YOU SURE? THIS DECISION IS IRREVERSIBLE!
npc.the_oracle.vocation_paladin: [EN] A PALADIN! ARE YOU SURE? THIS DECISION IS IRREVERSIBLE!
npc.the_oracle.vocation_sorcerer: [EN] A SORCERER! ARE YOU SURE? THIS DECISION IS IRREVERSIBLE!
npc.the_oracle.walkaway_msg_1: [EN] COME BACK WHEN YOU ARE PREPARED TO FACE YOUR DESTINY!
npc.the_orc_king.greet_msg_1: [EN] Harrrrk! You think you are strong now? You shall never escape my wrath! I am immortal!
npc.the_orc_king.multi_1: [EN] I can sense your evil intentions to imprison a djinn! You are longing for the lamp, which I still possess. ...
npc.the_orc_king.multi_2: [EN] Who do you want to trap in this cursed lamp?
npc.the_orc_king.say_1: [EN] Arrrrgh! A dirty paleskin! To me my children! Kill them my guards!
npc.the_orc_king.say_2: [EN] For eons he was trapped in an enchanted lamp by some ancient race. Now he's free to roam the world again. Although he cheated me I appreciate what he and his brethren will do to this world, now it's the time of the Djinn again!
npc.the_orc_king.say_3: [EN] You bring me a stinking cookie???
npc.the_orc_king.say_4: [EN] I was waiting for this day! Take the lamp and let Malor feel my wrath!
npc.the_orc_king.say_5: [EN] I don't know your enemy, paleskin! Begone!
npc.the_orc_king.say_6: [EN] You have no cookie that I'd like.
npc.the_orc_king.say_7: [EN] Well, I hope it stinks a lot. I like stinking cookies best ... BY MY THOUSAND SONS! YOU ARE SO DEAD HUMAN! DEAD!
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_1: [EN] I am Charkahn the Slayer! The immortal father of the {orcs} and master of this {hive}.
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_10: [EN] Pah! Don't mock me, mortal! This shape is a curse which the evil {djinn} bestowed upon me!
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_11: [EN] This cursed djinn king! I set him free from an enchanted {lamp}, and he {cheated} me!
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_12: [EN] Because I freed him he granted me three wishes. He was true to his word in the first two {wishes}.
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_13: [EN] He built this fortress over Uldrek's grave within a single night. Also, he granted me my second wish and gave me immortality. Test it and try to kill me if you want. Har Har!
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_14: [EN] I wished to father more healthy and fertile children as any orc has ever done. But the djinn cheated me and made me a slime! Then he laughed at me and left for his abandoned fortress in the {Deathwish} Mountains.
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_15: [EN] His ancient fortress on Darama was deserted as the evil Djinn fled this world after his imprisonment. Now the time has come for the evil Djinns to return to their master although this will certainly awaken the {good Djinn} too.
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_16: [EN] I will not share anything more about that topic with you {paleskins}.
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_17: [EN] You are as ugly as maggots, although not quite as as tasty.
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_18: [EN] This cursed djinn king! I set him free from an enchanted lamp, and he cheated me!
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_2: [EN] The orcs are the bearers of Blogs rage. This makes us the ultimate fighters and the most powerful of all races.
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_3: [EN] The orcs are the bearers of Blogs rage. This makes us the ultimate fighters and the most powerful of all races.
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_4: [EN] I can sense the presence and the feelings of my underlings and {minions}. I embrace the rage of the horde.
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_5: [EN] The orcish horde of this hive is under my control. I sense their emotions and their needs and provide them with the leadership they need to focus their hate and rage
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_6: [EN] Hate and rage are the true blessings of Blog, since they are powerful weapons. They give the hive strength. I provide them with direction and focus.
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_7: [EN] The Raging One blessed us with his burning hate. We are truly his children and therefore {divine}.
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_8: [EN] To conquer, to destroy and to dominate. Orcs are born to rule the {world}.
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_9: [EN] One day I will rule the world, even when turned into a {slime}.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.greet_msg_: [EN] Be greeted, dear visitor. Come and {stay} ... a while.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_1: [EN] If you have passed the first six seals and entered the blue fires that lead to the chamber of the seal you might receive my {kiss} ... It will open the last seal. Do you think you are ready?
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_10: [EN] You have not found the hidden seal yet. Return when you are better prepared.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_11: [EN] The Queen of the Banshee: Oh yes, you have braved the plague seal. Have you passed any other seal yet?
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_12: [EN] You have not faced the plagueseal yet. Return to me when you are better prepared.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_13: [EN] The Queen of the Banshee: Ah, I can sense the power of the seal of demonrage burning in your heart. Have you passed any other seal yet?
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_14: [EN] You are not filled with the fury of the imprisoned demon. Return when you are better prepared.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_15: [EN] The Queen of the Banshee: So, you have managed to pass the seal of the true path. Have you passed any other seal yet?
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_16: [EN] You have not found your true path yet. Return when you are better prepared.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_17: [EN] The Queen of the Banshee: I see! You have mastered the seal of logic. You have made the sacrifice, you have seen the unseen, you possess fortitude, you have filled yourself with power and found your path. You may ask me for my {kiss} now.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_18: [EN] You have not found your true path yet. Return to meh when you are better prepared.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_2: [EN] Are you prepared to receive my kiss, even though this will mean that your death as well as a part of your soul will forever belong to me, my dear?
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_20: [EN] You have spilled too much blood recently and the dead are hungry for your soul. Perhaps return when you regained you inner balance.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_21: [EN] Listen... there are no blooming flowers down here and the only smell present is that of death and decay. I wish that I could breathe the lovely smell of beautiful flowers just one more time, especially those which elves cultivate. Could you please bring me 50 holy orchids?
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_22: [EN] Thank you. I will wait for your return.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_23: [EN] Thank you! You have no idea what that means to me. As promised, here is your reward... as a follower of Zathroth, I hope that you will like this accessory.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_25: [EN] Then try to be better prepared next time we meet.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_26: [EN] Perhaps it is the better choice for you, my dear.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_3: [EN] You have already received my kiss. You should know better then to ask for it.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_4: [EN] Your wish for a spectral dress is silly. Although I will grant you the permission to take one. My maidens left one in a box in a room, directly south of here.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_5: [EN] Say... I have been longing for something for an eternity now... if you help me retrieve it, I will reward you. Do you consent to this arrangement?
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_6: [EN] Have you really brought me 50 holy orchids?
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_7: [EN] The Queen of the Banshee: Yessss, I can sense you have passed the seal of sacrifice. Have you passed any other seal yet?
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_8: [EN] You have not passed the seal of sacrifice yet. Return to me when you are better prepared.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_9: [EN] The Queen of the Banshee: I sense you have passed the hidden seal as well. Have you passed any other seal yet?
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.stdmod_2: [EN] It's my curse to be the eternal {guardian} of this ancient {place}.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.stdmod_3: [EN] I'm the {guardian} of the {SEVENTH} and final seal. The seal to open the last door before ... but perhaps it's better to see it with your own eyes.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.stdmod_4: [EN] It served as a temple, a source of power and ... as a sender for an ancient {race} which lived a long time ago and has long been forgotten.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.stdmod_5: [EN] The race that built this edifice came to this place from the stars. They ran from an enemy even more horrible than themselves. But they carried the {seed} of their own destruction in them.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.stdmod_6: [EN] This ancient race was annihilated by its own doings, that's all I know. Aeons have passed since then, but the sheer presence of this {complex} is still defiling and desecrating this area.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.stdmod_7: [EN] Its constructors were too strange for you or even me to understand. We don't know what this ... thing they built was supposed to be good for. I feel a constant twisting and binding of souls, though, that is probably only a side-effect.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.stdmod_8: [EN] The place you know as the Ghostlands had a different name once ... and many names after. Too many to remember them all.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.walkaway_m: [EN] Yes, flee from death. But know it shall be always one step behind you.
npc.theodore_loveless.multi_1: [EN] Ah what a fine blend. I really ...
npc.theodore_loveless.multi_2: [EN] OUCH! What have you done you fool? How dare you???
npc.theodore_loveless.say_1: [EN] Oh my. Have you gotten an exquisite cigar for me, my young friend?
npc.theodore_loveless.say_2: [EN] Oh, then there must be a misunderstanding.
npc.thorgrin.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! May earth protect you on the rocky grounds. If you need a {passage} back, I can help you.
npc.thorwulf.stdmod_1:
[EN] In this category I have '{Bruise Bane}', '{Cure Bleeding}', '{Wound Cleansing}', \z
		'{Cure Poison}', '{Intense Wound Cleansing}', '{Recovery}' and '{Intense Recovery}'.
npc.thorwulf.stdmod_2:
[EN] In this category I have '{Light}', '{Find Person}', '{Magic Rope}', '{Levitate}', '{Haste}', \z
		'{Charge}' and '{Great Light}'.
npc.thorwulf.stdmod_3:
[EN] I can teach you {healing spells}, {attack spells} and {support spells}. \z
		What kind of spell do you wish to learn? \z
		You can also tell me for which level you would like to learn a spell, if you prefer that.
npc.thorwulf.stdmod_4: [EN] In this category I have '{Whirlwind Throw}', '{Groundshaker}', '{Berserk}' and '{Fierce Berserk}' as well as ... '{Brutal Strike}', '{Front Sweep}', '{Inflict Wound}' and '{Annihilation}'.
npc.tibra.farewell_msg_1: [EN] Good bye, |PLAYERNAME|. May the gods be with you to guard and guide you, my child!
npc.tibra.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome in the name of the gods, pilgrim |PLAYERNAME|!
npc.tibra.stdmod_1: [EN] I think you have forgotten to bring your stake, my child.
npc.tibra.stdmod_10: [EN] I am a priest of the great pantheon.
npc.tibra.stdmod_11: [EN] The teachings of Crunor tell us to honor life and not to harm it.
npc.tibra.stdmod_12: [EN] It is my mission to bring the teachings of the gods to everyone.
npc.tibra.stdmod_13: [EN] It is my mission to bring the teachings of the gods to everyone.
npc.tibra.stdmod_14: [EN] My name is Tibra. Your soul tells me that you are |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.tibra.stdmod_15: [EN] Queen Eloise is wise to listen to the proposals of the druidic followers of Crunor.
npc.tibra.stdmod_16: [EN] The grace of the gods must be earned, it cannot be bought!
npc.tibra.stdmod_17: [EN] The world of Tibia is the creation of the gods.
npc.tibra.stdmod_19: [EN] There's something strange in its neighbourhood. But whom we gonna call for help if not the gods?
npc.tibra.stdmod_2: [EN] Yes, I was informed what to do. Are you prepared to receive my line of the prayer?
npc.tibra.stdmod_20: [EN] Remind: Not everything you call monster is evil to the core!
npc.tibra.stdmod_21: [EN] The mythical blade was hidden in ancient times. Its said that powerful wards protect it.
npc.tibra.stdmod_22: [EN] The fallen one should be mourned, not feared.
npc.tibra.stdmod_23: [EN] Only a man can fall as low as he did. His soul rotted away already.
npc.tibra.stdmod_24: [EN] The gods of good guard us and guide us, the gods of evil want to destroy us and steal our souls!
npc.tibra.stdmod_25: [EN] The gods we call the good ones are Fardos, Uman, the Elements, Suon, Crunor, Nornur, Bastesh, Kirok, Toth, and Banor.
npc.tibra.stdmod_26: [EN] Fardos is the creator. The great obsever. He is our caretaker.
npc.tibra.stdmod_27: [EN] Uman is the positive aspect of magic. He brings us the secrets of the arcane arts.
npc.tibra.stdmod_28: [EN] Air is one of the primal elemental forces, sometimes worshipped by tribal shamans.
npc.tibra.stdmod_29: [EN] Fire is one of the primal elemental forces, sometimes worshipped by tribal shamans.
npc.tibra.stdmod_3: [EN] So receive my prayer: 'Hope may fill your heart - doubt shall be banned'. Now, bring your stake to Maealil in the elven settlement for the next line of the prayer. I will inform him what to do.
npc.tibra.stdmod_30: [EN] Sula is the essence of the elemental power of water.
npc.tibra.stdmod_31: [EN] Suon is the lifebringing sun. He observes the creation with love.
npc.tibra.stdmod_32: [EN] Crunor, the great tree, is the father of all plantlife. He is a prominent god for many druids.
npc.tibra.stdmod_33: [EN] Nornur is the mysterious god of fate. Who knows if he is its creator or just a chronist?
npc.tibra.stdmod_34: [EN] Bastesh, the deep one, is the goddess of the sea and its creatures.
npc.tibra.stdmod_35: [EN] Kirok, the mad one, is the god of scientists and jesters.
npc.tibra.stdmod_36: [EN] Toth, Lord of Death, is the keeper of the souls, the guardian of the afterlife.
npc.tibra.stdmod_37: [EN] Banor, the heavenly warrior, is the patron of all fighters against evil. He is the gift of the gods to inspire humanity.
npc.tibra.stdmod_38: [EN] The gods we call the evil ones are Zathroth, Fafnar, Brog, Urgith, and the Archdemons!
npc.tibra.stdmod_39: [EN] Zathroth is the destructive aspect of magic. He is the deciver and the thief of souls.
npc.tibra.stdmod_40: [EN] Fafnar is the scorching sun. She observes the creation with hate and jealousy.
npc.tibra.stdmod_41: [EN] Brog, the raging one, is the great destroyer. The berserk of darkness.
npc.tibra.stdmod_42: [EN] The bonemaster Urgith is the lord of the undead and keeper of the damned souls.
npc.tibra.stdmod_43: [EN] The demons are followers of Zathroth. The cruelest are known as the ruthless seven.
npc.tibra.stdmod_44: [EN] I don't want to talk about that subject!
npc.tibra.stdmod_5: [EN] You should visit Maealil in the elven settlement now, my child.
npc.tibra.stdmod_6: [EN] You already received my line of the prayer, dear child.
npc.tibra.stdmod_7: [EN] A blessed stake? That is a strange request, my child. Maybe Quentin knows more, he is one of the oldest monks after all.
npc.tibra.stdmod_8: [EN] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.tibra.stdmod_9: [EN] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.tigo.greet_msg_1: [EN] There, there initiate. You will now become one of us, as so many before you. One of the {Barkless}. Walk with us and you will walk tall my friend.
npc.tigo.multi_1: [EN] The trial consists of three steps. The trial of tar, where you will suffer unbearable heat and embrace the stigma of misfortune. ...
npc.tigo.multi_2: [EN] To purge your soul, your body will have to be near absolute zero, the point where life becomes impossible. ...
npc.tigo.multi_3: [EN] Something about you is different.  I know that you will find a way to return even if you should die during the purification. And if you do... Leiden will become aware of you and retreat. ...
npc.tigo.multi_4: [EN] If he does, follow him into his own chambers. Barkless are neither allowed to go near the throne room, aside from being judged, nor can we actually enter it.
npc.tigo.multi_5: [EN] He should be easy to defeat with his back to the wall, find him - and delvier us from whatever became of the Penitent.
npc.tigo.multi_6: [EN] He should be easy to defeat with his back to the wall, find him - and delvier us from whatever became of the Penitent.
npc.tigo.say_1: [EN] You are now one of us. Learn to endure this world's suffering in every facet and take delight in the soothing eternity that waits for the {purest} of us on the other side.
npc.tigo.say_2: [EN] Purification is but one of the difficult steps on your way to the other side. The {trial} of tar, sulphur and ice.
npc.tim_the_guard.multi_1: [EN] It's not a drama!! I think there is just no god who's responsible for toothbrush safety, that's all ...
npc.tim_the_guard.multi_2: [EN] And even IF through some miracle the stupid toothbrush had jumped out of the toilet into my hand, I honestly doubt I would ever use it again.
npc.tim_the_guard.say_1: [EN] Ah, well. Just this morning my new toothbrush fell into the toilet.
npc.tim_the_guard.say_2: [EN] What do you mean? Of course they will immediately send someone with extra long and thin arms to retrieve it!
npc.tim_the_guard.say_3: [EN] Your humour might let end you up beaten in some dark alley, you know? No, I don't think someone could have prevented that accident!
npc.tim_the_guard.stdmod_1: [EN] It's my duty to protect the city.
npc.timothy.greet_msg_1: [EN] Oh, hello! It's a pleasure to see a visitor from the continent.
npc.timothy.multi_1: [EN] Oh, you are the contact person of the academy? Here are the notes that contain everything I have found out so far. ...
npc.timothy.multi_2: [EN] This city is absolutely fascinating, I tell you! If there hadn't been all this trouble and chaos in the past, this city would certainly be the greatest centre of knowledge in the world. ...
npc.timothy.multi_3: [EN] Oh, by the way, speaking about all the trouble here reminds me of Palimuth, a friend of mine. He is a native who was quite helpful in gathering all these information. ...
npc.timothy.multi_4: [EN] I'd like to pay him back for his kindness by sending him some experienced helper that assists him in his effort to restore some order in this city. Maybe you are interested in this job?
npc.timothy.say_1: [EN] Excellent! You will find Palimuth near the entrance of the city centre. Just ask him if you can assist him in a few missions.
npc.timur.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome to my little shop, adventurer! First read my blackboards.
npc.timur.voice_2: [EN] Selling ammunition and buying bows and crossbows!
npc.todd.farewell_msg_1: [EN] Yes, goodbye |PLAYERNAME|, just leave me alone.
npc.todd.greet_msg_1: [EN] Uhm oh hello |PLAYERNAME|... not so loud please... my {head}... What ... do you {want}?
npc.todd.multi_1: [EN] I'd really like to rebuild my reputation someday and maybe find a nice girl. If you come across scrolls of heroic deeds or addresses of lovely maidens... let me know! ...
npc.todd.multi_2: [EN] Oh no, it doesn't matter what name is on the scrolls. I'm, uhm... flexible! And money - yes, I can pay. My, erm... uncle died recently and left me a pretty sum. Yes.
npc.todd.stdmod_1: [EN] I am... a traveler. Just leave me alone if you have nothing {interesting} to talk about.
npc.todd.stdmod_10: [EN] I don't know anything about money, missing or not.
npc.todd.stdmod_11: [EN] He often comes here. But his constant confusion gives me a worse headache than Frodo's beer. I rather avoid him.
npc.todd.stdmod_12: [EN] Uhm, never heard about him... and you can't prove otherwise.
npc.todd.stdmod_13: [EN] Thats a common name, perhaps I met a William, not sure about that.
npc.todd.stdmod_2: [EN] I am... a traveler. Just leave me alone if you have nothing {interesting} to talk about.
npc.todd.stdmod_3: [EN] Uhhh ohhhh one of the beers yesterday must have been bad.
npc.todd.stdmod_4: [EN] My Name? I am To... ahm... hum... My name is {Hugo}.
npc.todd.stdmod_5: [EN] Yes, that's my name of course.
npc.todd.stdmod_6: [EN] Uh .. I... I met a Todd on the road. He told me he was traveling to Venore, look there for your Todd.
npc.todd.stdmod_8: [EN] I never was there. Now leave me alone.
npc.todd.stdmod_9: [EN] Resistance is futile... uhm... I wonder where I picked that saying up. Oh my head...
npc.tom.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hey there, |PLAYERNAME|. Did Vascalir send you to me for a {mission}?
npc.tom.greet_msg_2: [EN] Now, now - we can't work with that. Go back to that wolf den and fulfil your mission! Unless there is anything else I can help you with.
npc.tom.greet_msg_3: [EN] Hey there, |PLAYERNAME|. You look... exhausted. Did you run a lot? And more importantly, were you able to find some war wolf leather?
npc.tom.say_37: [EN] I had some cough syrup a while ago. It was stolen in an ape raid. I fear if you want more cough syrup you will have to buy it in the druids guild in carlin.
npc.tom.say_38: [EN] Would you like to wear bear paws like I do? No problem, just bring me 50 bear paws and 50 wolf paws and I'll fit them on.
npc.tom.say_39: [EN] Have you brought 50 bear paws and 50 wolf paws?
npc.tom.say_40: [EN] Excellent! Like promised, here are your bear paws.
npc.tom.stdmod_1: [EN] Buying fresh corpses of rats, rabbits and wolves.
npc.tom.stdmod_10: [EN] {Dixi} and {Lee'Delle} sell my leather clothes in their shops.
npc.tom.stdmod_11: [EN] That's my job. It can be dirty at times but it provides enough income for my living.
npc.tom.stdmod_12: [EN] Do I look like a tourist information centre? Go ask someone else.
npc.tom.stdmod_13: [EN] Help? I will give you a few gold coins if you have some fresh dead {animals} for me. Note the word {fresh}.
npc.tom.stdmod_14: [EN] Fresh means: shortly after their death.
npc.tom.stdmod_16: [EN] Good monsters to start with are rats. They live in the {sewers} under the village of {Rookgaard}.
npc.tom.stdmod_17: [EN] Dungeons can be dangerous without proper {equipment}.
npc.tom.stdmod_18: [EN] You need at least a {backpack}, a {rope}, a {shovel}, a {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}.
npc.tom.stdmod_19: [EN] Sorry, I haven't been outside for a while, so I don't know.
npc.tom.stdmod_2: [EN] Oh yeah, I'm also interested in wolf paws and bear paws.
npc.tom.stdmod_20: [EN] Troll leather stinks. Can't use it.
npc.tom.stdmod_21: [EN] I don't buy orcs. Their skin is too scratchy.
npc.tom.stdmod_23: [EN] Nope, sorry, don't sell that. Go see {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle}.
npc.tom.stdmod_24: [EN] Nope, sorry, don't sell that. Ask {Dixi} or {Lee'Delle}.
npc.tom.stdmod_25: [EN] Nope, sorry, don't sell that. Ask {Obi} or {Lee'Delle}.
npc.tom.stdmod_26: [EN] I'm buying fresh {corpses} of rats, rabbits and wolves. I don't buy half-decayed ones. If you have any for sale, {trade} with me.
npc.tom.stdmod_29: [EN] He's a better cook than his cousin {Willie}, actually.
npc.tom.stdmod_30: [EN] I kinda like him. At least he says what he thinks.
npc.tom.stdmod_32: [EN] He sticks his nose too much in books.
npc.tom.stdmod_33: [EN] My mother?? Did you meet my mother??
npc.tom.stdmod_34: [EN] I don't have a problem with him.
npc.tom.stdmod_36: [EN] It's in the academy, just above Seymour. Go there once you are level 8 to leave this place.
npc.tom.stdmod_4: [EN] Alright. Can I help you with something else then?
npc.tom.stdmod_45:
[EN] I can help you get boots, but I can't give them to you for free. Besides, you'd want good boots, not that stuff made from rat leather. The best leather you'd find on Rook is wolf leather. ... \z
	War wolf leather, to be precise. Problem is - war wolves are rare, and you can't hope to fight and defeat them. So your only chance is to find an already dead war wolf, take his skin, and escape really fast. ... \z
	What an interesting coincidence that I've seen a poacher sneak into the wolf den just a few hours ago. I'm not exactly a fan of poachers - they kill too many of our wolves. ... \z
	Sooo... what I'm suggesting is: follow his traces into the wolf den, and if you get lucky, you'll be able to take one of his illegally obtained war wolf skins. ... \z
	That's why I wouldn't call it 'stealing', what an ugly word... anyway, if you bring the skin back to me, I'll make some great war wolf boots from them. What do you say?
npc.tom.stdmod_46:
[EN] Hmm... unfortunately the skin is damaged too badly. Whoever skinned this wolf wasn't very skilled at it. Hmm. ... \z
	Ah, no need to fret. Tell you what kid, I'm gonna give you some normal leather boots instead. They should keep your feet warm as well. Here you go. ... \z
	By the way... that running you did to get out of the cave will be your normal walking speed when you are several levels higher. With each level you gain, you'll also become a little faster. ... \z
	There are also other items, spells and equipment that increase your speed. ... \z
	You can also tame creatures to ride on that will also increase your speed. So don't worry if you're out of breath now - you won't always be that slow. Now off with you and back to Vascalir, I have work to do.
npc.tom.stdmod_5: [EN] That's what I thought. I marked the wolf den on your map. To go there, exit the village to the north and walk north-east. Good luck finding that poacher and figuring out a plan to take those skins! Hehe.
npc.tom.stdmod_6: [EN] Well, then walk Rookgaard barefoot. It's up to you!
npc.tom.stdmod_7: [EN] Are you sure? I think I see some war wolf leather on you. You should reply with {yes}.
npc.tom.stdmod_8: [EN] My name is Tom the tanner.
npc.tom.stdmod_9: [EN] I'm the local {tanner}. I buy fresh animal {corpses}, tan them, and convert them into fine leather clothes which I then sell to {merchants}.
npc.tom.voice_1: [EN] Buying fresh corpses of rats, rabbits and wolves.
npc.tom.voice_2: [EN] Oh yeah, I'm also interested in wolf paws and bear paws.
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello hello! Always good to see fresh blood! What brings you here?
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.multi_1: [EN] Sanguine! Did you see those sparks! We definitely had some energy transfer! Well done! Now, for your reward. ...
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.multi_10: [EN] The second sample you must retrieve from the sacrificial chamber in the ancient vampire crypts, first floor, far west. ...
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.multi_11: [EN] Take these two sterilised vials, one for each blood basin. Oh, I wish I could go myself! Come back when you have filled both vials.
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.multi_12: [EN] So someone sent you after a scroll, eh? A stroll for a scroll! <chuckles> Sounds like an old-fashioned necromancer thing. ...
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.multi_13: [EN] Well, this piece here is a rather fascinating thing - see those strange blood stains? - ...
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.multi_14: [EN] My predecessors have had it for quite a while without finding out more - I was hoping to investigate, but there's always so much to do! ...
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.multi_15: [EN] Ah, so you want it, too? Well, do me a favour: fetch two samples and assist in my experiment, in exchange for the scroll piece. Yes?
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.multi_2: [EN] Err... I would awfully like to know more about the scroll ...
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.multi_3: [EN] Would you settle for a heartfelt handshake instead - oh, you wouldn't? Well, er, okay ...
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.multi_4: [EN] Give me a minute or two to retrieve it. Ask me for the {scroll} or the {mission}
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.multi_5: [EN] Now, let me see... yes... yes... very good. Let me add THIS ..... swill it... there. Sanguine! ...
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.multi_6: [EN] We're not finished yet. Take this tainted blood vial ...
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.multi_7: [EN] Dab some drops from it on to the four blood pagodas in the inner circle here. Then pull the lightning lever over there.
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.multi_8: [EN] Sanguine! I need two different blood samples - The first one from the necromancer's pure blood chamber. ...
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.multi_9: [EN] I was barred from the premises. For my research! Shameful! I'm a martyr to the cause - oh, the second sample you said? ...
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.say_1: [EN] Hello hello! Did you bring those blood samples?
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.say_3: [EN] Hello hello! Did Hello hello! Well now, painted all those blood pagodas properly?
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.say_4: [EN] Hello hell- oh, you've come for the scroll, haven't you?
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.say_5: [EN] My heart bleeds to part from it. Here. Extend your hand - I'll just retrieve some blood from in exchange - HOLD STILL.
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.voice_1: [EN] Interesting reaction. Bloodcurdling. Must inspect further.
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.voice_3: [EN] Hmm... the conductors are too dry to transmit energy.
npc.tonar.stdmod_1: [EN] What a beautiful day for a little boat trip.
npc.tonar.voice_1: [EN] What a beautiful day for a little boat trip.
npc.tonar_oskayaat.stdmod_1: [EN] I don't feel safe here ... I hope we can return to Ankrahmun soon.
npc.tonar_oskayaat.voice_1: [EN] I don't feel safe here ... I hope we can return to Ankrahmun soon.
npc.tony.say_1: [EN] Uhm, report, eh? <slowly gives a clumsy description of recent problems>.
npc.tony.say_2: [EN] You can {pass} either to the {Arena Quarter} or {Foreigner Quarter}. Which one will it be?
npc.topsy.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello, dear |PLAYERNAME|. How can I help you? \z If you need magical equipment such as {runes} or {wands}, just ask me for a {trade}.
npc.topsy.say_1: [EN] So you ask me for a {{}} to begin your adventure?
npc.topsy.say_2: [EN] What? I have already gave you one {{}}!
npc.topsy.say_3: [EN] Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.
npc.topsy.voice_1: [EN] Runes, wands, rods, health and mana potions! Have a look!
npc.torkada.greet_msg_1: [EN] Greetings! This isn't the {time} to chitchat though.
npc.torkada.multi_1: [EN] So hereby receive the blessings of the gods, provided by me as the voice of the inquisition! ...
npc.torkada.multi_2: [EN] Go now and search the ancient temple in the north-west part of the drefian ruins. Slay the evil that lurks there and cleanse the foul place from its taint!
npc.torkada.say_1: [EN] You need at least level 250 to start our mission.
npc.torkada.say_2: [EN] You already have accepted this mission.
npc.torkada.say_3: [EN] This expedition is here on an important {mission} for the inquisition
npc.torkada.say_4: [EN] Are you willing, to bring the fury of the inquisition to that foul place and eradicate all evil you find? Speak, {yes} or {no}?
npc.towncryer.voice_1: [EN] Hear me! Hear me! The mage Wyrdin in the Edron academy is looking for brave adventurers to undertake a task!
npc.towncryer.voice_2: [EN] Hear me! Hear me! The postmaster's guild has open spots for aspiring postmen! Contact Kevin Postner at the post office in the plains south of Kazordoon!
npc.towncryer.voice_3: [EN] Hear me! Hear me! The inquisition is looking for daring people to fight evil! Apply at the inquisition headquarters next to the Thaian jail!
npc.towncryer.voice_4: [EN] In Ankrahmun's desert, a storm has revealed the entry to a nightmare that can't be sealed. Horrible creatures there spell instant death to all young adventurers who dare take a breath!
npc.towncryer.voice_5: [EN] Near Darashia's coast, a storm has revealed the entry to a nightmare that can't be sealed. Horrible creatures there spell instant death to all young adventurers who dare take a breath!
npc.towncryer.voice_6: [EN] Near Drefia's mountains, a storm has revealed the entry to a nightmare that can't be sealed. Horrible creatures there spell instant death to all young adventurers who dare take a breath!
npc.towncryer.voice_7: [EN] Hear ye! Hear ye! What a lucky and beautiful day! Visit Carlin, Ankrahmun, or Liberty Bay. Yasir, the oriental trader might be there. Gather your creature products, for this chance is rare.
npc.towncryer.voice_8: [EN] Hear ye! Hear ye! A fiery gate has opened, threatening a city! Guard the people frightened, their death would be a pity!
npc.trisha.bones_deliver: [EN] How are you faring with your mission? Have you collected all 100 hardened bones?
npc.trisha.bones_success: [EN] I'm surprised. That's pretty good for a man. Now, bring us the 100 turtle shells.
npc.trisha.bones_wrong: [EN] Well, I'll give you a little hint. They can sometimes be extracted from creatures that consist only of - you guessed it, bones. You need an obsidian knife though.
npc.trisha.claw_deliver: [EN] Have you actually managed to obtain the dragon claw I asked for?
npc.trisha.claw_success: [EN] You did it! I have seldom seen a man as courageous as you. I really have to say that you deserve to wear a spike. Go ask Cornelia to adorn your armour.
npc.trisha.claw_wrong: [EN] You cannot get this special red claw from any common dragon in Tibia. It requires a special one, a lord among the lords.
npc.trisha.farewell_msg_1: [EN] Don't hurt yourself with that weapon, little one.
npc.trisha.say_1: [EN] Okay, who knows, maybe you have a chance. A really small one though. Listen up: ...
npc.trisha.say_2: [EN] First, you have to prove your guts by bringing me 100 hardened bones. ...
npc.trisha.say_3: [EN] Next, if you actually managed to collect that many, please complete a small task for our guild and bring us 100 turtle shells. ...
npc.trisha.say_4: [EN] It is said that excellent shields can be created from these. ...
npc.trisha.say_5: [EN] Alright, um, afterwards show me that you have fighting spirit. Any true hero needs plenty of that. ...
npc.trisha.say_6: [EN] The last task is the hardest. You will need to bring me a claw from a mighty dragon king. ...
npc.trisha.say_7: [EN] Did you understand everything I told you and are willing to handle this task?
npc.trisha.spirit_deliver: [EN] So, can you show me your fighting spirit?
npc.trisha.spirit_success: [EN] Correct - pretty smart for a man. But the hardest task is yet to come: the claw from a lord among the dragon lords.
npc.trisha.spirit_wrong: [EN] You should have enough fighting spirit if you are a true hero. Sorry, but you have to figure this one out by yourself. Unless someone grants you a wish.
npc.trisha.stdmod_1: [EN] In this category I have '{Wound Cleansing}'' and '{Cure Poison}''.
npc.trisha.stdmod_2: [EN] In this category I have '{Light}', '{Find Person}' and '{Great Light}'.
npc.trisha.stdmod_3: [EN] I can teach you {healing spells} and {support spells}. What kind of spell do you wish to learn? You can also tell me for which level you would like to learn a spell, if you prefer that.
npc.trisha.turtle_deliver: [EN] Did you get us 100 turtle shells so we can make new shields?
npc.trisha.turtle_success: [EN] Well done - for a man. These shells are enough to build many strong new shields. Thank you! Now - show me fighting spirit.
npc.trisha.turtle_wrong: [EN] Turtles can be found on some idyllic islands which have recently been discovered.
npc.tristan.stdmod_1: [EN] In this category I have '{Bruise Bane}', '{Cure Bleeding}', '{Wound Cleansing}', '{Cure Poison}', '{Intense Wound Cleansing}', '{Recovery}' and '{Intense Recovery}'.
npc.tristan.stdmod_2: [EN] In this category I have '{Light}', '{Find Person}', '{Magic Rope}', '{Levitate}', '{Haste}', '{Charge}' and '{Great Light}'.
npc.tristan.stdmod_3: [EN] I can teach you {healing spells}, {attack spells} and {support spells}. What kind of spell do you wish to learn? You can also tell me for which level you would like to learn a spell, if you prefer that.
npc.tristan.stdmod_4: [EN] In this category I have '{Whirlwind Throw}', '{Groundshaker}', '{Berserk}' and '{Fierce Berserk}' as well as ... '{Brutal Strike}', '{Front Sweep}', '{Inflict Wound}' and '{Annihilation}'.
npc.turvy.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello, dear |PLAYERNAME|. Can I be of any assistance? Just tell me if you'd like to {trade} weapons or armor.
npc.turvy.sendtrade_msg_1: Naturligtvis är det bara att bläddra igenom mina erbjudanden.
npc.turvy.voice_1: [EN] Courageous adventurers, come buy your weapons and armors here!
npc.tyrias.greet_msg_1: Välkommen, unga |PLAYERNAME|! Om du är svårt sårad eller förgiftad kan jag {heal} dig gratis.
npc.tyrias.keyword_1: [EN] So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_1: [EN] So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_11: [EN] You don't even have that strange stake with you.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_12: [EN] Brewster sent me a strange message about some strange hocus-pocus. I think it's nonsense, but since you have come that far, I'll play along. Are you ready?
npc.tyrias.stdmod_13: [EN] So receive my prayer: 'Your mind shall be a vessel for joy, light and wisdom' - uh, wow, something happened. Well, I guess that's it, but next time if you need some mumbo jumbo rather go to Chondur.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_14: [EN] You don't even have that strange stake with you.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_15: [EN] No problem, I have other things to do.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_16: [EN] A blessed stake? I don't believe in things like that. If anyone does, it's probably old Quentin.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_17: [EN] I won't do that rubbish again. Go pester Chondur with your hocus-pocus.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_18: [EN] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_19: [EN] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_2: [EN] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_20: [EN] Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_21: [EN] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_22: [EN] I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_23: [EN] I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_24: [EN] I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_25: [EN] I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_26: [EN] I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_27: [EN] You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_28: [EN] The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_29: [EN] You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_30: [EN] The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_32:
[EN] This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
npc.tyrias.stdmod_4: [EN] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.tyrias.stdmod_7: [EN] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.tyrias.stdmod_9: [EN] Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.tyrias.walkaway_msg_1: Kom ihåg: Om du är svårt sårad eller förgiftad kan jag bota dig gratis.
npc.ubaid.multi_10: [EN] All Marid and little worms like yourself should leave now or something bad may happen. Am I right?
npc.ubaid.multi_11: [EN] And he is sending a worm like you to us!?! The mighty Efreet!! Tell him that we won't be part in his 'great' plans and now LEAVE!! ...
npc.ubaid.multi_12: [EN] ...or do you want to join us and fight those stinking Marid who claim themselves to be noble and righteous?!? Just let me know.
npc.ubaid.multi_13: [EN] You have the smell of the Marid on you. Tell me who sent you?
npc.ubaid.multi_15: [EN] |PLAYERNAME|, that almost sounded like the word of greeting. Humans - cute they are!
npc.ubaid.multi_17: [EN] |PLAYERNAME|, that almost sounded like the word of greeting. Humans - cute they are!
npc.ubaid.multi_2: [EN] Go now to general Baa'leal and don't forget to greet him correctly! ...
npc.ubaid.multi_4: [EN] Of cour... Huh!? No!? I can't believe it! ...
npc.ubaid.multi_5: [EN] You... you got some nerves... Hmm. ...
npc.ubaid.multi_6: [EN] Maybe we have some use for someone like you. Would you be interested in working for us. Helping to fight the Marid?
npc.ubaid.multi_7: [EN] Only the mighty Efreet, the true djinn of Tibia, may enter Mal'ouquah! ...
npc.ubaid.multi_8: [EN] All Marid and little worms like yourself should leave now or something bad may happen. Am I right?
npc.ubaid.multi_9: [EN] Only the mighty Efreet, the true djinn of Tibia, may enter Mal'ouquah! ...
npc.ubaid.say_1: [EN] Shove off, little one! Humans are not welcome here, |PLAYERNAME|!
npc.ubaid.say_2: [EN] What? You know the word, |PLAYERNAME|? All right then - I won't kill you. At least, not now.  What brings you {here}?
npc.ubaid.say_4: [EN] You already pledged loyalty to king Malor!
npc.ubaid.say_5: [EN] Of course. Then don't waste my time and shove off.
npc.ubaid.say_6: [EN] Who do you think you are? A Marid? Shove off you worm!
npc.ubaid.say_7: [EN] So you pledge loyalty to king Malor and you are willing to never ever set foot on Marid's territory, unless you want to kill them? Yes?
npc.ubaid.say_8: [EN] Of course. Then don't waste my time and shove off.
npc.ubaid.say_9: [EN] Of course. Then don't waste my time and shove off.
npc.ulala.multi_1: [EN] Uzroth very easy to anger. You been great help so far but me think that need to pray to Uzroth meself. Only me understand what he wants at time and he is veeeeeery moody. Cannot risk to make angry! ...
npc.ulala.multi_10: [EN] You seen Krunus altar south in camp, on mountain top? This is where dance is. If you do right steps Krunus will give you sign. If wrong, he not pleased. ...
npc.ulala.multi_11: [EN] Do Krunus dance for us! Step and dance and turn around! You will know when you do good. Make {Krunus} happy and support our great hunt!
npc.ulala.multi_2: [EN] So me will do when you gone. But me thank you very much. Go speak Lazaran and tell the gods are pleased now.
npc.ulala.multi_3: [EN] We need make sure Fasuon is on our side. There is laaaaaaaarge crystal on top of mountain. Don't know where come from, was there before us. Problem is - way is infested with creatures! ...
npc.ulala.multi_4: [EN] Creatures from the other side of mountain. Bony! Scary! We too weak to go through there, can just run and hope to survive.. but you do better! ...
npc.ulala.multi_5: [EN] Please find great crystal of Fasuon and pray there for his support!
npc.ulala.multi_6: [EN] You born dancer! Krunus is pleased and support the great hunt. But he easy to please! Pandor much harder. We weak, so he sad about us. ...
npc.ulala.multi_7: [EN] Maybe we can please with sacrifice of body parts of our enemies. But you need help us get it! We much too weak. ...
npc.ulala.multi_8: [EN] If you bring us 5 teeth of green men, 5 skin of horned ones and 5 skin of snakemen that already be good. Please help tribe make Pandor happy!
npc.ulala.multi_9: [EN] The great hunt! About to begin, but gods are not in favour of us yet. We need all help we get. We please Krunus with special nature dance. ...
npc.ulala.say_1: [EN] Come back if you finished the dance.
npc.ulala.say_2: [EN] Please help tribe make Pandor happy! Did you bring us what I asked?
npc.ulala.say_3: [EN] Please find great crystal of Fasuon and pray there for his support!
npc.ulala.say_4: [EN] You prayed to Fasuon! Me saw ray of lights on mountain top! Beautiful it was. Me thank you for your help. Great hunt almost can't go wrong now!
npc.ulala.say_5: [EN] Krunus is God for plants and birth. He hidden in all that grows.
npc.ulala.say_6: [EN] Me thank you! Me will bring sacrifice for Pandor. He surely be pleased with our work. Well your work, but me won't tell him. Teehee.
npc.ulala.say_7: [EN] You do not have these things!
npc.umar.multi_1: [EN] Oh. Ok. Welcome then. You may pass. ...
npc.umar.multi_10: [EN] I should go and tell Fa'hradin. ...
npc.umar.multi_11: [EN] Well. Why are you here anyway, |PLAYERNAME|?
npc.umar.multi_13: [EN] |PLAYERNAME|, that almost sounded like the word of greeting. Humans - cute they are!
npc.umar.multi_15: [EN] |PLAYERNAME|, that almost sounded like the word of greeting. Humans - cute they are!
npc.umar.multi_2: [EN] And don't forget to kill some Efreets, now and then.
npc.umar.multi_3: [EN] If you want to enter our fortress you have to become one of us and fight the Efreet. ...
npc.umar.multi_4: [EN] So, are you willing to do so?
npc.umar.multi_5: [EN] How dare you lie to me?!? The caliph should choose his envoys more carefully. We will not accept his peace-offering ...
npc.umar.multi_6: [EN] ...but we are always looking for support in our fight against the evil Efreets. Tell me if you would like to join our fight.
npc.umar.multi_7: [EN] I should go and tell Fa'hradin. ...
npc.umar.multi_8: [EN] I am impressed you know our address of welcome! I honour that. So tell me who sent you on a mission to our fortress?
npc.umar.multi_9: [EN] Whoa? You know the word! Amazing, |PLAYERNAME|! ...
npc.umar.say_1: [EN] Whoa! A human! This is no place for you, |PLAYERNAME|. Go and play somewhere else.
npc.umar.say_2: [EN] |PLAYERNAME|! How's it going these days? What brings you {here}?
npc.umar.say_3: [EN] You already have the permission to enter Ashta'daramai.
npc.umar.say_4: [EN] Are you sure? You pledge loyalty to king Gabel, who is... you know. And you are willing to never ever set foot on Efreets' territory, unless you want to kill them? Yes?
npc.umar.say_5: [EN] I don't believe you! You better go now.
npc.umar.say_6: [EN] This isn't your war anyway, human.
npc.umar.say_7: [EN] This isn't your war anyway, human.
npc.uncle.multi_1: [EN] Some dwarven criminal called Blowbeard dares to blackmail our city. He threatens to destroy the whole city and demands an insane amount of gold ...
npc.uncle.multi_10: [EN] In some ruin in the midst of the Green Claw Swamp, a dark knight had fancied himself as the lord of the swamp for quite a while ...
npc.uncle.multi_11: [EN] For some years, we had some sort of gentleman's agreement. In exchange for some supplies and luxuries, the deranged knight used his ominous influence over the local bonelord species to supply us with ... certain goods ...
npc.uncle.multi_12: [EN] However, lately the black knight has proven himself to be no gentleman at all. In a fit of unprovoked rage, he slew our emissary and almost all of his henchmen ...
npc.uncle.multi_13: [EN] Even though we can live with this loss, it becomes obvious that the knight's madness gets worse which makes him unbearable as a neighbour. Find him in his hideout in the Green Claw Swamp and get rid of him.
npc.uncle.multi_14: [EN] The oppression of Carlin's men by their lunatic women is unbearable to some of our authorities. We see it as our honourable duty to support the male resistance in Carlin ...
npc.uncle.multi_15: [EN] The poor guys have some speakeasy in the sewers. Bring them this barrel of beer with our kind regards to strengthen their resistance.
npc.uncle.multi_16: [EN] Our Thaian allies are sometimes a bit forgetful. For this reason we are not always informed timely about certain activities. We won't insult our great king by pointing out this flaw ...
npc.uncle.multi_17: [EN] Still, we are in dire need of these information so we are forced to take action on our own. Travel to the Thaian castle and 'find' the documents we need. They have the file name AH-X17L89. ...
npc.uncle.multi_18: [EN] Now go to Thaian castle and get the File.
npc.uncle.multi_19: [EN] Well, well, well! As you might know, we are entrusted by the Venorean tradesmen to ensure the safety of their ventures ...
npc.uncle.multi_2: [EN] Of course we are not willing to give him a single gold coin. It will be your job to get rid of this problem. Go and kill this infamous dwarf ...
npc.uncle.multi_20: [EN] This task often puts our representatives in rather dangerous and challenging situations. On the other hand, you can expect a generous compensation for your efforts on our behalf...
npc.uncle.multi_21: [EN] Just keep in mind though that we expect quick action and that we are rather intolerant to needless questions and moral doubts ...
npc.uncle.multi_22: [EN] If you join our ranks, you cannot join the service of another city! So do I understand you correctly, you want to join our small business?
npc.uncle.multi_23: [EN] You have proven yourself as very efficient. The future may hold great things for you in store ...
npc.uncle.multi_24: [EN] Take this token of gratitude. I hope you can use well what you will find inside!
npc.uncle.multi_3: [EN] His laboratory is near the technomancer hall. Bring me his beard as proof of his demise.
npc.uncle.multi_4: [EN] We try to establish new trade agreements with various potential customers. Sometimes we have to offer some presents in advance to ensure that trade is prospering and flourishing. It will be your task to deliver one of those little presents ...
npc.uncle.multi_5: [EN] The northern barbarians are extremely hostile to us. The ones living in Svargrond are poisoned by the lies of agitators from Carlin. The barbarians that are also known as raiders are another story though ...
npc.uncle.multi_6: [EN] Of course they are extremely wild and hostile but we believe that we will sooner or later profit from it when we are able to improve our relations. Please deliver this chest of weapons to the barbarians as a sign of our good will ...
npc.uncle.multi_7: [EN] Unfortunately, most of them will attack you on sight. It will probably take some time until you find somebody that is willing to talk to you and to accept the weapons.
npc.uncle.multi_8: [EN] As you know, our lovely city is a bastion of civilisation surrounded by numerous hazards. The nearby Plains of Havoc and the hostile elven town Shadowthorn are only a few of the obstacles we have to overcome on an almost daily basis ...
npc.uncle.multi_9: [EN] Against all odds, we managed to gain some modest profit by exploiting these circumstances in one way or the other. Recently though, one of our neighbours went too far...
npc.uncle.say_10: [EN] Please bring me proof of the mad technomancers defeat!
npc.uncle.say_12: [EN] Let's start with a rather simple job. There is a contact in Thais with that we need to get in touch again. Deliver this note to Gamel in Thais. Get an answer from him. If he is a bit reluctant, be 'persuasive'.
npc.uncle.say_13: [EN] Do you have news to make old Uncle happy?
npc.uncle.say_14: [EN] Do you have news to make old Uncle happy?
npc.uncle.say_15: [EN] Do you have news to make old Uncle happy? Don't tell me you need another barrel of beer, though.
npc.uncle.say_16: [EN] Do you have news to make old Uncle happy?
npc.uncle.say_17: [EN] I need you to locate a lost ring on the Isle of the Kings for me, get back to me once you have it.
npc.uncle.say_18: [EN] Do you have news to make old Uncle happy?
npc.uncle.say_19: [EN] Do you have news to make old Uncle happy?
npc.uncle.say_2: [EN] I hope you did not make this little pest too nervous. He isn't serving us too well by hiding under some stone or something like that. However, nicely done for your first job.
npc.uncle.say_20: [EN] Do you have news to make old Uncle happy?
npc.uncle.say_3: [EN] Ah, yes. This will be a most interesting lecture.
npc.uncle.say_4: [EN] Please bring me the file AH-X17L89.
npc.uncle.say_5: [EN] Does it not warm up your heart if you can bring a little joy to the people while doing your job? Well, don't get carried away, most part of your job is not warming up hearts but tearing them out.
npc.uncle.say_6: [EN] Good work getting rid of that nuisance.
npc.uncle.say_7: [EN] Fine, fine. This will serve us quite well. Ah, don't give me that look... you are not that stupid, are you?
npc.uncle.say_8: [EN] Come back when you've found the ring.
npc.uncle.say_9: [EN] Even if the present has not improved our relations, the weapons will enable the barbarians to put more pressure on Svargrond and Carlin. So in any case we profited from the present.
npc.undal.greet_msg_1: [EN] Greetings hero. I guess you came to {talk}.
npc.undal.multi_1: [EN] You have to empower eight ward stones. Once charged with arcane energy, they will strengthen the Nightmare Beast's prison and at the same time weaken this terrible creature. We know about the specific location of six of those stones. ...
npc.undal.multi_10: [EN] There the nightmare beast can be challenged and defeated.
npc.undal.multi_11: [EN] So do you want to learn the story behind of this or rather talk about the {task} at hand?
npc.undal.multi_2: [EN] You can find them in the mountains of the island Okolnir, in a water elemental cave beneath Folda, in the depths of Calassa, in the forests of Feyrist and on the islands Meriana and Cormaya. ...
npc.undal.multi_3: [EN] The location of the other two ward stones is a bit more obscure, however. We are not completely sure where they are. You should make inquiries at an abandoned house in the Plains of Havoc. You may find it east of an outlaw camp. ...
npc.undal.multi_4: [EN] The other stone seems to be somewhere in Tiquanda. Search for a small stone building south-west of Banuta. Take this talisman to empower the ward stones. It will work with the six stones at the known locations. ...
npc.undal.multi_5: [EN] However, the empowering of the two hidden stones could be a bit more complicated. But you have to find out on yourself what to do with those stones.
npc.undal.multi_6: [EN] You empowered all eight ward stones. Well done! You may now enter the Dream Labyrinth via the portal here in the Court. Beneath it you will find the Nightmare Beast's lair. But the labyrinth is protected by seven so called Dream Doors. ...
npc.undal.multi_7: [EN] You have to find the Seven {Keys} to unlock the Seven Dream Doors down there. Only then you will be able to enter the Nightmare Beast's lair.
npc.undal.multi_8: [EN] You will have to re-empower several wardstones all over the world, to weaken the beast of nightmares. ...
npc.undal.multi_9: [EN] The next step would be to enter a place known as dream scar and participate in battles, to gain access to the lower areas. ...
npc.undal.say_1: [EN] So do you want to learn the {story} behind of this or rather talk about the {task} at hand?
npc.undal.say_10: [EN] Very good! You gained the second addon to the dream warrior outfit.
npc.undal.say_11: [EN] You do not have enough items.
npc.undal.say_12: [EN] Very good! You gained the first addon to the dream warrior outfit.
npc.undal.say_13: [EN] You do not have enough items.
npc.undal.say_2: [EN] Do you prefer the {long} version or the {short} version?
npc.undal.say_3: [EN] The Nightmare Beast is slain. You have done well. The Courts of Summer and Winter will be forever grateful. For your efforts I want to reward you with our traditional dream warrior outfit. May it suit you well!
npc.undal.say_5: [EN] They are not literally keys but rather puzzles you have to solve or a secret mechanism you have to discover in order to open the Dream Doors. A parchment in the chest here can tell you more about it.
npc.undal.say_6: [EN] Are you interested in one or two addons to your dream warrior outfit?
npc.undal.say_7: [EN] You don't even have the outfit.
npc.undal.say_8: [EN] I provide two addons. For the first one I need you to bring me five pomegranates. For the second addon you need an ice shield. Do you want one of these addons?
npc.undal.say_9: [EN] What do you have for me: the {pomegranates} or the {ice shield}?
npc.urks_the_mute.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! Lovely steamboat, ain't it? I can even offer you a {passage} if you like.
npc.urks_the_mute.stdmod_1: [EN]  <the dwarf quizzically raises his brow - the only destinations he accepts seems to be {Cormaya} or {Kazordoon}>
npc.urks_the_mute.stdmod_2:
[EN] Well, you might be just the hero they need there. To tell you the truth, some our most reliable ore mines have started to run low. ... \z
	This is why we developed new steamship technologies to be able to further explore and cartograph the great subterraneous rivers. Our brothers have established a base on a continent far, far away. ... \z
	We call that the far, far away base. But since it will hopefully become a flourishing mine one day, most of us started to call it {Farmine}. The dwarfs there could really use some help right now.
npc.urks_the_mute.stdmod_3: [EN] <the dwarf smiles slightly, shows you a piece of paper with |TRAVELCOST| written on it, as expecting a {yes} or {no}>
npc.urks_the_mute.stdmod_6: [EN] <the dwarf smiles slightly, shows you a piece of paper with |TRAVELCOST| written on it, as expecting a {yes} or {no}>
npc.uso.stdmod_1: [EN] In this category I have '{Bruise Bane}', '{Cure Bleeding}', '{Wound Cleansing}', '{Cure Poison}', '{Intense Wound Cleansing}', '{Recovery}' and '{Intense Recovery}'.
npc.uso.stdmod_2: [EN] In this category I have '{Light}', '{Find Person}', '{Magic Rope}', '{Levitate}', '{Haste}', '{Charge}' and '{Great Light}'.
npc.uso.stdmod_3: [EN] I can teach you {healing spells}, {attack spells} and {support spells}. What kind of spell do you wish to learn? You can also tell me for which level you would like to learn a spell, if you prefer that.
npc.uso.stdmod_4: [EN] In this category I have '{Whirlwind Throw}', '{Groundshaker}', '{Berserk}' and '{Fierce Berserk}' as well as ... '{Brutal Strike}', '{Front Sweep}', '{Inflict Wound}' and '{Annihilation}'.
npc.ustan.say_1: [EN] I had some cough syrup a while ago. It was stolen in an ape raid. I fear if you want more cough syrup you will have to buy it in the druids guild in carlin.
npc.ustan.say_2: [EN] Would you like to wear bear paws like I do? No problem, just bring me 50 bear paws and 50 wolf paws and I'll fit them on.
npc.ustan.say_3: [EN] Have you brought 50 bear paws and 50 wolf paws?
npc.ustan.say_4: [EN] Excellent! Like promised, here are your bear paws.
npc.uzgod.say_1: [EN] You bringing me draconian steel and obsidian lance in exchange for obsidian knife?
npc.uzgod.say_10: [EN] To get into dwacatra you having to get several keys. Each key opening way to other key until you get key to dwarven prison ...
npc.uzgod.say_11: [EN] Last key should be in the generals quarter near armory. Only General might have key to enter there too. But me not knowing how to enter Generals private room at barracks. You looking on your own ...
npc.uzgod.say_12: [EN] When got key, then you going down to dwarven prison and getting me that brooch. Tell me that you got brooch when having it.
npc.uzgod.say_13: [EN] Thanking you for brooch. Me guessing you now want your pickaxe?
npc.uzgod.say_15: [EN] Ah, that's how me like me customers. Ok, me do this... <pling pling> ... another fine swing of the hammer here and there... <ploing>... here you have it!
npc.uzgod.say_16: [EN] Well. Thinking about it, me a smith, so why not. 1000 gold for your personal crimson sword. Ok?
npc.uzgod.say_17: [EN] Too expensive?! You think me work is cheap? Well, if you want cheap, I can make cheap. Hrmpf. I make cheap sword for 300 gold. Ok?
npc.uzgod.say_18: [EN] Cheap but good quality? Impossible. Unless... you bring material. Three iron ores, 250 gold. Okay?
npc.uzgod.say_4: [EN] True dwarven pickaxes having to be maded by true weaponsmith! You wanting to get pickaxe for explorer society?
npc.uzgod.say_6: [EN] You telling me to forge one?! Especially for you? You making fun of me?
npc.uzgod.say_8: [EN] Me order book quite full is. But telling you what: You getting me something me lost and Uzgod seeing that your pickaxe comes first. Jawoll! You interested?
npc.uzgod.say_9: [EN] Good good. You listening: Me was stolen valuable heirloom. Brooch from my family. Good thing is criminal was caught. Bad thing is, criminal now in dwarven prison of dwacatra is and must have taken brooch with him ...
npc.uzon.stdmod_1: [EN] Feel the wind in your hair during one of my carpet rides!
npc.uzon.stdmod_10: [EN] I would never transport this one.
npc.uzon.stdmod_11: [EN] So you heard about haunted Drefia? Many adventures travel there to test their skills against the undead: vampires, mummies, and ghosts.
npc.uzon.stdmod_12: [EN] Some people claim it is hidden somewhere under the endless sands of the devourer desert in Darama.
npc.uzon.stdmod_13: [EN] Thais is noisy and overcrowded. That's why I like Darashia more.
npc.uzon.stdmod_14: [EN] I have seen almost every place on the continent.
npc.uzon.stdmod_15: [EN] I could retell the tales of my travels for hours. Sadly another flight is scheduled soon.
npc.uzon.stdmod_16: [EN] Just another Thais but with women to lead them.
npc.uzon.stdmod_17: [EN] You can buy flying carpets only in Darashia.
npc.uzon.stdmod_18: [EN] I transport travellers to the continent of Darama for a small fee. So many want to see the wonders of the desert and learn the secrets of Darama.
npc.uzon.stdmod_19: [EN] I heard too many news to recall them all.
npc.uzon.stdmod_2: [EN] Never heard about a place like this.
npc.uzon.stdmod_20: [EN] I heard too many news to recall them all.
npc.uzon.stdmod_21: [EN] I can fly you to {Darashia} on Darama, {Kazordoon}, {Svargrond}, {Issavi}, {Farmine} or {Edron} if you like. Where do you want to go?
npc.uzon.stdmod_22: [EN] I can fly you to {Darashia} on Darama, {Kazordoon}, {Svargrond} or {Edron} if you like. Where do you want to go?
npc.uzon.stdmod_23: [EN] I can fly you to {Darashia} on Darama, {Kazordoon}, {Svargrond} or {Edron} if you like. Where do you want to go?
npc.uzon.stdmod_5: [EN] I am known as Uzon Ibn Kalith.
npc.uzon.stdmod_6: [EN] I am a licensed Darashian carpet pilot. I can bring you to {Darashia}, {Kazordoon}, {Svargrond} or {Edron}.
npc.uzon.stdmod_7: [EN] The caliph welcomes travellers to his land.
npc.uzon.stdmod_8: [EN] The caliph welcomes travellers to his land.
npc.uzon.stdmod_9: [EN] Oh, there is so much to tell about Daraman. You better travel to Darama to learn about his teachings.
npc.uzon.voice_1: [EN] Feel the wind in your hair during one of my carpet rides!
npc.uzon_back.stdmod_1: [EN] Feel the wind in your hair during one of my carpet rides!
npc.uzon_back.stdmod_2: [EN] Never heard about a place like this.
